variable_text: حجم كبير من البيانات الشخصية
value_text: set by the executive regulations: establishments not processing a large volume of personal data (المنشآت التي لا تقوم بمعالجة حجم كبير من البيانات الشخصية)
measurement: Standards and criteria to be set by the Executive Regulations; measurement window and measurer not stated in this text
consequence: The Office may exempt such establishments from part or all of the requirements of the Decree-Law
conditions: Discretionary Office power; applies to establishments not processing a large volume of personal data
depends_on: Executive Regulations of this Decree-Law (Art. 3)
quote: المنشآت التي لا تقوم بمعالجة حجم كبير من البيانات الشخصية

variable_text: حجم كبير من البيانات الشخصية الحساسة
value_text: large volume of sensitive personal data (حجم كبير من البيانات الشخصية الحساسة); standards set by the executive regulations (Art. 10(4))
measurement: Standards for determining the volume to be set by the Executive Regulations; measurement window and measurer not stated in this text
consequence: The controller and the processor must appoint a data protection officer
conditions: One of three alternatives in Art. 10(1): (a) high-level risk from new technologies or volume-linked technologies; (b) systematic and comprehensive evaluation of sensitive data including profiling and automated processing; (c) this volume criterion
depends_on: Executive Regulations (Art. 10(4)) set the standards for determining the volume
quote: إذا كانت المعالجة ستتم على حجم كبير من البيانات الشخصية الحساسة

variable_text: حجم كبير من البيانات الشخصية الحساسة
value_text: large volume of sensitive personal data (حجم كبير من البيانات الشخصية الحساسة); no numeric value in the text
measurement: Not defined in the text
consequence: The controller must carry out a data protection impact assessment before the processing
conditions: One of two listed cases in Art. 21(2); the other is systematic evaluation of personal aspects by automated processing with legal or significant effects (Art. 21(2)(a))
depends_on: Not quantified in this text; the Art. 10(4) volume standard is stated for Art. 10 only
quote: إذا كانت المعالجة ستتم على حجم كبير من البيانات الشخصية الحساسة

variable_text: monto mínimo de inversión en activos computables por sector o subsector productivo
value_text: los montos mínimos de inversión en activos computables por sector o subsector productivo, netos de IVA, son: (table of amounts not reproduced in the document)
measurement: Investment in computable assets, net of IVA, by sector or subsector; accreditation based on amounts actually disbursed by the VPU
consequence: Sets the minimum computable investment per sector or subsector for RIGI eligibility; the amounts are not stated in the operative text of this decree
conditions: Recitals (considerandos) mention USD 600,000,000 for new onshore hydrocarbon developments and USD 200,000,000 for the offshore exploratory and productive subsector; these figures do not appear in the operative provisions of this decree
depends_on: Table of minimum amounts in Anexo I Art. 29 as replaced (not reproduced in the document)
quote: los montos mínimos de inversión en activos computables por sector o subsector productivo, netos de IVA, son:

variable_text: share of components of the new product that differ from the goods being produced (by economic value)
value_text: exhiba diferencias en al menos un CINCUENTA POR CIENTO (50 %) de sus componentes, medidos en términos de valor económico
measurement: Share of components by economic value, comparing the new product with goods in execution when the RIGI adhesion application is filed
consequence: A expansion of a Preexisting Project in the Sector de Tecnología that adds a new product qualifies only if the new product differs in at least 50% of components by economic value, cumulatively with the other conditions
conditions: Cumulative with minimum investment of USD 250,000,000 and market useful life of 10 years or less
provision: Art. 8 (replacing Anexo I Art. 60, para. 3 letter a)
quote: exhiba diferencias en al menos un CINCUENTA POR CIENTO (50 %) de sus componentes, medidos en términos de valor económico

variable_text: monto de la inversión mínima computable del Proyecto que involucra la ampliación
value_text: igual o superior a DÓLARES ESTADOUNIDENSES DOSCIENTOS CINCUENTA MILLONES (USD 250.000.000)
measurement: Minimum computable investment of the project that involves the expansion
consequence: A new-product expansion of a Preexisting Project in the Sector de Tecnología qualifies only if the computable investment is at or above this amount
conditions: Cumulative with the 50% component difference and the 10-year market useful life conditions
provision: Art. 8 (replacing Anexo I Art. 60, para. 3 letter b)
quote: que el monto de la inversión mínima computable del Proyecto que involucra la ampliación sea igual o superior a DÓLARES ESTADOUNIDENSES DOSCIENTOS CINCUENTA MILLONES (USD 250.000.000)

variable_text: ciclo de vida útil de mercado del nuevo producto
value_text: igual o inferior a DIEZ (10) años
measurement: Market useful life of the new product, shown by a Technical Useful Life Report submitted with the adhesion application by an independent competent professional
consequence: A new product must have a market useful life of 10 years or less to qualify under the new-product expansion rule
conditions: Cumulative with the 50% component difference and USD 250,000,000 minimum investment conditions
provision: Art. 8 (replacing Anexo I Art. 60, para. 3 letter c)
quote: el nuevo producto a incorporar debe estar caracterizado por un ciclo de vida útil de mercado igual o inferior a DIEZ (10) años

variable_text: valor de los bienes importados respecto del valor total del contrato de provisión de la obra de infraestructura
value_text: no podrá exceder el CINCUENTA POR CIENTO (50 %) del valor total del contrato de provisión de la respectiva obra de infraestructura
measurement: Value of imported goods relative to the total value of the contract for providing the respective infrastructure work
consequence: Imported goods without a transformation process that are integrated into the essential infrastructure work may not exceed this share of contract value; the Application Authority may authorise exceeding it on reasoned justification
conditions: Applies where imported goods are integrated into the infrastructure work essential for the RIGI project
quote: En este último supuesto, el valor de los bienes importados no podrá exceder el CINCUENTA POR CIENTO (50 %) del valor total del contrato de provisión de la respectiva obra de infraestructura.

variable_text: años desde el cierre del período fiscal correspondiente a la fecha de adhesión al RIGI
value_text: luego de transcurridos SIETE (7) años desde el cierre del período fiscal correspondiente a la fecha de adhesión al RIGI
measurement: Years counted from the close of the fiscal period corresponding to the date of RIGI adhesion
consequence: After this period, the rate in Art. 185 first paragraph of Law 27.742 applies to any dividend, assimilable profit or remittance distributed by the VPU as a consequence of the Proyecto Único, regardless of when the profit was generated
conditions: Applies to distributions made as a consequence of the Proyecto Único
quote: luego de transcurridos SIETE (7) años desde el cierre del período fiscal correspondiente a la fecha de adhesión al RIGI

variable_text: montos mínimos de inversión en activos computables por sector o subsector productivo, netos de IVA
value_text: montos mínimos por sector o subsector (tabla no reproducida en el texto del decreto)
measurement: Computable-asset investment actually disbursed by the VPU (second paragraph of Art. 29)
consequence: Minimum investment for RIGI adhesion, set by sector; the amounts are not reproduced in the text
conditions: Applies by sector or subsector productivo; Ley 27.742 arts. 172 and 173
depends_on: Table annexed to Art. 29 is not reproduced in the document
quote: en activos computables por sector o subsector productivo

variable_text: titularidad del capital social por personas con domicilio fiscal en el país (proveedor local)
value_text: al menos el CINCUENTA Y UNO POR CIENTO (51%) de su capital social
measurement: Share of social capital or votes held by persons with fiscal domicile in Argentina
consequence: Company qualifies as a local supplier (proveedor local) for RIGI purposes
conditions: Company also constituted and domiciled in Argentina and supplies goods or services to one or more adhered VPU
quote: al menos el CINCUENTA Y UNO POR CIENTO (51%) de su capital social

variable_text: inversión mínima por Etapa de Proyecto de Exportación Estratégica de Largo Plazo
value_text: inversión mínima por Etapa sea igual o superior a DÓLARES ESTADOUNIDENSES MIL MILLONES (USD 1.000.000.000)
measurement: Computable-asset investment in each successive Etapa
consequence: RIGI project qualifies as Proyecto de Exportación Estratégica de Largo Plazo
conditions: Also requires placement as new long-term supplier in markets without relevant Argentine share (Art. 40(a))
quote: DÓLARES ESTADOUNIDENSES MIL MILLONES (USD 1.000.000.000)

variable_text: distancia máxima entre componentes de un Proyecto Único
value_text: radio máximo de DOSCIENTOS (200) kilómetros
measurement: Distance between project components
consequence: Components beyond this radius are outside the single-project definition unless an exception applies
conditions: Exceptions: related transport infrastructure; radius extended by Authority by reasoned decision; case in Art. 41
quote: máximo de DOSCIENTOS (200) kilómetros

variable_text: titularidad de activos por los integrantes de una unión transitoria de empresas
value_text: titularidad del CIEN POR CIENTO (100%) de dichos activos
measurement: Ownership share of the members, parties or contracting partners of the union
consequence: The unión transitoria is deemed to be the owner of the project assets
conditions: Applies to uniones transitorias de empresas and other associative contracts
quote: la titularidad del CIEN POR CIENTO (100%) de dichos activos

variable_text: valor de bienes importados como proporción del contrato de provisión
value_text: no podrá exceder el CINCUENTA POR CIENTO (50 %) del valor total del contrato
measurement: Value of imported goods relative to the total value of the supply contract for the infrastructure work
consequence: Ceiling on imported goods supplied to a VPU under the import incentive in the stated case
conditions: Applies to imported inputs not transformed by a tariff-heading change or integrated into the infrastructure work; Authority may authorise more
quote: el valor de los bienes importados no podrá exceder el CINCUENTA POR CIENTO (50 %) del valor total del contrato

variable_text: incremento sobre tributos no abonados en caso de desafectación anticipada
value_text: con un incremento del CIENTO POR CIENTO (100%)
measurement: Duties not paid under the incentive, computed at the time of disaffectation
consequence: Early disaffectation of imported goods requires payment of unpaid duties plus this increment
conditions: Disaffectation before the end of useful life; Authority authorisation required
quote: del CIENTO POR CIENTO (100%)

variable_text: tope máximo de los derechos de importación exigibles en caso de desafectación
value_text: hasta un tope máximo del TREINTA Y CINCO POR CIENTO (35%)
measurement: Import duties computed on the basis of the tariff multiplied by two
consequence: Duties payable on disaffectation may not exceed this ceiling
conditions: Computation: tariff multiplied by 2, up to this maximum
quote: hasta un tope máximo del TREINTA Y CINCO POR CIENTO (35%)

variable_text: factor multiplicador vinculado a la facturación mínima del proveedor
value_text: al CERO COMA CINCO (0,5) ni superior al UNO COMA CINCO (1,5)
measurement: Share of annual billing to VPU relative to share of imported goods in total billing
consequence: Sets the permitted range of the multiplier that determines the minimum billing percentage
conditions: Percentage itself to be specified by the Authority within this range
quote: al CERO COMA CINCO (0,5) ni superior al UNO COMA CINCO (1,5)

variable_text: inversión mínima para Proyectos de Exportación Estratégica de Largo Plazo
value_text: DÓLARES ESTADOUNIDENSES DOS MIL MILLONES (USD 2.000.000.000.-)
measurement: Computable-asset investment for the project
consequence: Minimum investment amount for a long-term strategic export project
conditions: Per Ley 27.742 arts. 172 and 173
quote: DÓLARES ESTADOUNIDENSES DOS MIL MILLONES (USD 2.000.000.000.-)

variable_text: participación de Argentina en el mercado global de los productos del proyecto
value_text: posea una participación inferior al DIEZ POR CIENTO (10%) del mercado global
measurement: Argentina's share of the global market for the products, at entry into force of the law
consequence: One of three alternative grounds for qualifying as a long-term strategic export project
conditions: Alternatives: no prior export record, or export to new destinations (Art. 40(a)(i)-(ii))
quote: posea una participación inferior al DIEZ

variable_text: inversión mínima comprometida para cada Etapa de un Proyecto de Exportación Estratégica
value_text: no podrá ser inferior a DÓLARES ESTADOUNIDENSES MIL MILLONES (USD 1.000.000.000)
measurement: Computable-asset investment committed for each Etapa
consequence: The committed minimum must be met before each Etapa ends
conditions: Investment above the amount in one Etapa carries over to the next Etapa
quote: (USD 1.000.000.000) y deberá cumplirse antes de la finalización

variable_text: número de Etapas con inversión mínima cumplida
value_text: para cada una de las DOS (2) primeras Etapas
measurement: Number of Etapas in which the per-stage minimum has been met
consequence: Once the minimum is met for the first two stages, no minimum investment is required for later stages
conditions: Applies to the per-stage minimum of Art. 40(b)
quote: para cada una de las DOS (2)

variable_text: inversión en los dos primeros años como porcentaje del monto mínimo
value_text: igual o superior al VEINTE POR CIENTO (20%) de DÓLARES
measurement: Computable-asset investment in the first and second year counted from the Fecha de Adhesión
consequence: Minimum investment to be reached in the first two years for export strategic projects
conditions: Investments under Art. 38 not counted
quote: igual o superior al VEINTE POR CIENTO (20%) de DÓLARES

variable_text: distancia entre componentes de un Proyecto Único con más de un VPU
value_text: que exceda los DOSCIENTOS (200) kilómetros
measurement: Distance between project components
consequence: Components beyond this radius must be physically integrated
conditions: Export strategic projects with more than one VPU
quote: que exceda los DOSCIENTOS (200) kilómetros

variable_text: investments in categories listed in Art. 38(a)-(d) counted toward minimum
value_text: El límite porcentual del QUINCE POR CIENTO (15%)
measurement: Share of minimum investment counted from the listed categories
consequence: Ceiling on counting these investments toward the minimum
conditions: Applies to acquisitions and asset assignments, real estate, usufruct rights on real estate, and mining or oil and gas concessions
quote: límite porcentual del QUINCE POR CIENTO (15%)

variable_text: other computable investments counted toward minimum
value_text: hasta el CIEN POR CIENTO (100%) del monto mínimo
measurement: Share of minimum investment counted
consequence: Other computable investments may count up to this share of the minimum
conditions: Must be destined to acquisition, production, construction or development of the single project
quote: hasta el CIEN POR CIENTO (100%) del monto mínimo

variable_text: pagos por servicios esenciales computables como inversión
value_text: hasta el VEINTE POR CIENTO (20%) del monto mínimo de inversión
measurement: Share of minimum investment counted from essential-service contracts
consequence: Ceiling on counting essential-service payments toward the minimum, if the Authority approves
conditions: Services approved by the Authority as essential; no payments to affiliated providers
quote: hasta el VEINTE POR CIENTO (20%) del monto mínimo de inversión

variable_text: porcentaje de pagos a proveedores de bienes y obras que corresponde a proveedores locales
value_text: equivalente, como mínimo, al VEINTE POR CIENTO
unit: percent of payments to goods and works suppliers
measurement: Share of total payments to suppliers of goods and works for the project paid to local suppliers
consequence: Affidavit commitment to this minimum local-supplier share during construction and operation
conditions: Applies if local supply is available and at market price and quality
quote: equivalente, como mínimo, al VEINTE POR CIENTO

variable_text: proporción de la producción exportada al extranjero
value_text: más del NOVENTA POR CIENTO (90%) de su producción al extranjero
measurement: Share of production exported or to be exported abroad
consequence: Presumed not to generate market distortion; a lower export share creates no presumption
conditions: Part of the assessment of local market distortion under Art. 52
quote: más del NOVENTA POR CIENTO (90%) de su producción al extranjero

variable_text: diferencias en componentes de un nuevo producto respecto de bienes en producción (valor económico)
value_text: exhiba diferencias en al menos un CINCUENTA POR CIENTO (50 %) de sus componentes
measurement: Differences in components measured in economic value
consequence: New product added to a technology-sector project counts as an expansion
conditions: Also requires minimum computable investment and product life cycle conditions (Art. 60(i)(b)-(c))
quote: exhiba diferencias en al menos un CINCUENTA

variable_text: inversión mínima computable de una ampliación con nuevo producto (sector tecnología)
value_text: DOSCIENTOS CINCUENTA MILLONES (USD 250.000.000)
measurement: Computable investment of the expansion project
consequence: Minimum investment for a technology-sector expansion that adds a new product
conditions: Also requires differences in components and product life cycle condition
quote: DOSCIENTOS CINCUENTA MILLONES (USD 250.000.000)

variable_text: ciclo de vida útil de mercado del nuevo producto
value_text: igual o inferior a DIEZ (10) años
measurement: Market useful life of the new product, supported by an independent technical report
consequence: New product must have a market useful life up to this value to count as an expansion
conditions: Requires an independent Informe Técnico de Ciclo de Vida Útil with the application
quote: igual o inferior a DIEZ (10) años

variable_text: número de Proyectos RIGI involucrados en una adquisición o fusión
value_text: que involucren DOS (2) o más Proyectos RIGI
measurement: Number of RIGI projects involved in the acquisition or merger
consequence: Requires Authority approval to form a single Proyecto Único, with conditions it may impose
conditions: Acquisitions or mergers of VPU shares or assets
quote: que involucren DOS (2) o más Proyectos RIGI

variable_text: tiempo desde la imputación de quebrantos transferidos
value_text: Transcurridos CINCO (5) años desde la fecha de su imputación
measurement: Time since imputation of the transferred tax loss
consequence: No further deduction of the remaining transferred loss after this period
conditions: Applies to transferred quebrantos (tax losses)
quote: Transcurridos CINCO (5) años desde la fecha de su imputación

variable_text: años desde el cierre del período fiscal de adhesión
value_text: luego de transcurridos SIETE (7) años desde el cierre del período fiscal
measurement: Time from the close of the fiscal period corresponding to the adhesion date
consequence: The dividend rate of first paragraph of Ley 27.742 art. 185 applies to any distribution after this period, regardless of the generating period
conditions: Distributions of the VPU; exceptions for distributions to shareholders resident in Argentina per Art. 72
quote: luego de transcurridos SIETE (7) años desde el cierre del período fiscal

variable_text: proporción presumida de fuente argentina de pagos al exterior
value_text: al TREINTA POR CIENTO (30%) de los importes pagados
measurement: Share of amounts paid to foreign beneficiaries presumed to be Argentine-source income
consequence: Payments are presumed Argentine-source income at this share unless a more favourable treatment applies
conditions: Applies to payments not covered by the second paragraph of Ley 27.742 art. 185
quote: al TREINTA POR CIENTO (30%) de los importes pagados

variable_text: avance de inversión para fijar la fecha de puesta en marcha
value_text: se complete el CUARENTA POR CIENTO (40%) del monto mínimo de inversión
measurement: Computable-asset investment, net of Art. 38 and 39 amounts
consequence: Start date of the project (puesta en marcha) is the earlier of the first export or this completion; defines the start of the exchange incentive
conditions: Net of computable investments subject to the 15% and 20% limits
quote: se complete el CUARENTA POR CIENTO (40%) del monto mínimo

variable_text: relación entre divisas ingresadas y divisas demandadas del proyecto
value_text: mayor o igual a los importes en divisas demandadas
measurement: Foreign-currency inflows liquidated in the FX market compared with FX demand for the project, at each access
consequence: Access to the FX market for any purpose is allowed only when inflows at least equal demand, where the Central Bank so provides
conditions: Does not apply to interest or dividend payments under the last paragraph of Ley 27.742 art. 199
quote: mayor o igual a los importes en divisas demandadas

variable_text: período de estabilidad tributaria y aduanera
value_text: durante TREINTA (30) años contados desde la Fecha de Adhesión
measurement: Period counted from the Fecha de Adhesión
consequence: VPU is entitled to pay only the RIGI-related taxes during this period, even if Title VII is amended
conditions: Stability continues for the life of the project for the arbitration protection described in Art. 105
quote: durante TREINTA (30) años contados desde la

variable_text: monto de inversión de una Etapa para extender la estabilidad
value_text: respecto de aquellas Etapas que hubiesen alcanzado el monto de DÓLARES ESTADOUNIDENSES MIL MILLONES (USD 1.000.000.000.-)
measurement: Investment reached by each Etapa
consequence: Authority may extend the stability period only for Etapas that reached this amount
conditions: Long-term strategic export projects
quote: respecto de aquellas Etapas que hubiesen alcanzado el monto de DÓLARES

variable_text: cumplimiento del monto mínimo de inversión respecto de la fecha límite
value_text: incumplimiento del CIEN POR CIENTO (100%) del monto mínimo
measurement: Computable investment reached by the declared deadline
consequence: Listed breach that, combined with the condition in Art. 115 second-but-one paragraph (b), constitutes an art. 211(g) infraction
conditions: Deadline as declared by the VPU; not applicable where the Authority has authorised a modification
quote: incumplimiento del CIEN POR CIENTO (100%) del monto mínimo

variable_text: cumplimiento del monto mínimo en proyectos de exportación estratégica
value_text: incumpla con el VEINTE POR CIENTO (20 %) del monto mínimo de inversión
measurement: Computable investment achieved in an export strategic project
consequence: Project may remain adhered but loses exclusive export incentives; infraction arises only if such incentives are used after the final resolution
conditions: Applies only to Proyectos de Exportación Estratégica de Largo Plazo
quote: incumpla con el VEINTE POR CIENTO (20 %) del monto mínimo de inversión

variable_text: días previos a la fecha fijada para el comicio
value_text: antes de los treinta y cinco (35) días previos a la fecha fijada para el comicio
measurement: Days counted back from the date set for the election; window within which TV and radio advertising is prohibited
consequence: Vote-seeking advertising for candidates and party-related advertising on television and radio is prohibited before this window.
conditions: Applies to TV and radio advertising; other media (print, public roads, internet, mobile and fixed telephony, static advertising at public events) may carry electoral advertising only during the campaign period set by this law.
provision: Art. 1 (modifying Código Nacional Electoral, Art. 64 ter, first paragraph)
quote: antes de los treinta y cinco (35) días previos a la fecha fijada para el comicio

variable_text: minimum interval between free access requests by the data subject
value_text: a intervalos no inferiores a seis meses
measurement: interval between successive access requests by the same data subject; free of charge only at or above this interval
consequence: Access may be exercised free of charge only at intervals of not less than six months, unless a legitimate interest is shown
conditions: No proven legitimate interest (salvo que se acredite un interés legítimo al efecto)
quote: sólo puede ser ejercido en forma gratuita a intervalos no inferiores a seis meses

variable_text: look-back window for credit information to be disclosed on the data subject's request
value_text: comunicadas durante los últimos seis meses
measurement: information, evaluations and assessments communicated to third parties during the preceding six months, counted from the data subject's request
consequence: The credit information service must disclose the information, evaluations and assessments communicated during the last six months and the name and address of the assignee where the data were obtained by assignment
conditions: Request made by the data subject
quote: comunicará las informaciones, evaluaciones y apreciaciones que sobre el mismo hayan sido comunicadas durante los últimos seis meses

variable_text: look-back period for archiving, registering or assigning credit data relevant to solvency
value_text: durante los últimos cinco años
measurement: period during which the debt-related data must be significant for assessing the financial solvency of the affected person
consequence: Only data significant for assessing financial solvency during the last five years may be archived, registered or assigned
conditions: Credit information services; data on the affected person's economic-financial solvency
quote: Sólo se podrán archivar, registrar o ceder los datos personales que sean significativos para evaluar la solvencia económico-financiera de los afectados durante los últimos cinco años.

variable_text: reduced look-back period for credit data where the debt has been cancelled or extinguished
value_text: Dicho plazo se reducirá a dos años cuando el deudor cancele o de otro modo extinga la obligación
measurement: period counted for credit data after the debtor cancels or otherwise extinguishes the obligation; the fact must be recorded
consequence: The look-back period for credit data is reduced from five years to two years, and the cancellation or extinction must be recorded
conditions: The debtor cancels or otherwise extinguishes the obligation
quote: Dicho plazo se reducirá a dos años cuando el deudor cancele o de otro modo extinga la obligación, debiéndose hace constar dicho hecho.

variable_text: maximum retention period for personal data kept by a service provider after contract performance
value_text: por un período de hasta dos años
measurement: period after completion of the contractual service during which the processed personal data may be stored
consequence: Processed personal data may be stored by the service provider for up to two years after performance, under security conditions
conditions: Express authorisation from the client on whose behalf the service is provided, and reasonable presumption of further commissions
quote: por un período de hasta dos años

variable_text: calendar period of debts covered by the deletion obligation of credit databases
value_text: durante el período comprendido entre el 1º de enero del año 2000 y el 10 de diciembre de 2003
measurement: calendar period from 1 January 2000 to 10 December 2003 in which the default or classification occurred; years used as the numeric bounds of the stated dates
consequence: Credit information services must delete and omit future entries of the covered obligations
conditions: Obligations in default (en mora) or classified in categories 2 to 5 by BCRA rules, and cancelled or regularised at entry into force or within 180 days after it; a payment plan or homologated agreement counts as regularisation
quote: durante el período comprendido entre el 1º de enero del año 2000 y el 10 de diciembre de 2003

variable_text: debt classification categories under BCRA rules covered by the deletion obligation
value_text: clasificadas con categoría 2, 3, 4 ó 5, según normativas del Banco Central de la República Argentina
measurement: BCRA debtor classification category assigned to the financial obligation during the covered period
consequence: Entries of financial obligations classified in these categories fall within the deletion and omission obligation for credit information services
conditions: Classification made under Banco Central de la República Argentina regulations; obligation cancelled or regularised
depends_on: Banco Central de la República Argentina classification rules (normativas del Banco Central)
quote: clasificadas con categoría 2, 3, 4 ó 5, según normativas del Banco Central de la República Argentina

variable_text: menor de dieciocho (18) años
value_text: menor de dieciocho (18) años
measurement: Age of the minor depicted in the representation, as stated in the text
consequence: Representations of persons under 18 engaged in explicit sexual activities fall within the offence in Art. 128 para. 1
conditions: Representation produced, financed, offered, traded, published, facilitated, disseminated or distributed by any means, or live shows of such representations involving such minors
quote: toda representación de un menor de dieciocho (18) años dedicado a actividades sexuales explícitas

variable_text: menores de catorce (14) años
value_text: menores de catorce (14) años
measurement: Age of the person to whom access is facilitated or material is supplied, as stated in the text

conditions: VPU holders of projects declared Strategic Long-Term Export; applies unless the general regime is more favourable
quote: Ciento por ciento (100%) luego de transcurrido tres (3) años contados desde la fecha de puesta en marcha del VPU

variable_text: plazo de estabilidad normativa, tributaria, aduanera y cambiaria desde la adhesión
value_text: treinta (30) años siguientes de la fecha de adhesión por parte del VPU
measurement: counted from the date of adhesion by the VPU
consequence: Stability of incentives in chapters IV and V lasts 30 years from adhesion; afterwards the RIGI may be modified under the general regime
conditions: VPU adhered to RIGI; stability covers the tax, customs, exchange and regulatory regime
quote: tendrá vigencia durante los treinta (30) años siguientes de la fecha de adhesión por parte del VPU

variable_text: plazo de estabilidad de etapas sucesivas, contado desde la puesta en marcha de cada etapa
value_text: se extienda hasta los treinta (30) años posteriores a la fecha estimada de puesta en marcha de cada etapa del Proyecto
measurement: counted from the estimated start-up date of each stage
consequence: Stability of successive stages may be extended up to 30 years after each stage's estimated start-up date
conditions: Strategic Long-Term Export projects executed in successive stages; first stage meets minimum investment commitments of Art. 172 a); dates stated in the approving act
quote: se extienda hasta los treinta (30) años posteriores a la fecha estimada de puesta en marcha de cada etapa del Proyecto

variable_text: tope temporal de la estabilidad de etapas sucesivas, contado desde el décimo año de la primera etapa
value_text: cumplido el décimo año de la puesta en marcha de la primera etapa del proyecto
measurement: counted from the tenth year after start-up of the first stage
consequence: Stability of successive stages may in no case extend beyond 30 years counted from the end of the tenth year after start-up of the first stage
conditions: Strategic Long-Term Export projects executed in successive stages
quote: en ningún caso la estabilidad de las etapas sucesivas se extenderá más allá de treinta (30) años contados desde cumplido el décimo año de la puesta en marcha de la primera etapa del proyecto

variable_text: fecha de corte de los gravámenes locales existentes
value_text: 31 de diciembre de 2023
measurement: date used as the cut-off for existing local taxes
consequence: Local taxes and taxable events existing on this date are the baseline against which new local levies and increases are assessed for adhering jurisdictions
conditions: Provinces, the City of Buenos Aires and municipalities that adhere to the RIGI
quote: existentes al 31 de diciembre de 2023

variable_text: precio de venta declarado inferior al precio relevado por la AFIP
value_text: en un veinte por ciento (20%)
measurement: compared with the price determined from the Administración Federal de Ingresos Públicos survey
consequence: Declared consumer price is not treated as a suitable tax base, and the price determined by the AFIP applies
conditions: Not applicable where the taxpayer proves that the declared consumer price is a market price
provision: Art. 229 (inserting unnumbered article after Art. 2, Ley de Impuestos Internos)
quote: inferior, como mínimo, en un veinte por ciento (20%) al precio que surja del relevamiento

variable_text: incremento relativo [...] de la demanda media del MEM
value_text: exceda en al menos un CERO COMA CINCO POR CIENTO (0,5%) de la demanda media del MEM
measurement: Relative increase over average MEM demand
consequence: The new or expanded demand is an Extratrend Demand (XDEM) and must file a Plan Especial de Abastecimiento
conditions: Applies whether connected through transmission or distribution. Wording differs from Anexo Art. 1 ('igual o superior', 'incremento de potencia', 'demanda media de referencia'); both coded
provision: Res. Art. 1 (substituting Res. SE 400/2025, Art. 13, para. 1)
quote: Toda nueva demanda o ampliación de demanda que solicite su incorporación al MERCADO ELÉCTRICO MAYORISTA (MEM) y represente un incremento relativo que exceda en al menos un CERO COMA CINCO POR CIENTO (0,5%) de la demanda media del MEM será considerada Demanda Extratendencial (XDEM)

variable_text: incremento de potencia [...] de la demanda media de referencia del MEM
value_text: igual o superior al CERO COMA CINCO POR CIENTO (0,5 %) de la demanda media de referencia del MEM
unit: percent of reference average MEM demand
measurement: Reference average MEM demand computed by the OED as total MEM energy demanded over the 12 full calendar months before the request, divided by the hours of that period (Base Temporal); demand of one project, establishment or economically or technically linked set is counted as a whole and may not be split to avoid the threshold
consequence: The demand is an XDEM and falls under the regime (subcategory GUMA-XDEM DATOS or PRODUCCIÓN)
conditions: Request for MEM incorporation (and transmission access, where relevant) filed after Res. SE 400/2025 took effect; transmission or distribution connection
provision: Anexo, Art. 1 (definitions of Demanda Extratendencial and Base Temporal); Art. 3
quote: que represente un incremento de potencia igual o superior al CERO COMA CINCO POR CIENTO (0,5 %) de la demanda media de referencia del MEM

variable_text: nueva producción de energía
value_text: al menos un OCHENTA POR CIENTO (80%) de nueva producción de energía
measurement: Base not specified beyond 'nueva producción de energía'
consequence: Required content of the Plan Especial de Abastecimiento filed with the XDEM request
provision: Res. Art. 1 (substituting Res. SE 400/2025, Art. 13, para. 1)
quote: Deberá acompañar a su solicitud la presentación de un Plan Especial de Abastecimiento que asegure: (i) al menos un OCHENTA POR CIENTO (80%) de nueva producción de energía

variable_text: cobertura contractual [...] de la energía efectivamente demandada durante el período mensual
value_text: como mínimo, al OCHENTA POR CIENTO (80%) de la energía efectivamente demandada
measurement: Energy actually demanded in each month; proven monthly; contracts registered in the MATE administered by CAMMESA
consequence: Minimum contractual energy coverage from Nueva Oferta Elegible XDEM; uncovered energy is bought in the spot market at the Insuficiencia de Cobertura Energética value
conditions: Eligible sources: renewable, thermal, hydro or nuclear generation, or other technologies set by the Secretaría de Energía
quote: equivalente, como mínimo, al OCHENTA POR CIENTO (80%) de la energía efectivamente demandada durante el período mensual correspondiente

variable_text: respaldo físico de potencia [...] emprendimiento de Producción
value_text: al menos el CIEN POR CIENTO (100%) de su consumo
consequence: Required firm-capacity backing in the Plan Especial de Abastecimiento for production XDEM, with new firm capacity
conditions: Backing must be new firm capacity within the Plan Especial de Abastecimiento
provision: Res. Art. 1 (substituting Res. SE 400/2025, Art. 13, para. 1)
quote: respaldo físico de potencia suficiente para cubrir al menos el CIEN POR CIENTO (100%) de su consumo en caso de tratarse de un emprendimiento de Producción

variable_text: respaldo físico de potencia [...] emprendimiento de Datos
value_text: el CIENTO QUINCE POR CIENTO (115%) en caso de tratarse de un emprendimiento de Datos
consequence: Required firm-capacity backing in the Plan Especial de Abastecimiento for data XDEM, with new firm capacity
conditions: Backing must be new firm capacity within the Plan Especial de Abastecimiento
provision: Res. Art. 1 (substituting Res. SE 400/2025, Art. 13, para. 1)
quote: el CIENTO QUINCE POR CIENTO (115%) en caso de tratarse de un emprendimiento de Datos

variable_text: potencia firme [...] de su demanda máxima (XDEM DATOS)
value_text: equivalente al CIENTO QUINCE POR CIENTO (115 %) de su demanda máxima
measurement: Maximum demand to be consumed; considered for monthly coverage assessment
consequence: XDEM-DATOS must commit new firm capacity as a reserve guarantee on incorporation; the value is used to assess monthly coverage
quote: La XDEM DATOS deberá comprometer, como incorporación, una potencia firme equivalente al CIENTO QUINCE POR CIENTO (115 %) de su demanda máxima a consumir en concepto de garantía de reserva

variable_text: potencia firme [...] de su demanda máxima (XDEM PRODUCCIÓN)
value_text: equivalente al CIEN POR CIENTO (100 %) de su demanda máxima
consequence: XDEM-PRODUCCIÓN must commit new firm capacity on incorporation
conditions: The text says 'equivalente al', coded as a minimum consistent with Art. 10
quote: La XDEM PRODUCCIÓN deberá comprometer como incorporación una potencia firme equivalente al CIEN POR CIENTO (100 %) de su demanda máxima

variable_text: cobertura contractual de potencia firme [...] de su requerimiento máximo de potencia
value_text: al menos, al CIEN POR CIENTO (100%) de su requerimiento máximo de potencia
measurement: Contracts registered in the MATP administered by CAMMESA; firm capacity must be able to supply the demand physically at its node
consequence: Minimum contractual firm-capacity coverage for every GUMA-XDEM; uncovered capacity pays the Cargo por Déficit de Potencia Firme
conditions: The Secretaría de Energía may exceptionally authorise a lower percentage for new XDEM in exporting areas with structural transmission limits, on a reasoned OED report
quote: El GUMA-XDEM deberá acreditar cobertura contractual de potencia firme equivalente, al menos, al CIEN POR CIENTO (100%) de su requerimiento máximo de potencia.

variable_text: cobertura contractual de potencia firme mínima (XDEM DATOS)
value_text: equivalente al CIENTO QUINCE POR CIENTO (115 %) de su requerimiento máximo
consequence: Higher minimum contractual firm-capacity coverage for XDEM-DATOS
conditions: Same exceptional reduction for exporting areas as the 100% row
quote: En el caso de la XDEM DATOS la cobertura contractual de potencia firme mínima será equivalente al CIENTO QUINCE POR CIENTO (115 %) de su requerimiento máximo.

variable_text: almacenamiento de energía con duración mínima (Potencia Firme)
value_text: duración mínima de SEIS (6) horas
consequence: Energy storage counts as Potencia Firme only with at least 6 hours' duration
quote: Computable desde nuevas centrales térmicas, almacenamiento de energía con duración mínima de SEIS (6) horas

variable_text: sistemas de almacenamiento de energía con una duración mínima
value_text: una duración mínima de SEIS (6) horas
consequence: Storage qualifies as Nueva Oferta Elegible XDEM for capacity coverage only with at least 6 hours' duration
quote: sistemas de almacenamiento de energía con una duración mínima de SEIS (6) horas

variable_text: cargo trimestral de reserva de capacidad
value_text: DÓLARES ESTADOUNIDENSES DOS MIL QUINIENTOS (USD 2.500) por MW
measurement: Per MW of capacity assigned
consequence: Projects assigned capacity conditional on a transmission expansion pay this quarterly charge to the OED from assignment to the committed commercial-operation date
quote: un cargo trimestral de reserva de capacidad de DÓLARES ESTADOUNIDENSES DOS MIL QUINIENTOS (USD 2.500) por MW

variable_text: cargo trimestral durante el plazo prorrogado
value_text: DÓLARES ESTADOUNIDENSES CINCO MIL (USD 5.000) por MW
measurement: Per MW of capacity assigned
consequence: Quarterly charge during the automatic 8-quarter extension after a missed commercial-operation date
quote: Durante el plazo prorrogado el titular abonará un cargo trimestral de DÓLARES ESTADOUNIDENSES CINCO MIL (USD 5.000) por MW.

variable_text: reembolso por cumplimiento
value_text: el OCHENTA POR CIENTO (80%) del monto total abonado
consequence: OED refunds 80% of the charges paid if the project enters commercial operation on or before the committed date
quote: el OED reembolsará al titular el OCHENTA POR CIENTO (80%) del monto total abonado en concepto del cargo previsto

variable_text: reembolso dentro del plazo prorrogado
value_text: el CUARENTA POR CIENTO (40%) a valor nominal, del monto total abonado
consequence: OED refunds 40% (nominal) of all charges paid under (b) and (d) if the project enters commercial operation within the extension
quote: el OED reembolsará al titular el CUARENTA POR CIENTO (40%) a valor nominal, del monto total abonado computando conjuntamente los cargos de los incisos b) y d)

variable_text: factor de potencia (capabilidad P-Q)
value_text: un factor de potencia de 0,95 en el punto de conexión
consequence: Minimum reactive-power capability at the connection point (triangular P-Q curve); a wider range may be required if studies show voltage deterioration
quote: consistente, como mínimo, con una capacidad de operación equivalente a un factor de potencia de 0,95 en el punto de conexión

variable_text: rampa de potencia activa (MW/min)
value_text: 30 MW/min
consequence: Ramp limit for increases and reductions of load at the connection point; the lower of this and 10%/min applies
conditions: Storage may be added to comply; ramps may be configurable at the operator's request
quote: La instalación deberá cumplir con el menor de los siguientes límites de variación de potencia activa (rampas), tanto en incremento como en reducción de carga: ● 30 MW/min

variable_text: rampa de potencia activa (%/min)
value_text: 10 %/min
consequence: Ramp limit for increases and reductions of load; the lower of this and 30 MW/min applies
quote: tanto en incremento como en reducción de carga: ● 30 MW/min ● 10 %/min

variable_text: amplitud máxima de oscilaciones de tensión
value_text: una amplitud máxima del 1 %
consequence: Voltage oscillations must stay within the lower of the IEC 61000-2-2 limits and 1% amplitude across all oscillation frequencies
quote: definidos como el menor valor entre los límites establecidos por la IEC 61000‑2‑2 y una amplitud máxima del 1 %

variable_text: variación de tensión por conexión o desconexión de bloques de demanda (500 kV y 220 kV)
value_text: ±1 % en el sistema de 500 kV y 220 kV
consequence: Limit on voltage changes caused by switching demand blocks, at nodes influenced by the installation
conditions: Verified in Stage 2 Phase 1 studies in N and N-1 conditions
quote: no superen ±1 % en el sistema de 500 kV y 220 kV

variable_text: variación de tensión por conexión o desconexión de bloques de demanda (132 kV)
value_text: ±2 % en el sistema de 132 kV
consequence: Limit on voltage changes caused by switching demand blocks in the 132 kV system
quote: ni ±2 % en el sistema de 132 kV

variable_text: recuperación de potencia activa posterior a perturbación
value_text: recuperar un 90% el nivel de potencia activa en 1 segundo
unit: percent of active power within 1 second
consequence: Active power must recover to 90% within 1 s once voltage exceeds 0.9 pu after a disturbance; a slower adjustable rate may be required by Stage 2 studies
quote: La instalación debe ser capaz de recuperar un 90% el nivel de potencia activa en 1 segundo cuando la tensión supere los 0.9 pu luego de una perturbación.

variable_text: sobreimpulso de potencia activa (overshoot)
value_text: mayores a 10%
consequence: Active-power overshoot after disturbances may not exceed 10%
quote: No deberán producirse sobreimpulsos de potencia (overshoot) mayores a 10% en la potencia activa

variable_text: rango de frecuencia de operación sin límite de tiempo
value_text: entre 49 y 51 Hz
consequence: The installation must stay connected without time limit between 49 and 51 Hz; time-delayed bands extend to 47.5-52.5 Hz
conditions: Except the portion assigned to under-frequency load shedding
quote: Rango de frecuencia admisible de operación sin límite de tiempo entre 49 y 51 Hz

variable_text: tasa de cambio de frecuencia (RoCoF)
value_text: al menos ±2 Hz/s
consequence: The installation must withstand RoCoF of at least ±2 Hz/s without disconnecting
quote: La instalación deberá ser capaz de soportar tasas de cambio de frecuencia de al menos ±2 Hz/s

variable_text: salto en el ángulo de fase de la tensión
value_text: hasta ±25 grados
consequence: The installation must stay connected for voltage phase jumps up to ±25 degrees at the connection point
quote: Ante la ocurrencia de un salto en el ángulo de fase de la tensión de hasta ±25 grados medido en el punto de conexión

variable_text: nivel de tensión del punto de conexión (requisitos de calidad de energía)
value_text: menor o igual a 220 kV
consequence: Power-quality requirements (flicker, harmonics, monitoring, unbalance) apply to installations connected at 220 kV or below
quote: Los requerimientos indicados en esta sección son aplicables a instalaciones cuyo punto de conexión se realice en un punto de conexión menor o igual a 220 kV.

variable_text: flicker de corto plazo (Pst95%)
value_text: el valor Pst95% = 1
measurement: Level measured over 10 minutes that may be exceeded at most 5% of the time over 24 h
consequence: Short-term flicker may not exceed Pst95% = 1 in the 1-220 kV range
quote: no deberá exceder, según normas internacionales y Res. ENRE N° 184/2000, el valor Pst95% = 1

variable_text: desequilibrio de tensiones
value_text: mayor al 1%
consequence: The installation may not introduce voltage unbalance above 1% at the connection point
quote: no introduzca desequilibrios de la tensión en el punto de conexión mayor al 1%

variable_text: monto mínimo de inversión en activos computables por proyecto
value_text: dólares estadounidenses mil millones (u$s 1.000.000.000) por proyecto
measurement: Investment in computable assets per project, to be completed before the deadline stated in the investment plan
consequence: Project qualifies as a Gran Inversión en Nuevas Industrias only if the minimum investment amount is reached.
conditions: Must be completed before the deadline stated in the investment plan; applies together with Art. 12 b) and the Art. 4 requirements.
quote: dólares estadounidenses mil millones (u$s 1.000.000.000)

variable_text: inversión mínima en activos computables dentro de los dos primeros años, como porcentaje del monto del inciso a)
value_text: igual o superior al veinte por ciento (20 %)
measurement: Committed investment in computable assets within the first two years counted from the Fecha de Adhesión, as a share of the Art. 12 a) amount
consequence: The project must commit at least this share within two years to meet an essential requirement for qualification and continuation.
conditions: Counted over the first two (2) years from the Fecha de Adhesión and the investment plan.
quote: igual o superior al veinte por ciento (20 %)

variable_text: inversiones en bienes inmuebles y derechos reales de usufructo computables como parte del monto mínimo
value_text: hasta un máximo del quince por ciento (15 %) de dicho monto de inversión mínima
measurement: Combined amount of real estate and usufruct investments, as a share of the minimum investment amount
consequence: Real estate and usufruct investments count toward the minimum investment only up to this share.
conditions: Applies jointly to items a) real estate and b) usufruct rights over real estate.
quote: quince por ciento (15 %) de dicho monto de inversión

variable_text: ponderación de inversiones en investigación y desarrollo (I+D) computadas por el doble de su valor
value_text: no podrá representar más del veinte por ciento (20 %) del monto mínimo de inversión
measurement: R&D investment weighted at double value, as a share of the minimum investment amount
consequence: R&D investment above this share is counted at nominal value rather than double value.
conditions: R&D investment must be linked to the project.
quote: no podrá representar más del veinte por ciento (20 %)

variable_text: superposición de proyectos con objeto similar, medida sobre el CAPEX comprometido, los activos físicos principales o la capacidad de producción prevista
value_text: igual o superior al cincuenta por ciento (50 %) del CAPEX comprometido
measurement: Overlap in committed CAPEX, main physical assets or planned production capacity, assessed with the group's related entities
consequence: A project with similar object to one whose RIGI application was submitted is excluded from the Súper RIGI.
conditions: Overlap is one of three alternative elements (i), (ii) or (iii) in Art. 8; the threshold applies to element (iii) only.
quote: igual o superior al cincuenta por ciento (50 %) del CAPEX comprometido

variable_text: contratación de proveedores locales como parte del plan de desarrollo de proveedores locales
value_text: equivalente como mínimo al veinte por ciento (20 %) de la totalidad del monto de inversión destinado al pago de proveedores
measurement: Local supplier contracting as a share of the total amount allocated to paying suppliers for the project
consequence: The investment plan must contain a commitment to contract local suppliers at least at this share.
conditions: Applies only while the local supplier offer is available and in market conditions as to price and quality.
quote: equivalente como mínimo al veinte por ciento (20 %)

variable_text: alícuota del Impuesto a las Ganancias aplicable a los VPU adheridos
value_text: alícuota del quince por ciento (15 %)
measurement: Income tax rate applied to the VPU's taxable income
consequence: The VPU pays income tax at this flat rate instead of the general scale of Art. 73 a).
conditions: Applies to VPU adhered to the Súper RIGI.
quote: tributará el Impuesto a las Ganancias a la alícuota del quince por ciento (15 %)

variable_text: alícuota aplicable a dividendos y utilidades de personas humanas y sucesiones indivisas provenientes del VPU
value_text: alícuota del siete por ciento (7 %)
measurement: Net gain of individuals and undivided estates from dividends and profits of the VPU
consequence: Net gains of individuals and undivided estates from VPU dividends and profits are taxed at this rate.
conditions: Applies to dividends and profits covered by Art. 40 of the bill.
quote: tributará a la alícuota del siete por ciento (7 %)

variable_text: alícuota reducida aplicable a dividendos y utilidades tras el plazo de cuatro años
value_text: una alícuota del tres coma cinco por ciento (3,5 %)
measurement: Tax rate on dividends and profits covered by Art. 40, counted from the Fecha de Adhesión
consequence: After four years from the Fecha de Adhesión, the dividends and profits covered by Art. 40 are taxed at this reduced rate.
conditions: Applies once four (4) years have elapsed from the Fecha de Adhesión al Súper RIGI.
quote: Una vez transcurrido un plazo de cuatro (4) años contados desde la Fecha de Adhesión al Súper RIGI

variable_text: plazo sin límite temporal para deducir quebrantos, transferibles a terceros tras cinco años
value_text: Transcurridos cinco (5) años sin que dichos quebrantos hubieren sido absorbidos por ganancias gravadas
measurement: Period elapsed since the tax loss arose without being absorbed by taxable gains
consequence: Unabsorbed tax losses may be transferred to third parties.
conditions: Losses may otherwise be deducted from later taxable gains without time limit.
quote: Transcurridos cinco (5) años sin que dichos quebrantos hubieren sido absorbidos

variable_text: limitaciones del cuarto párrafo y siguientes del inciso a) del artículo 85 de la Ley de Impuesto a las Ganancias no aplicables
value_text: durante los primeros cinco (5) años desde la Fecha de Adhesión al Súper RIGI
measurement: Period counted from the Fecha de Adhesión
consequence: The limitations in Art. 85 a) of the income tax law do not apply during this period.
conditions: Applies only to the first five years from the Fecha de Adhesión.
quote: no serán aplicables durante los primeros cinco (5) años

variable_text: alícuota única de contribuciones patronales para nuevas relaciones laborales
value_text: una única alícuota del diez por ciento (10 %)
measurement: Employer social security contribution rate on new employment relations from the Fecha de Adhesión
consequence: Employer contributions on new employment relations are set at this single rate.
conditions: Applies to new employment relationships starting from the Fecha de Adhesión.
quote: una única alícuota del diez por ciento (10 %)

variable_text: porcentaje de cómputo de los importes del impuesto sobre los débitos y créditos bancarios
value_text: podrá computar el cien por ciento (100 %)
measurement: Share of bank debit and credit tax amounts creditable against income tax
consequence: The VPU may credit the full amount of bank debit and credit tax against income tax.
conditions: Applies to amounts paid or received under Law 25.413.
quote: podrá computar el cien por ciento (100 %)

variable_text: alícuota máxima del Impuesto sobre los Ingresos Brutos que provincias y CABA pueden aplicar a las actividades de los VPU
value_text: una alícuota superior al cero coma cincuenta por ciento (0,50 %)
measurement: Gross income tax rate applied to activities of VPU
consequence: Provinces and the Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires may not apply a rate above this to VPU activities.

variable_text: valor da parcela de multa eleitoral em relação ao faturamento de pessoa jurídica

variable_text: prazo máximo de parcelamento de multas eleitorais para partidos políticos

variable_text: valor da parcela de parcelamento de multas dos partidos em relação ao repasse mensal do Fundo Partidário
value_text: o limite de 2% (dois por cento) do repasse mensal do Fundo Partidário
measurement: monthly transfer from the Fundo Partidário

conditions: Applies to parties' instalment plans
quote: o limite de 2% (dois por cento) do repasse mensal do Fundo Partidário

variable_text: idade de eleitores que não podem ser nomeados para mesas receptoras ou apoio logístico

variable_text: multiplicador de dias de folga para eleitores convocados
value_text: pelo dobro dos dias de convocação

variable_text: folga por certificado de treinamento a distância
value_text: equivalente a 1 (um) dia de convocação

variable_text: distância entre zona rural e local de votação para transporte de eleitores pela Justiça Eleitoral

consequence: Defines the interned adolescents for whom polling sections are provided in detention units
conditions: Submitted to a socio-educational measure of internment
quote: Consideram-se adolescentes internados os maiores de 16(dezesseis) e menores de 21(vinte e um) anos submetidos à medida socioeducativa de internação.

variable_text: número de eleitores do município para instalação de urnas de voto em trânsito

measurement: number of voters in the municipality
consequence: Urns for voting in transit are installed in capitals and in municipalities above this number of voters
conditions: Applies to presidential, governor, senator, federal, state and district deputy elections
quote: nas capitais e nos Municípios com mais de cem mil eleitores

variable_text: idade para preferência na votação
value_text: os eleitores maiores de 60 (sessenta) anos
measurement: age of the voter
consequence: Voters over this age have preference in the voting queue
conditions: Preference applies in the voting queue according to arrival order

variable_text: número de eleitores da circunscrição para o regime de nulidade e novas eleições

conditions: Item II covers Senador and Prefeito of municipalities with up to 200.000 voters
quote: nas eleições para os cargos de Presidente da República, Governador do Estado ou do Distrito Federal e de Prefeito de município com mais de 200.000 (duzentos mil) eleitores

variable_text: parcela dos votos anulados em relação aos votos válidos
value_text: mais da metade dos votos válidos
measurement: votes whose annulment is ordered
consequence: If annulment reaches more than half of valid votes, other votes are considered void and new elections are set within 60 days
quote: decretação da nulidade atingir mais da metade dos votos válidos

variable_text: idade mínima para ser fiscal ou delegado de partido ou coligação
value_text: menor de 18 (dezoito) anos
measurement: age of the person
consequence: A person under 18 may not be chosen as party or coalition fiscal or delegate
quote: não poderá recair em menor de 18 (dezoito) anos

variable_text: período de vedação após cargo em comissão na administração pública da circunscrição
value_text: nos últimos dois anos que antecedem a missão

conditions: Requirements for membership of national electoral observation missions

variable_text: soma dos votos nominais de candidatos em relação ao total de votos
value_text: superior a 50% (cinquenta por cento) da votação

conditions: Votes annulled sub judice

variable_text: parcela dos votos válidos obtida pela chapa cuja votação é afetada por anulação
value_text: mais de 50% (cinquenta por cento) dos votos válidos
measurement: votes obtained by the ticket whose votes are annulled
consequence: If annulment affects a ticket with more than this share of valid votes, new elections are called immediately
conditions: Majoritarian elections
quote: a votação dada a chapa que tenha obtido mais de 50% (cinquenta por cento) dos votos válidos

variable_text: tempo entre vacância do cargo de Presidente ou Senador e o fim do mandato
value_text: a menos de 6 (seis) meses do final do mandato
measurement: time from vacancy to end of term
consequence: New elections are indirect if the vacancy occurs less than this period before the end of the term, and direct otherwise
conditions: Applies to new elections for President and Senator
quote: a menos de 6 (seis) meses do final do mandato

variable_text: parcela do Fundo Especial de Financiamento de Campanha distribuída igualitariamente entre partidos
value_text: 2% (dois por cento), divididos igualitariamente entre todos os partidos com estatutos registrados no Tribunal Superior Eleitoral

variable_text: parcela do FEFC distribuída entre partidos com representante na Câmara
value_text: 35% (trinta e cinco por cento), divididos entre os partidos que tenham pelo menos um representante na Câmara dos Deputados

conditions: Proportional to the percentage of votes in the last general election for the Câmara dos Deputados

measurement: representatives in the Câmara dos Deputados

quote: que tenham pelo menos um representante na Câmara dos Deputados

variable_text: parcela do FEFC distribuída na proporção de representantes na Câmara

quote: As doações financeiras de valor igual ou superior a R$ 2.000,00 (dois mil reais) só poderão ser realizadas mediante transferência eletrônica

value_text: para transmissão de inserções até o limite de 3 (três) minutos diários

variable_text: personas menores de dieciséis años (prohibición de registro, acceso y uso de cuentas en plataformas de redes sociales)
value_text: menores de dieciséis años
measurement: No window or aggregation stated; applies to the age of the individual user.
consequence: Registration, access and use of an account on social media platforms is prohibited for persons under 16, and platforms must delete any active account held by such a person.
conditions: Applies to social media platforms as defined in Art. 3(a) that offer or direct services to Chile, whether or not the provider is domiciled in Chile (Art. 2).
quote: Se prohíbe el registro, acceso y uso de una cuenta asociada a las plataformas de redes sociales para las personas menores de dieciséis años.

variable_text: personas menores de dieciséis años (responsabilidad de los proveedores de impedir registro, acceso y uso)
value_text: personas menores de dieciséis años
measurement: No window or aggregation stated; applies to the age of the individual user.
consequence: Digital service providers are made responsible for preventing registration, access and use by persons under 16, which triggers the sanctions of Art. 8 on non-compliance.
conditions: Applies to digital service providers as defined in Art. 3(b); Art. 7 also requires risk-mitigation measures for minor users, and the sanctions of Art. 8 apply subject to proof to the contrary.
quote: Los proveedores de servicios digitales serán responsables de impedir el registro, acceso y uso de personas menores de dieciséis años.

measurement: Look-back window measured from the date of the relevant election (or plebiscite) to the contract date; declaration made at candidate or party registration (al momento de su inscripción) before the Servicio Electoral

conditions: Applies to candidates, parties, electoral pacts and plebiscite option holders, whether the contract was entered by them or by third parties; the declaration applies regardless of how much of the spending is attributable to the campaign period.

value_text: 给予单个最高500万元资助

consequence: Approved municipal key laboratories receive up to 500万元 each.
conditions: Municipal key laboratory approved for establishment
quote: 给予单个最高500万元资助

variable_text: 奖励金额上限（重点实验室周期评估）
value_text: 评估结果为良好或优秀的，给予最高300万元奖励
measurement: periodic evaluation rating (every three years, as written)
consequence: Built municipal key laboratories rated good or excellent receive up to 300万元.
conditions: Evaluation rating of good or excellent
quote: 评估结果为良好或优秀的，给予最高300万元奖励

variable_text: 免租期限
value_text: 给予6个月至3年不等的免租优惠
consequence: Rent-free benefit lasts between 6 months and 3 years.
conditions: Eligible AI small, medium and micro enterprises and start-up enterprises at the 零租 incubators
quote: 给予6个月至3年不等的免租优惠

variable_text: 中小微企业及初创企业资格（规模标准）
value_text: 人工智能中小微企业和初创企业 (size criteria not set in this text)
consequence: Eligibility for the rent-free benefit depends on being an AI small, medium or micro enterprise or a start-up.
conditions: Must meet 符合条件 criteria; no size standard stated in this text
depends_on: 中小微企业 size standard and 符合条件 criteria are not specified in this text
quote: 对符合条件的人工智能中小微企业和初创企业

variable_text: 奖励金额（认定园区运营主体）
value_text: 对经认定的园区给予园区运营主体200万元奖励
consequence: A certified AI software park receives a 200万元 reward to its operating entity.
conditions: Park certified (经认定) as an AI software park
quote: 对经认定的园区给予园区运营主体200万元奖励

variable_text: 奖励金额（考核优秀园区）
value_text: 对考核获评优秀的园区给予50万元奖励
measurement: assessment rating
consequence: A park rated excellent in assessment receives a 50万元 reward.
conditions: Assessment rating of excellent
quote: 对考核获评优秀的园区给予50万元奖励

variable_text: 注册时间（创业资助）
value_text: 对注册时间在6－48个月内的企业
measurement: time since registration
consequence: Enterprises registered within 6 to 48 months are eligible for the one-off start-up grant.
conditions: Overseas high-level talent or AI overseas-returnee entrepreneurship; selected on merit (择优)
quote: 对注册时间在6－48个月内的企业

variable_text: 一次性创业资助金额上限
value_text: 择优给予100万元、50万元、30万元的一次性创业资助
measurement: one-off grant
consequence: One-off start-up grants are 100万元, 50万元 or 30万元, awarded on merit.
conditions: Tier amounts 100万元, 50万元 and 30万元; mapping of tiers to criteria not stated in text
quote: 择优给予100万元、50万元、30万元的一次性创业资助

variable_text: 资助比例（行业交流活动）
value_text: 对符合条件的活动，按不超过项目审定总投入的50%，给予最高300万元资助
measurement: share of approved total investment
consequence: Qualifying industry exchange and competition events receive up to 50% of approved total investment.
conditions: Activities that meet the eligibility requirements
quote: 按不超过项目审定总投入的50%，给予最高300万元资助

variable_text: 资助金额上限（行业交流活动）
value_text: 按不超过项目审定总投入的50%，给予最高300万元资助
measurement: per event, as written
consequence: Funding for a qualifying industry exchange or competition event is capped at 300万元.
conditions: Applies to the 50% approved total investment rule
quote: 按不超过项目审定总投入的50%，给予最高300万元资助

variable_text: 未满十四周岁的未成年人
value_text: 未满十四周岁
consequence: Personal data of minors under 14 is processed under the sensitive personal data rules and requires prior explicit consent of the guardian.
conditions: Applies to processing of personal data of minors under 14.
quote: 处理未满十四周岁的未成年人个人数据的，按照处理敏感个人数据的有关规定执行

variable_text: 未满十四周岁的未成年人
value_text: 未满十四周岁
consequence: Data processors may not recommend personalised products or services to minors under 14 based on user profiling.
conditions: Exception where the processing protects the minor's lawful rights and the guardian gives explicit consent (但是，为了维护其合法权益并征得其监护人明示同意的除外).
quote: 数据处理者不得基于用户画像向未满十四周岁的未成年人推荐个性化产品或者服务

variable_text: 交易金额
value_text: 交易金额一万元以上
measurement: Transaction amount of the traded data product or service; the text does not state the measurement window or method.
consequence: Higher penalty tier applies to unlawful data trading under Art. 67 (fine range stated in the same paragraph).
conditions: Applies to unlawful data trading under Art. 67; below 10,000 yuan the lower penalty tier applies.
quote: 交易金额一万元以上的，处二十万元以上一百万元以下罚款

variable_text: 数据中心整体上架率（建成投用1年以上）
value_text: 低于50%的市州
measurement: 区域内数据中心整体上架率（建成投用1年以上），按市州区域统计
consequence: In a municipality or prefecture below this rate, no new data centre cluster planning is supported.
conditions: Data centres completed and in service for more than 1 year.
quote: 区域内数据中心整体上架率（建成投用1年以上)低于50%的市州，不支持规划新的数据中心集群

variable_text: 新建大型、超大型数据中心（折合2.5kW标准机架）
value_text: 3000架及以上（折合2.5kW标准机架）
measurement: 新建数据中心的折合标准机架数
consequence: New large and very large data centres are in principle to be sited within the 甘肃枢纽 planning area.
conditions: Newly built data centres; during the 十四五 period, concentration in the 庆阳集群 is stated in the same item.
quote: 新建大型、超大型数据中心（折合2.5kW标准机架3000架及以上）原则上布局在全国一体化算力网络国家枢纽节点（甘肃）

variable_text: 电能利用效率（存量数据中心）
value_text: 电能利用效率超过1.5
measurement: 存量数据中心的电能利用效率；按谁审批、谁负责的原则落实
consequence: Existing data centres above this value are to be guided and urged to undertake energy-saving and carbon-reduction retrofits.
conditions: Applies together with low utilisation, high energy consumption or poor returns, as listed in the same clause.
quote: 引导督促利用率低、能耗高、效益差以及电能利用效率超过1.5的存量数据中心进行节能降碳改造

variable_text: 土地出让底价（相对全国工业用地出让最低价标准的比例）
value_text: 不低于所在地土地等别相对应《全国工业用地出让最低价标准》的70%
measurement: 确定土地出让底价时，相对所在地土地等别对应的全国工业用地出让最低价标准
consequence: Land sale floor price may be set at 70% of the national minimum standard for eligible industrial projects, but not below actual total costs.
conditions: Priority industries in Gansu with land-intensive industrial projects; applies to land in the 庆阳集群; price not below actual total costs.
quote: 可按不低于所在地土地等别相对应《全国工业用地出让最低价标准》的70%执行

variable_text: 主营业务收入占企业收入总额
value_text: 60%以上
measurement: 企业收入总额中主营业务收入的占比；计量期间未作规定
consequence: Eligible for a 15% enterprise income tax rate and a 50% reduction in listed local taxes and fees for the period stated.
conditions: Big data enterprise in the 庆阳集群; main business is an industry project in the 《西部地区鼓励类产业目录》.
quote: 其主营业务收入占企业收入总额60%以上

variable_text: 包容期（新设立的新业态、新模式、新产业企业）
value_text: 2年包容期
measurement: 自企业新设立起计算的包容期
consequence: Newly established new-format enterprises receive a 2-year inclusive period, supervised mainly through administrative guidance.
conditions: Newly established enterprises in new business forms, new models and new industries.
quote: 对新设立的新业态、新模式、新产业企业给予2年包容期

variable_text: 注册用户达到5000万以上
value_text: 注册用户达到5000万以上

consequence: Platform is a 大型互联网平台 and the duties in Art. 54 apply to it
conditions: Alternative prong: monthly active users of 1000万 or more (see following row)

variable_text: 月活跃用户1000万以上
value_text: 月活跃用户1000万以上
measurement: Monthly active users of the platform; no measurement window stated
consequence: Platform is a 大型互联网平台 and the duties in Art. 54 apply to it
conditions: Alternative prong: registered users of 5000万 or more (see preceding row); the platform must also have complex business types and significant influence on the economy, network order or user rights
quote: 月活跃用户1000万以上

variable_text: 连续未开展相关电信业务的期限
value_text: 连续2年未开展相关电信业务
measurement: Continuous period without carrying on the relevant telecom business; the text does not specify how it is measured
consequence: The telecom authority that granted the licence cancels the relevant telecom business operating licence
conditions: Alternative: the provider no longer meets the conditions for the telecom business operating licence
quote: 连续2年未开展相关电信业务
