value_text: 超过6个月不登录、不使用
measurement: Period of non-login and non-use of an internet account; the text does not specify the measurement method
consequence: Internet information service provider must take reminder, suspension, restriction or prohibition measures on posting and related functions, up to account closure, under its agreements
conditions: Alternative: the account's identity information does not match the user's real identity; the provider is to run a dynamic verification system for existing accounts
quote: 超过6个月不登录、不使用的互联网账号

variable_text: 违法所得
value_text: 违法所得不足5万元
measurement: Illegal income from the unlicensed telecom business
consequence: Where there is no illegal income or illegal income is below this amount, a fine of 10万元 to 100万元 applies instead of the income-based fine
conditions: Applies to unlicensed or out-of-scope telecom business under Art. 9; the fine is in addition to confiscation of illegal income
quote: 没有违法所得或者违法所得不足5万元的

variable_text: 违法所得1万元以上
value_text: 违法所得1万元以上
measurement: Illegal income from unlicensed internet information service under Art. 11
consequence: Where illegal income reaches this amount, a fine of 5 to 10 times the illegal income may be added; below it, a fine of 1万元 to 10万元 may be imposed instead
conditions: Applies to unlicensed provision of internet information services in the fields listed in Art. 11; confiscation of illegal income applies in all cases
quote: 违法所得1万元以上的，并处违法所得5倍以上10倍以下罚款

variable_text: 具有较大影响力的互联网用户公众账号认定标准
value_text: 具体认定办法，由国家网信部门会同国家新闻出版和国务院文化和旅游、广播电视、公安等有关主管部门制定
measurement: Criteria (audience size, views, shares, comments, prior-year revenue or influence in a field) to be specified by the implementing measures
consequence: Determines which accounts are treated as having greater influence, and so are subject to Art. 45 and Art. 46 duties
conditions: Applies only to accounts whose operators are within the definition in Art. 90 item (5); criteria to be set by the delegated measures
depends_on: Implementing measures (具体认定办法) to be formulated by 国家网信部门 together with 国家新闻出版 and 国务院文化和旅游、广播电视、公安等有关主管部门
quote: 前款所称的具有较大影响力的互联网用户公众账号的具体认定办法，由国家网信部门会同国家新闻出版和国务院文化和旅游、广播电视、公安等有关主管部门制定

variable_text: 处理自然人个人信息的人数
value_text: 1000万人以上
measurement: Number of natural persons whose personal information is processed; window and measuring party not stated
consequence: One of three criteria to be considered together when designating a large personal information handler
conditions: Considered together with item (二) (important network services or multi-business operations involving personal information) and item (三) (important impact on national security, economy, social stability, public health and safety)
quote: 处理1000万人以上自然人个人信息

variable_text: 处理自然人个人信息的人数
value_text: 处理1000万人以上自然人个人信息
measurement: Number of natural persons whose personal information is processed; window and measuring party not stated
consequence: Handler must apply through its provincial cyberspace authority for designation as a large personal information handler
conditions: Also applies to handlers that self-assess as meeting Art. 2(2) items (二) and (三)
quote: 处理1000万人以上自然人个人信息和自评估认为符合本规定第二条第二款第二项、第三项条件的个人信息处理者，应当通过所在地省级网信部门向国家网信部门申报

variable_text: 连续不再符合认定条件的时长
value_text: 连续6个月不再符合认定条件
measurement: Consecutive months in which the designated handler considers itself no longer meeting designation criteria; self-assessed
consequence: Designated handler may apply through its provincial cyberspace authority to change its designation
conditions: Applies only to a designated large handler that considers itself no longer meeting the criteria
quote: 认为其已连续6个月不再符合认定条件

variable_text: 未成年人年龄
value_text: 不满十四周岁未成年人
measurement: Age of the minor whose personal information is processed; method of verification not stated
consequence: Parental or guardian consent is required to process personal information of minors under 14
conditions: Applies to processing by large personal information handlers
quote: 处理不满十四周岁未成年人个人信息的，应当取得未成年人的父母或者其他监护人的同意

variable_text: 未成年人年龄
value_text: 不满十四周岁
measurement: Age of the minor; method of verification not stated
consequence: Personal information protection officer must organise specific personal information processing rules for minors under 14
conditions: Duty listed among the personal information protection officer's duties under Art. 26
quote: 组织针对不满十四周岁未成年人制定专门的个人信息处理规则

variable_text: 未成年人年龄
value_text: 已满十四周岁不满十八周岁
measurement: Age of the minor; method of verification not stated
consequence: Targeted personal information protection measures required for minors aged 14 to under 18
conditions: Duty listed among the personal information protection officer's duties under Art. 26
quote: 对已满十四周岁不满十八周岁未成年人采取针对性个人信息保护措施

variable_text: 监督委员会成员人数
value_text: 不少于7名
measurement: Number of members of the supervisory committee
consequence: Supervisory committee must have at least seven members
conditions: Number of members must be odd and match business scale and user numbers
quote: 不少于7名

variable_text: 外部成员占监督委员会成员的比例
value_text: 不低于三分之二
measurement: Share of external members among committee members
consequence: External members must make up at least two-thirds of the supervisory committee
conditions: Applies to the supervisory committee that a large handler must establish within six months of designation
quote: 外部成员占比不低于三分之二

variable_text: 同时受聘的大型个人信息处理者数量
value_text: 同时受聘的大型个人信息处理者不超过3家
measurement: Number of large handlers at which the person is concurrently engaged as external member
consequence: A person may serve as external member only if concurrently engaged by at most three large handlers
conditions: Eligibility condition for external members under Art. 38
quote: 同时受聘的大型个人信息处理者不超过3家

variable_text: 个人信息保护相关工作年限
value_text: 从事个人信息保护相关工作不少于3年
measurement: Years of personal information protection work by the candidate
consequence: Required minimum experience in personal information protection work for external members
conditions: Also requires compliance audit capability and knowledge of relevant laws and standards
quote: 从事个人信息保护相关工作不少于3年

variable_text: 持有受聘大型个人信息处理者的已发行股份比例
value_text: 已发行股份百分之一以上
measurement: Direct or indirect holding of issued shares of the engaging handler, within the most recent year
consequence: A person holding at least this share cannot serve as external member
conditions: Lookback period is the most recent year (最近一年内); applies to the person and close relatives as stated in the provision
quote: 直接或间接持有受聘大型个人信息处理者已发行股份百分之一以上

variable_text: 受聘大型个人信息处理者股东排名
value_text: 前十名股东中的自然人股东
measurement: Ranking of shareholders of the engaging handler
consequence: A natural-person shareholder ranked in the top ten cannot serve as external member
conditions: Lookback period is the most recent year (最近一年内)
quote: 受聘大型个人信息处理者前十名股东中的自然人股东

variable_text: 股东单位持有受聘大型个人信息处理者的已发行股份比例
value_text: 已发行股份百分之五以上的股东单位
measurement: Direct or indirect holding of issued shares of the engaging handler by the shareholder unit
consequence: Employees of a shareholder unit holding at least this share cannot serve as external member
conditions: Lookback period is the most recent year (最近一年内); applies to employees of such unit and their close relatives
quote: 直接或间接持有受聘大型个人信息处理者已发行股份百分之五以上的股东单位

variable_text: 受聘大型个人信息处理者股东单位排名
value_text: 前五名股东单位
measurement: Ranking of shareholder units of the engaging handler
consequence: A person employed by a top-five shareholder unit cannot serve as external member
conditions: Lookback period is the most recent year (最近一年内)
quote: 在受聘大型个人信息处理者前五名股东单位任职的人员

variable_text: 连续未出席监督委员会会议次数
value_text: 连续两次未出席监督委员会会议
measurement: Consecutive absences from committee meetings
consequence: External member is to be dismissed through the handler's procedure
conditions: Meetings include regular and extraordinary meetings; grounds listed in guideline item 6(2)
provision: 工作规则制定指引 六（二）
quote: 连续两次未出席监督委员会会议

variable_text: 提议临时会议的成员比例
value_text: 三分之一以上成员
measurement: Share of committee members proposing an extraordinary meeting
consequence: Extraordinary meeting may be convened on this proposal where evidence of unlawful processing exists
conditions: Requires evidence that the handler's processing activities involve illegal conduct
provision: 工作规则制定指引 十一
quote: 经监督委员会三分之一以上成员提议

variable_text: 出席监督委员会会议的成员比例
value_text: 过半数成员出席
measurement: Share of committee members attending a meeting
consequence: A committee meeting may be held only if more than half of members attend
conditions: Members unable to attend may appoint another member to vote by written proxy
provision: 工作规则制定指引 十二
quote: 监督委员会会议有过半数成员出席方可召开

variable_text: 同意履行职责方式的成员比例（全体成员）
value_text: 经全体成员过半数同意
measurement: Share of all committee members consenting
consequence: Member actions under modes (一) and (二) of guideline item 10 require consent of more than half of all members
conditions: Modes (一) and (二) are proposing agenda items and making inquiries to the handler
provision: 工作规则制定指引 十
quote: 应当经全体成员过半数同意

variable_text: 会议决议的同意比例（全体成员）
value_text: 全体成员三分之二以上同意
measurement: Share of all committee members consenting to a resolution
consequence: Committee resolution requires consent of two-thirds or more of all members
conditions: Dissenting opinions must be recorded in the resolution
provision: 工作规则制定指引 十三
quote: 会议决议应当取得全体成员三分之二以上同意

variable_text: 主要股东持有大型个人信息处理者的股份比例
value_text: 持有大型个人信息处理者百分之五以上股份
measurement: Shareholding in the large handler
consequence: Defines main shareholder for guideline purposes; external members may not obtain other benefits from main shareholders
conditions: Alternatively, holding under 5% but with major influence on the handler also qualifies
provision: 工作规则制定指引 十五
quote: 主要股东，是指持有大型个人信息处理者百分之五以上股份

variable_text: 年龄（周岁）：未满十六周岁

consequence: Providers may not provide online live-streaming publishing services to minors under 16 (Art. 4 item (4)).

variable_text: 年龄（周岁）：未满十六周岁

measurement: not specified in text
consequence: Providers offering the listed network services to minors under 16 must provide them through minor mode (未成年人模式).
conditions: Applies to the service types listed in Art. 5 items (1) to (4).
quote: 向未满十六周岁的未成年人提供下列网络服务的，应当通过未成年人模式提供

variable_text: 附件1第一部分所列物项占境外制造的附件1第二部分所列物项的价值比例 (value share of Annex 1 Part 1 items within overseas-manufactured Annex 1 Part 2 items)

unit: percent of monthly legal minimum wage
measurement: amount of the overdue obligation; the text does not state the measurement method
consequence: Negative data may be reported only after at least two communications on different days, with 20 calendar days between the last communication and the report
conditions: Applies to obligations already in arrears (constituidas en mora)
quote: En las obligaciones inferiores o iguales al (15%) de un (1) salario mínimo legal mensual vigente

variable_text: tamaño empresarial (micro, pequeña, mediana o gran empresa)
value_text: micro, pequeña, mediana o gran empresa, de acuerdo con la normativa vigente
measurement: not stated in this text
consequence: Size is one factor for the proportionate measures that operators, sources and users must be able to demonstrate
conditions: Considered together with the legal nature of the entity, the nature of the data, the type of processing and the potential risks to data subjects
depends_on: normativa vigente (size classes defined outside this text)
quote: teniendo en cuenta si se trata de una micro, pequeña, mediana o gran empresa, de acuerdo con la normativa vigente

variable_text: permanencia de información negativa de titulares al día: un año
value_text: por lo menos un año contado a partir de la cancelación de las obligaciones
measurement: counted from cancellation of the reported obligations
consequence: Immediate expiry (caducidad inmediata) of the negative information
conditions: Applies to holders who were up to date on the reported obligations on the date this law entered into force
quote: serán beneficiarios de la caducidad inmediata de la información negativa

variable_text: permanencia de información negativa tras cancelación dentro de seis meses: un año
value_text: por el término de un (1) año, contado a partir de la fecha de cancelación de tales obligaciones
measurement: counted from the date of cancellation of the obligations
consequence: Negative information remains for one year from cancellation and must then be removed automatically
conditions: Applies to holders who cancel reported obligations within six months after this law enters into force
quote: permanecerán con dicha información negativa en los bancos de datos por el término de un (1) año

variable_text: cuantía de la conducta de transferencia no consentida de activos (Art. 269J)
value_text: una cuantía superior a 200 salarios mínimos legales mensuales
measurement: Amount of the conduct described in the two preceding paragraphs of Art. 269J; the text states no measurement window and does not say who measures it
consequence: The penalty set in the preceding paragraph is increased by half.
conditions: Conduct described in the two preceding paragraphs of Art. 269J (non-consented transfer of assets by computer manipulation, or making or facilitating a computer program for that offence or for fraud).
quote: Si la conducta descrita en los dos incisos anteriores tuviere una cuantía superior a 200 salarios mínimos legales mensuales, la sanción allí señalada se incrementará en la mitad.

variable_text: menor (minor) for child pornography offences: person under 18 years
value_text: toda persona menor de dieciocho años
measurement: age of the depicted person; not specified in text
consequence: Depicted persons under 18 are minors for the child pornography offences in Art. 9, unless a Party sets a lower age limit under Art. 9(3).
conditions: Applies by default; a Party may set a lower age limit, which must be at least 16 years.
quote: toda persona menor de dieciocho años

variable_text: lower age limit that a Party may set for minors in Art. 9, floor of 16 years
value_text: que será como mínimo de dieciséis años
measurement: age of the depicted person; not specified in text
consequence: A Party that sets a lower age limit for minors in Art. 9 may not set it below 16 years.
conditions: Applies only where a Party chooses to set a lower age limit under Art. 9(3).
quote: que será como mínimo de dieciséis años

variable_text: maximum term of deprivation of liberty of the offence, for extradition eligibility under the Convention
value_text: con una pena privativa de libertad de una duración máxima de como mínimo un año
measurement: maximum penalty under the law of both requesting and requested Parties; not specified in text
consequence: Offences in Arts. 2 to 11 are extraditable between Parties only if punishable in both Parties' laws with at least this maximum term of deprivation of liberty, or a heavier penalty.
conditions: Offence must be punishable under the law of both Parties; applies to offences established under Arts. 2 to 11.
quote: con una pena privativa de libertad de una duración máxima de como mínimo un año

variable_text: number of items (devices, passwords or similar data) possessed, required by a Party for criminal liability under Art. 6(1)(b)
value_text: Cualquier Parte podrá exigir en su derecho interno que se posea un número determinado de dichos elementos para que se considere que existe responsabilidad penal.
measurement: number of items possessed with intent to commit offences in Arts. 2 to 5; not specified in text
consequence: Possession of the specified number of items with intent to commit offences in Arts. 2 to 5 is criminal under a Party's law once the number set in national law is reached.
conditions: Applies only where a Party makes use of this option; possession must be with intent to commit offences in Arts. 2 to 5.
depends_on: national law of each Party (number set under Art. 6(1)(b))
quote: Cualquier Parte podrá exigir en su derecho interno que se posea un número determinado de dichos elementos

variable_text: maximum term of a fixed-term employment contract
value_text: un término no mayor a cuatro (4) años
measurement: term of a fixed-term employment contract agreed in writing
consequence: Fixed-term contracts may not exceed this maximum; for existing contracts the limit is counted from the law's entry into force.
conditions: Fixed-term employment contracts under amended CST Art. 46, num. 1
quote: Podrán celebrarse contratos de trabajo a término fijo por un término no mayor a cuatro (4) años.

variable_text: number of extensions (prórrogas) of a fixed-term contract shorter than one year
value_text: después de la cuarta prórroga
measurement: count of agreed extensions of the contract
consequence: After the fourth extension, the contract may not be renewed for a period shorter than one year.
conditions: Applies to contracts concluded for a term shorter than one (1) year
quote: sin embargo, después de la cuarta prórroga, el contrato no podrá renovarse por un período inferior a un (1) año.

variable_text: trabajadores of micro and small enterprises (fewer than ten workers)
value_text: micro y pequeñas empresas de menos de diez (10) trabajadores
measurement: number of workers of the employer
consequence: The full disciplinary procedure in Art. 115 does not apply; the employer only has to hear the worker beforehand.
conditions: Also excludes domestic workers (trabajadores del hogar)
depends_on: Decreto 957 de 2019 (micro and small enterprise definition)
quote: ni a las micro y pequeñas empresas de menos de diez (10) trabajadores

variable_text: time of day defining daytime (diurno) and night work (nocturno)
value_text: entre las seis horas (6:00 a. m.) y las diecinueve horas (7:00 p. m.)
measurement: clock time of the work period
consequence: Work outside the 6:00 to 19:00 daytime period is night work, which entitles the worker to a night surcharge (recargo nocturno).
conditions: Amended CST Art. 160; night surcharge referred to in amended CST Art. 161
quote: Trabajo diurno es el que se realiza en el período comprendido entre las seis horas (6:00 a. m.) y las diecinueve horas (7:00 p. m.).

variable_text: duración máxima de la jornada ordinaria de trabajo (daily)
value_text: ocho (8) horas al día
measurement: hours of the ordinary working day
consequence: Maximum daily ordinary working day.
conditions: Without prejudice to the gradual application under Ley 2101 de 2021, Art. 3
quote: La duración máxima de la jornada ordinaria de trabajo es de ocho (8) horas al día

variable_text: jornada máxima semanal (weekly)
value_text: una jornada máxima de cuarenta y dos (42) horas a la semana
measurement: hours of the ordinary working week
consequence: Maximum weekly ordinary working hours.
conditions: Weekly distribution over five to six days may be agreed between employer and worker
quote: una jornada máxima de cuarenta y dos (42) horas a la semana

variable_text: daily hours in a flexible daily schedule
value_text: mínimo cuatro (4) horas continuas y máximo hasta nueve (9) horas diarias
measurement: daily hours within a week averaging up to 42 hours
consequence: Within this range and the 42-hour weekly average, no overtime surcharge is payable.
conditions: Agreed between employer and worker; maximum six days a week with a mandatory rest day
quote: teniendo como mínimo cuatro (4) horas continuas y máximo hasta nueve (9) horas diarias

variable_text: age of minors authorized to work (15 to 17 years)
value_text: entre los 15 y los 17 años
measurement: age of the minor
consequence: Minors in this age range may work only subject to the daytime and hour limits in the same provision.
conditions: Minors authorized to work
provision: Art. 11, exception c), num. 1 (replaces CST Art. 161)
quote: Los menores de edad entre los 15 y los 17 años, solo podrán trabajar en jornada diurna máxima de seis (6) horas diarias y treinta (30) horas a la semana.

variable_text: daily maximum for minors aged 15 to 17 (daytime only)
value_text: jornada diurna máxima de seis (6) horas diarias
measurement: hours of daytime work per day
consequence: Daily maximum working time for minors aged 15 to 17.
conditions: Minors aged 15 to 17 years
provision: Art. 11, exception c), num. 1 (replaces CST Art. 161)
quote: solo podrán trabajar en jornada diurna máxima de seis (6) horas diarias y treinta (30) horas a la semana

variable_text: daily maximum for minors over 17 years
value_text: una jornada máxima de ocho (8) horas diarias
measurement: hours of work per day
consequence: Daily maximum working time for minors older than 17.
conditions: Minors older than seventeen (17) years
provision: Art. 11, exception c), num. 2 (replaces CST Art. 161)
quote: solo podrán trabajar en una jornada máxima de ocho (8) horas diarias y cuarenta (40) horas a la semana

variable_text: maximum length of a successive-shift turn
value_text: el respectivo turno no exceda de seis (6) horas al día
measurement: length of a shift in a continuous-operation arrangement
consequence: Where shifts stay within this limit, no night surcharge or Sunday/holiday surcharge applies; the worker receives the ordinary wage and one paid rest day.
conditions: Agreed between employer and worker for successive shifts running all days of the week
quote: siempre y cuando el respectivo turno no exceda de seis (6) horas al día y treinta y seis (36) a la semana.

variable_text: number of shifts worked on the same day
value_text: dos turnos en el mismo día
measurement: shifts assigned to one worker on one day
consequence: The employer may not employ a worker for two shifts on the same day, even with the worker's consent.
conditions: Except supervision, management, trust or handling roles (labores de supervisión, dirección, confianza o manejo)
quote: no podrá, aún con el consentimiento del trabajador o trabajadora, contratarla para la ejecución de dos turnos en el mismo día

variable_text: maximum daily overtime hours
value_text: no exceder de dos (2) horas diarias
measurement: overtime hours (diurnas or nocturnas) per day
consequence: Overtime may not exceed two hours per day.
conditions: Exception for security sector (Ley 1920 de 2018) and health sector
quote: En ningún caso las horas extras de trabajo, diurnas o nocturnas, podrán exceder de dos (2) horas diarias y doce (12) semanales.

variable_text: surcharge for work on a mandatory rest day (recargo)
value_text: recargo del ciento por ciento (100%) sobre el salario ordinario
measurement: surcharge applied proportionally to hours worked
consequence: Work on a mandatory rest day is paid with a 100% surcharge, subject to the transitional schedule.
conditions: Full application from 1 July 2027 under the transitional paragraph; employer may apply the transitional schedule
quote: se remunera con un recargo del ciento por ciento (100%) sobre el salario ordinario

variable_text: transitional surcharge for work on a mandatory rest day (80%)
measurement: surcharge applied proportionally to hours worked
consequence: Surcharge for rest-day work increases to 80% from 1 July 2025.
conditions: Gradual implementation by the employer under the transitional paragraph
quote: A partir del primero de julio de 2025, se incrementará el recargo por laborar en día de descanso obligatorio a 80%.

variable_text: transitional surcharge for work on a mandatory rest day (90%)
measurement: surcharge applied proportionally to hours worked
consequence: Surcharge for rest-day work increases to 90% from 1 July 2026.
conditions: Gradual implementation by the employer under the transitional paragraph
quote: A partir del primero de julio de 2026, se incrementará el recargo por laborar en día de descanso obligatorio a 90%.

variable_text: rest-day work classified as occasional
value_text: hasta dos (2) días de descanso obligatorio, durante el mes calendario
measurement: count of mandatory rest days worked in a calendar month
consequence: Work on mandatory rest days up to two per calendar month is classified as occasional.
quote: Se entiende que el trabajo en día de descanso obligatorio es ocasional cuando el trabajador o trabajadora labora hasta dos (2) días de descanso obligatorio, durante el mes calendario.

variable_text: rest-day work classified as habitual
value_text: tres (3) o más de estos durante el mes calendario
measurement: count of mandatory rest days worked in a calendar month
consequence: Work on three or more mandatory rest days in a calendar month is classified as habitual.
quote: Se entiende que el trabajo en día de descanso es habitual cuando el trabajador o trabajadora labore tres (3) o más de estos durante el mes calendario.

variable_text: employers with up to 500 workers (disability employment quota)
value_text: hasta 500 trabajadores
measurement: total of permanent workers
consequence: Employer must hire or keep at least two workers with disability per 100 workers.
conditions: Certification of disability as provided by the Ministerio de Salud y Protección Social; reporting within fifteen days
quote: Las empresas que cuenten con hasta 500 trabajadores deberán contratar o mantener contratados, según corresponda, al menos dos (2) trabajadores con discapacidad por cada 100 trabajadores.

variable_text: employers with 501 or more workers (disability employment quota)
value_text: A partir de 501 trabajadores en adelante
measurement: total of permanent workers
consequence: Employer must hire or keep at least one additional worker with disability for each tranche of 100 workers.
conditions: Applies to the total of permanent workers
quote: A partir de 501 trabajadores en adelante, deberán contratar o mantener contratados, según corresponda, al menos un (1) trabajador con discapacidad adicional por cada tramo de 100 trabajadores.

variable_text: first year of the disability employment quota (optional)
value_text: optativa en el primer año de entrada en vigencia de la presente ley
measurement: years from entry into force of the law
consequence: Application of the disability quota is optional in the first year and mandatory from the second year.
conditions: Employers begin a technical review plan for reasonable adjustments during the first year
quote: será optativa en el primer año de entrada en vigencia de la presente ley

variable_text: paid rest day per six months of work (bicycle commuting)
value_text: un (1) día de descanso remunerado por cada seis (6) meses de trabajo
measurement: months of work with the employer
consequence: One paid rest day per six months of work may be agreed where the worker certifies bicycle use for commuting.
conditions: Agreed with the employer; certification of bicycle use as transport to and from work
quote: un (1) día de descanso remunerado por cada seis (6) meses de trabajo

variable_text: maximum duration of an apprenticeship contract
value_text: por cualquier tiempo determinado no superior a tres (3) años
measurement: fixed term of the apprenticeship contract
consequence: Apprenticeship contract has a fixed term not exceeding three years.
conditions: Contrato de aprendizaje as defined in amended CST Art. 81
quote: por cualquier tiempo determinado no superior a tres (3) años

variable_text: minimum monthly support for apprentices, dual training, first year
value_text: como mínimo durante el primer año el equivalente al setenta y cinco por ciento (75%) de un (1) salario mínimo legal mensual vigente
measurement: monthly support paid during the contract
consequence: Minimum monthly apprenticeship support in the first year of dual training.
conditions: Formación dual (dual training) as defined in Art. 21, par. 2
provision: Art. 21, lit. d), num. 1 (replaces CST Art. 81)
quote: recibirá como mínimo durante el primer año el equivalente al setenta y cinco por ciento (75%) de un (1) salario mínimo legal mensual vigente

variable_text: minimum monthly support for apprentices, dual training, second year
value_text: durante el segundo año el equivalente al cien por ciento (100%) de un (1) salario mínimo legal mensual vigente
measurement: monthly support paid during the contract
consequence: Minimum monthly apprenticeship support in the second year of dual training.
conditions: Formación dual (dual training) as defined in Art. 21, par. 2
provision: Art. 21, lit. d), num. 1 (replaces CST Art. 81)
quote: durante el segundo año el equivalente al cien por ciento (100%) de un (1) salario mínimo legal mensual vigente

variable_text: minimum monthly support for apprentices, traditional training, theory phase
value_text: en la fase lectiva el equivalente al setenta y cinco por ciento (75%) de un (1) salario mínimo mensual vigente
measurement: monthly support paid during the contract
consequence: Minimum monthly apprenticeship support during the theory phase of traditional training.
conditions: Formación tradicional (traditional training)
provision: Art. 21, lit. d), num. 2 (replaces CST Art. 81)
quote: en la fase lectiva el equivalente al setenta y cinco por ciento (75%) de un (1) salario mínimo mensual vigente

variable_text: minimum monthly support for apprentices, traditional training, practical phase
value_text: en la parte práctica, el apoyo del sostenimiento será equivalente al cien por ciento (100%) de un salario mínimo mensual legal vigente
measurement: monthly support paid during the contract
consequence: Minimum monthly apprenticeship support during the practical phase of traditional training.
conditions: Formación tradicional (traditional training)
provision: Art. 21, lit. d), num. 2 (replaces CST Art. 81)
quote: en la parte práctica, el apoyo del sostenimiento será equivalente al cien por ciento (100%) de un salario mínimo mensual legal vigente

variable_text: minimum monthly support for university-student apprentices
value_text: no podrá ser inferior al equivalente a un (1) salario mínimo legal vigente
measurement: monthly support paid during the contract
consequence: Monthly apprenticeship support for university-student apprentices may not be below one minimum monthly legal wage.
conditions: Applies whether or not the training is dual
quote: el apoyo de sostenimiento mensual no podrá ser inferior al equivalente a un (1) salario mínimo legal vigente

variable_text: weekly activity hours of university-student apprentices
value_text: cumpla con actividades de 24 horas semanales en la empresa
measurement: weekly hours of activity in the company
consequence: Apprenticeship contract may cover university students whose activity in the company is 24 hours weekly.
conditions: Activity must relate to the student's academic training
quote: cumpla con actividades de 24 horas semanales en la empresa

variable_text: minimum monthly remuneration for medical interns
value_text: no podrá ser inferior a un salario mínimo
measurement: monthly remuneration during the compulsory rotating internship
consequence: Medical interns receive monthly remuneration of at least one minimum wage during the internship.
conditions: Students meeting admission requirements for the compulsory medical internship (Ley 14 de 1962)
quote: recibirán remuneración mensual que no podrá ser inferior a un salario mínimo

variable_text: payment to SENA per apprentice not hired (monetization of apprenticeship quota)
value_text: un valor mensual que corresponderá a uno punto cinco (1,5) salario mínimo legal mensual vigente (SMLMV)
unit: SMLMV per apprentice not hired per month
measurement: monthly payment per apprentice not hired
consequence: Employers obliged to meet the apprenticeship quota must pay SENA this monthly amount for each apprentice they do not hire.
conditions: Partial monetization is proportional to the number of apprentices not hired
quote: un valor mensual que corresponderá a uno punto cinco (1,5) salario mínimo legal mensual vigente (SMLMV)

variable_text: maximum monthly SENA support per apprentice
value_text: hasta un (1) Salario Mínimo Legal Mensual Vigente (SMLMV), por mes
measurement: monthly amount of support to apprentices
consequence: SENA support to apprentices from monetization revenue is capped at one SMLMV per month.
conditions: Priority to apprentices in extreme poverty, moderate poverty and vulnerability
quote: Estos apoyos serán de hasta un (1) Salario Mínimo Legal Mensual Vigente (SMLMV), por mes.

variable_text: monthly income below the daily minimum wage (independent delivery workers)
value_text: ingresos inferiores al salario mínimo diario
measurement: monthly income of the independent or autonomous delivery worker
consequence: The contribution form for these workers is to be set by regulation.
conditions: Independent and autonomous workers in delivery services; provisions in Arts. 24–29 enter into force only as set in Art. 24 and Art. 67
depends_on: Ministerio del Trabajo y Ministerio de Salud y Protección Social (regulation)
quote: que mensualmente generen ingresos inferiores al salario mínimo diario

variable_text: número de empleados de la empresa beneficiaria al momento de la postulación
value_text: hasta 50 empleados al momento de la postulación
measurement: headcount at the time of application to CREA EMPLEO
consequence: Firm with up to 50 employees may be a beneficiary of the CREA EMPLEO benefit
conditions: Alternative route for larger firms: sales growth at or below IPC (separate row)
quote: Podrán ser beneficiarias aquellas Empresas con hasta 50 empleados al momento de la postulación

variable_text: crecimiento en ventas comparando los dos últimos años
value_text: inferior o igual al IPC
measurement: sales growth comparing the last two years
consequence: Firms with more employees than the 50-employee limit may be beneficiaries if sales growth is at or below IPC
conditions: Applies to firms with more employees than the 50-employee limit
depends_on: IPC
quote: empresas con más empleados cuyo crecimiento en ventas comparando los dos últimos años sea inferior o igual al IPC

variable_text: ingreso base de cotización del trabajador dependiente
value_text: al menos un salario mínimo legal mensual vigente (SMLMV)
measurement: contribution base in PILA for the full month
consequence: Dependent worker counts as eligible for the CREA EMPLEO benefit
conditions: Full-month PILA contributions, RUAF affiliation and contributions to all subsystems
quote: con un ingreso base de cotización de al menos un salario mínimo legal mensual vigente (SMLMV)

variable_text: días de novedad SLN registrados en el mes de solicitud
value_text: superior a 15 días en el mes de solicitud
measurement: novedad SLN in the month of application
consequence: Benefit not applied to that employee
quote: No se aplicará el beneficio a empleados con novedad SLN superior a 15 días en el mes de solicitud

variable_text: edad de la persona contratada
value_text: personas mayores de 50 años
consequence: Persons over 50 are among the groups for whom new jobs qualify for CREA EMPLEO
conditions: Listed together with women and young persons
quote: personas mayores de 50 años

variable_text: duración del beneficio por cada nuevo empleo
value_text: por un máximo de seis (6) meses por cada nuevo empleo
consequence: CREA EMPLEO payment per new job lasts at most six months
conditions: Monthly payment only while the DANE unemployment condition holds
quote: se otorgará por un máximo de seis (6) meses por cada nuevo empleo

variable_text: tasa de desempleo certificada por el DANE frente al promedio OCDE
value_text: superior al promedio de la tasa de desempleo en países OCDE
measurement: DANE certified unemployment rate
consequence: CREA EMPLEO benefit paid only while the condition holds
depends_on: promedio de la tasa de desempleo en países OCDE
quote: mientras la tasa de desempleo certificada por el DANE sea superior al promedio de la tasa de desempleo en países OCDE

variable_text: monto del beneficio por cada nuevo empleo
value_text: hasta el 25% de un salario mínimo legal mensual vigente por cada nuevo empleo
consequence: Benefit per new job is capped at 25% of SMLMV
conditions: Subject to budget availability
quote: será de hasta el 25% de un salario mínimo legal mensual vigente por cada nuevo empleo

variable_text: tamaño de microempresa
value_text: definida de acuerdo con el Decreto 957 de 2019
consequence: Defines the microenterprises that may use part-time social security contributions
depends_on: Decreto 957 de 2019 (or the norma that replaces or modifies it)
quote: Se entenderá por microempresa aquella definida de acuerdo con el Decreto 957 de 2019 o la norma que lo sustituya o modifique.

variable_text: periodo de pago a seguridad social de los trabajadores de la microempresa
value_text: en periodo superior a seis (6) meses
measurement: period of demonstrated social security payments
consequence: Eligibility for the incentive program for access to credit
conditions: Microenterprise must demonstrate social security payments for its workers
quote: que demuestren el pago a seguridad social de sus trabajadores y trabajadoras en periodo superior a seis (6) meses

variable_text: ingresos mensuales de microempresas, hogares e independientes
value_text: aun cuando estos ingresos sean inferiores al salario mínimo legal mensual vigente
measurement: monthly income
consequence: Proportional contributions allowed even when monthly income is below SMLMV
conditions: Applies to microenterprises, households and independent workers
quote: aun cuando estos ingresos sean inferiores al salario mínimo legal mensual vigente

variable_text: remuneración del teletrabajador
value_text: que devenguen menos de dos (2) salarios mínimos legales mensuales vigentes
consequence: Teleworkers earning below two SMLMV receive the connectivity allowance in place of the transport allowance
conditions: Only one of the connectivity or transport allowance per teleworker
quote: para teletrabajadores y teletrabajadoras que devenguen menos de dos (2) salarios mínimos legales mensuales vigentes

variable_text: base de liquidación de prestaciones sociales del auxilio de conectividad
value_text: hasta dos (2) salarios mínimos legales mensuales vigentes
consequence: Connectivity allowance counts as base for calculating social benefits for these workers
conditions: Connectivity allowance is not constitutive of salary
quote: para aquellos trabajadores que devenguen hasta dos (2) salarios mínimos legales mensuales vigentes

variable_text: plazo de permanencia en el régimen subsidiado de salud
value_text: por un plazo de 6 meses
consequence: Formalized dependent workers in poverty or vulnerability may remain in the subsidized health regime for six months
conditions: Population in extreme poverty, moderate poverty and vulnerability as focalized by the national government
quote: podrán permanecer en el régimen subsidiado de salud por un plazo de 6 meses

variable_text: menores de 18 años
value_text: menores de 18 años
consequence: Privacy and personal data protection of persons under 18 must be respected by the monitoring and evaluation system for child protection in digital environments.
quote: respeten los derechos de privacidad y protección de datos personales de los menores de 18 años

variable_text: Arbeitnehmer in Betrieben (employees in establishments; works council may demand guidelines)
value_text: In Betrieben mit mehr als 500 Arbeitnehmern
measurement: Not specified in the provision; the counting method and reference date are not stated.
consequence: The works council may demand that guidelines on the professional and personal requirements and social aspects to be observed in measures under § 95(1) sentence 1 be drawn up; failing agreement, the conciliation committee decides.
conditions: Applies to measures under § 95(1) sentence 1 (hiring, transfer, regrouping and dismissal selection guidelines). § 95(2a) applies §§ 95(1) and (2) even where AI is used in drafting the guidelines.
quote: In Betrieben mit mehr als 500 Arbeitnehmern kann der Betriebsrat die Aufstellung von Richtlinien

variable_text: Dauer einer Zuweisung eines anderen Arbeitsbereichs (duration of reassignment to another work area)
value_text: die voraussichtlich die Dauer von einem Monat überschreitet
measurement: Expected (voraussichtliche) duration of the assignment at the time it is made; the text does not specify further measurement rules.
consequence: An assignment of another work area expected to exceed one month is a Versetzung within the meaning of the Act, which falls under the personnel selection guideline rules of § 95(1).

consequence: Energy supplier is excluded from the definition if its sales are below this amount, together with the cumulative test
conditions: Exclusion applies if the energy quantity is below this value OR the employee and turnover/balance-sheet conditions in the same definition are met
quote: unter dem Äquivalent von 75 Gigawattstunden an Energie pro Jahr

variable_text: Beschäftigte (Energielieferant)
value_text: weniger als zehn Personen beschäftigt
measurement: Number of persons employed
consequence: Energy supplier is excluded from the definition together with the turnover or balance-sheet condition
conditions: Applies jointly with the turnover or balance-sheet total below 2 million euros
quote: es werden weniger als zehn Personen beschäftigt

variable_text: Jahresumsatz oder Jahresbilanz (Energielieferant)
value_text: der Jahresumsatz oder die Jahresbilanz liegt unter 2 Millionen Euro
measurement: Annual turnover or annual balance sheet total
consequence: Energy supplier is excluded from the definition together with the employee condition
conditions: Applies jointly with fewer than ten persons employed
quote: der Jahresumsatz oder die Jahresbilanz liegt unter 2 Millionen Euro

variable_text: Gesamtnutzfläche eines Nichtwohngebäudes (Renovierung der öffentlichen Hand)
value_text: mit einer Gesamtnutzfläche von mehr als 750 Quadratmetern
measurement: Total usable floor area of the non-residential building
consequence: Public body must check whether energy performance contracts and other energy services are feasible for renovations
conditions: Applies to renovations of non-residential buildings as defined in § 1 Nr. 23 GEG
quote: mit einer Gesamtnutzfläche von mehr als 750 Quadratmetern

variable_text: Jährlicher durchschnittlicher Gesamtendenergieverbrauch (Stichprobe, Freistellung)
value_text: von 2,77 Gigawattstunden nicht überschritten hat
measurement: Average annual total final energy consumption over the last three completed calendar years
consequence: Company may evidence that it did not exceed the threshold, so that the audit obligation does not apply in a BAFA sample check
conditions: Evidence requested by BAFA within a sampling check
provision: Art. 2 Nr. 6 Buchst. b (§ 8c Abs. 2 Nr. 3 EDL-G)
quote: von 2,77 Gigawattstunden nicht überschritten hat

variable_text: jährlicher durchschnittlicher Gesamtendenergieverbrauch innerhalb der letzten drei abgeschlossenen Kalenderjahre
value_text: mehr als 2,77 Gigawattstunden
measurement: Average annual total final energy consumption over the last three completed calendar years; measurement method not stated in this part
consequence: Companies above the threshold fall within the scope of the energy audit obligation (EDL-G § 1 Nr. 4) as described in the explanatory memorandum.
conditions: Companies that are obliged under § 8 Abs. 1 of the Gesetz zur Steigerung der Energieeffizienz to have an energy or environmental management system are excluded.
provision: Begründung zu Art. 2 Nr. 1 Buchst. b (§ 1 Nr. 4 EDL-G)
quote: auf Unternehmen mit einem jährlichen durchschnittlichen Gesamtendenergieverbrauch innerhalb der letzten drei abgeschlossenen Kalenderjahre von mehr als 2,77 Gigawattstunden geändert

variable_text: Gesamtendenergieverbrauch der Unternehmen (Schwellenwert für Energie- oder Umweltmanagementsysteme)
value_text: mehr als 23,6 Gigawattstunden (GWh)
measurement: Total energy consumption of the company; window and measurement method not stated in this part
consequence: Companies above the threshold are obliged to introduce an energy and environmental management system (as described in the Bundesrat statement on the bill's § 8 Abs. 1 EnEfG-E).
conditions: The Bundesrat statement describes the bill's text; the Federal Government agreed to adjust the formulation for companies consuming exactly 23.6 GWh.
provision: Anlage 3, Stellungnahme des Bundesrates Nr. 25 (Begründung, zu Art. 1 Nr. 7 (§ 9 Abs. 1 EnEfG))
quote: In § 8 Absatz 1 EnEfG-E sind Unternehmen mit einem Gesamtendenergieverbrauch von mehr als 23,6 Gigawattstunden (GWh) verpflichtet, ein Energie- und Umweltmanagement einzuführen.

variable_text: Gesamtendenergieverbrauch der Unternehmen (Schwelle für Umsetzungspläne nach § 9 EnEfG)
value_text: ab dem Schwellenwert von 2,77 GWh bis zu diesem Schwellenwert von 23,6 GWh
measurement: Total energy consumption of the company; window and measurement method not stated in this part
consequence: Companies in the range must prepare implementation plans for the energy saving measures identified as economic in the energy audit (per the Bundesrat reading of the bill's § 9 EnEfG-E).
conditions: Range as described in the Bundesrat's explanatory statement of the bill's intent; the Bundesrat proposed the upper limit wording 'höchstens 23,6' in its own proposal text, which the Federal Government only partly accepted.
provision: Anlage 3, Stellungnahme des Bundesrates Nr. 25 (Begründung, zu Art. 1 Nr. 7 (§ 9 Abs. 1 EnEfG))
quote: Der § 9 EnEfG-E soll alle Unternehmen ab dem Schwellenwert von 2,77 GWh bis zu diesem Schwellenwert von 23,6 GWh verpflichten.

variable_text: Gesamtnutzfläche von Nichtwohngebäuden bei Renovierungen
value_text: mehr als 750 m2
measurement: Total usable floor area (Gesamtnutzfläche) of the non-residential building being renovated
consequence: The public authority must examine whether energy performance contracts and other performance-based energy services are feasible when renovating the building.
conditions: Applies to renovations of non-residential buildings; implements Art. 29 paras. 4 and 5 of Directive (EU) 2023/1791 as described in the explanatory memorandum.
provision: Begründung zu Art. 2 Nr. 2 (§ 3 Abs. 2 Satz 4 EDL-G)
quote: Bei Renovierungen von Nichtwohngebäuden mit einer Gesamtnutzfläche von mehr als 750 m2 hat die öffentliche Hand zu prüfen

variable_text: Einwohnerzahl der Gebietskörperschaft (Ausnahme für öffentliche Einrichtungen)
value_text: mehr als 5 000 und maximal 50 000 Einwohnern
measurement: Population of the Gebietskörperschaft; measurement source not stated
consequence: Public facilities in municipalities within this population range are exempt under the transitional provision, which applies only until 31 December 2026 (per the Bundesrat statement).
conditions: The exemption applies only until the end of 31 December 2026, as stated in the Bundesrat statement.
provision: Anlage 3, Stellungnahme des Bundesrates Nr. 19 Buchst. c (Begründung, zu Art. 1 Nr. 17 (§ 20 EnEfG))
quote: Die Ausnahmen für öffentliche Einrichtungen in Gebietskörperschaften mit mehr als 5 000 und maximal 50 000 Einwohnern können gestrichen werden, da diese nur bis zum Ablauf des 31. Dezember 2026 gelten.

variable_text: installed IT power consumption of datacentre (installeret informationsteknologisk effektforbrug)
value_text: på 500 kW eller derover
measurement: Installed IT power consumption as defined in Bilag 5 Art. 2(13), i.e. the nominal power of network, server and storage equipment installed in the computer room
consequence: Operator must report the information listed in § 4(2) to the Commission's European datacentre database
conditions: Not applicable to datacentres used exclusively for defence and civil protection purposes (§ 3 stk. 2)
quote: installeret informationsteknologisk (IT) effektforbrug på 500 kW

variable_text: installed IT power consumption of datacentre (installeret IT-effektforbrug), restated in the reproduced Delegated Regulation
value_text: med et installeret IT-effektforbrug på mindst 500 kW
measurement: Installed IT power consumption as defined in Bilag 5 Art. 2(13)
consequence: Restates the reporting scope of operators of datacentres with installed IT power of at least 500 kW; the same cutoff appears in § 3 stk. 1 of this order
quote: med et installeret IT-effektforbrug på mindst 500 kW

variable_text: size category of datacentre by installed IT power: very small datacentre
value_text: meget lille datacenter: 100-500 kW
measurement: Installed IT power (PDIT) of the datacentre
consequence: Datacentre falls in this size category for aggregated public disclosure of reported data
conditions: Only the aggregated data at Member State and EU level are published by size category; a category is shown only if it contains data from at least three datacentres (for indicators vi-ix)
quote: meget lille datacenter: 100-500 kW

variable_text: size category of datacentre by installed IT power: small datacentre
value_text: lille datacenter: 500-1 000 kW
measurement: Installed IT power (PDIT) of the datacentre
consequence: Datacentre falls in this size category for aggregated public disclosure of reported data
conditions: Only the aggregated data at Member State and EU level are published by size category
quote: lille datacenter: 500-1 000 kW

variable_text: size category of datacentre by installed IT power: medium datacentre
value_text: mellemstort datacenter: 1-2 MW
measurement: Installed IT power (PDIT) of the datacentre
consequence: Datacentre falls in this size category for aggregated public disclosure of reported data
conditions: Only the aggregated data at Member State and EU level are published by size category
quote: mellemstort datacenter: 1-2 MW

variable_text: size category of datacentre by installed IT power: large datacentre
value_text: stort datacenter: 2-10 MW
measurement: Installed IT power (PDIT) of the datacentre
consequence: Datacentre falls in this size category for aggregated public disclosure of reported data
conditions: Only the aggregated data at Member State and EU level are published by size category
quote: stort datacenter: 2-10 MW

variable_text: size category of datacentre by installed IT power: very large datacentre
value_text: meget stort datacenter: >10 MW
measurement: Installed IT power (PDIT) of the datacentre
consequence: Datacentre falls in this size category for aggregated public disclosure of reported data
conditions: Only the aggregated data at Member State and EU level are published by size category
quote: meget stort datacenter: >10 MW

variable_text: share of installed IT power of new servers covered by data, permitting extrapolation of CSERV (colocation operators)
value_text: mindst 90 % af det installerede IT-effektforbrug
measurement: Share of installed IT power of all new servers installed in the reporting datacentre
consequence: Colocation operator may calculate CSERV by extrapolating the value corresponding to this share
conditions: Applies only to operators of colocation datacentres
quote: mindst 90 % af det installerede IT-effektforbrug for alle nye servere

variable_text: share of installed IT power of new storage equipment covered by data, permitting extrapolation of CSTOR (colocation operators)
value_text: mindst 90 % af det installerede IT-effektforbrug
measurement: Share of installed IT power of all new storage equipment installed in the reporting datacentre
consequence: Colocation operator may calculate CSTOR by extrapolating the value corresponding to this share
conditions: Applies only to operators of colocation datacentres
quote: mindst 90 % af det installerede IT-effektforbrug for alt nyt lagringsudstyr

variable_text: operating period of the reporting datacentre
value_text: i mindre end et år
measurement: Period during which the reporting datacentre has been in operation
consequence: Operator reports only for the period in operation and states that period
conditions: Applies to the reporting of the calendar year preceding the reporting year
quote: Hvis et rapporterende datacenter har været i drift i mindre end et år

variable_text: maximum duration of the custodial sentence for the offence (strafbar handling)
value_text: af en maksimal varighed på mindst fire år
measurement: offence punishable in the Member State concerned, listed in Annex II
consequence: Real-time remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces for law enforcement is permitted for the listed offences, as an exception to the prohibition in Art. 5(1)(h).
conditions: Offence listed in Annex II; use strictly necessary; prior authorisation under Art. 5(3)
provision: Art. 5(1), første afsnit, litra h), nr. iii)
quote: af en maksimal varighed på mindst fire år

variable_text: cumulative compute used for training the general-purpose AI model, measured in floating-point operations
value_text: er større end 1025 (flydende kommatalsberegninger)
measurement: cumulative training compute, measured in floating-point operations
consequence: The model is presumed to have high-impact capabilities and is thereby treated as a general-purpose AI model with systemic risk.
conditions: Presumption applies for the purpose of Art. 51(1)(a)
quote: er større end 1025

variable_text: number of Member States in which affected individuals reside (widespread infringement, udbredt overtrædelse, litra a)
value_text: mindst to medlemsstater
measurement: counted in addition to the Member State where the act or omission originated or took place, and the Member State of the provider's or its authorised representative's establishment, or of the deployer's establishment
consequence: Determines whether an infringement is a widespread infringement under the definition in Art. 3(61).
conditions: Act or omission contrary to EU law that protects individuals' interests; applies under litra a)
quote: med bopæl i mindst to medlemsstater

variable_text: number of Member States in which the same operator commits the practice simultaneously (widespread infringement, udbredt overtrædelse, litra b)
value_text: i mindst tre medlemsstater
measurement: simultaneous commission by the same operator, with common features including the same unlawful practice
consequence: Determines whether an infringement is a widespread infringement under the definition in Art. 3(61), litra b).
conditions: Infringement has common features, including the same unlawful practice and infringement of the same interest
quote: i mindst tre medlemsstater

variable_text: SMEs, including start-ups (SMV'er, herunder iværksættervirksomheder)
value_text: size class not defined in this text; SMEs and start-ups may submit the technical documentation in a simplified form
consequence: SMEs and start-ups may present the technical documentation in a simplified form, using the simplified form provided by the Commission.
conditions: Applies to the technical documentation in Annex IV
depends_on: size definition by reference to Recommendation 2003/361/EC (see Art. 34(2)); simplified form to be provided by the Commission
quote: kan fremlægge de elementer i den tekniske dokumentation, der er anført i bilag IV, på en forenklet måde

variable_text: micro and small enterprises (mikrovirksomheder og små virksomheder)
value_text: size classes as referred to in Recommendation 2003/361/EC; not set out in this text
consequence: Notified bodies must minimise administrative burdens and compliance costs for these enterprises; the required level of strictness and protection is not reduced.
conditions: Applies to notified bodies' operational activities
depends_on: Commission Recommendation 2003/361/EC
quote: mikrovirksomheder og små virksomheder som omhandlet i henstilling 2003/361/EF

variable_text: micro-enterprise size class (Recommendation 2003/361/EC)
value_text: Mikrovirksomheder som omhandlet i henstilling 2003/361/EF
consequence: Micro-enterprises may comply with certain elements of the quality management system in a simplified manner.
conditions: No partner enterprises or affiliated enterprises as referred to in the Recommendation. Does not exempt them from other requirements of the Regulation (Art. 63(2)).
depends_on: Commission Recommendation 2003/361/EC
quote: Mikrovirksomheder som omhandlet i henstilling 2003/361/EF kan overholde visse elementer i det kvalitetsstyringssystem

variable_text: duration of real-world testing of high-risk AI systems outside regulatory sandboxes
value_text: under ingen omstændigheder længere end seks måneder, som kan forlænges i en yderligere periode på seks måneder
measurement: Duration of the testing under real-world conditions, as set in the testing plan.
consequence: Testing under real-world conditions may not run longer than six months.
conditions: Extension by a further six months is possible only if the provider has notified the market surveillance authority in advance, with a justification for the extension. Applies to testing under Art. 60(4).
quote: under ingen omstændigheder længere end seks måneder, som kan forlænges i en yderligere periode på seks måneder

variable_text: registrerede erhvervsbrugere etableret i Unionen
value_text: mindst 10 000 registrerede erhvervsbrugere etableret i Unionen
measurement: Number of registered business users established in the Union to whom the model has been made available
consequence: Presumed to have a large impact on the internal market by reason of its reach, one of the criteria the Commission takes into account under Article 51.
conditions: Listed among criteria the Commission takes into account when assessing whether a general-purpose AI model has capabilities or impacts equivalent to those in Article 51(1)(a); the presumption is stated to apply when the model has been made available to at least this number of registered business users.
quote: når den er blevet gjort tilgængelig for mindst 10 000 registrerede erhvervsbrugere etableret i Unionen

variable_text: Pyme (small and medium-sized enterprise) size class, defined by reference to Reg. (UE) 651/2014 Annex I
value_text: definición de pequeñas y medianas empresas establecida en el anexo I del Reglamento (UE) 651/2014
consequence: SMEs: each fine may be set at the turnover percentage or the fixed amount, whichever is lower (Art. 30.8)
depends_on: Reglamento (UE) 651/2014, anexo I
quote: Pyme: aquella entidad que cumpla con la definición de pequeñas y medianas empresas establecida en el anexo I del Reglamento (UE) 651/2014 de la Comisión

variable_text: Empresa emergente (start-up) class, defined by reference to Ley 28/2022 art. 3
value_text: definición establecida en el artículo 3 de la Ley 28/2022, de 21 de diciembre, de fomento del ecosistema de las empresas emergentes
consequence: Start-ups are included in the SME fine treatment of Art. 30.8
depends_on: Ley 28/2022, de 21 de diciembre, art. 3
quote: c) Empresa emergente: aquella que cumpla con la definición establecida en el artículo 3 de la Ley 28/2022, de 21 de diciembre, de fomento del ecosistema de las empresas emergentes.

variable_text: reduction of proposed sanction on acknowledgement of responsibility after proceedings start
value_text: reducción del 25 % sobre el importe de la sanción propuesta
consequence: Sanction reduced by 25% when the infringer acknowledges responsibility after initiation of proceedings
conditions: infractor reconoce su responsabilidad una vez iniciado el procedimiento sancionador
quote: aplicará una reducción del 25 % sobre el importe de la sanción propuesta

variable_text: reduction of proposed sanction on voluntary payment before resolution
value_text: reducción del 25 % sobre el importe de la sanción propuesta
consequence: Voluntary payment before resolution ends the procedure, with a 25% reduction of the proposed sanction
conditions: pago voluntario por el presunto responsable en cualquier momento anterior a la resolución
quote: aplicará una reducción del 25 % sobre el importe de la sanción propuesta

variable_text: payment level of sanction with reduction, treated as acknowledgement of responsibility
value_text: reducción del 50 %
consequence: Payment of the sanction with a 50% reduction is treated as acknowledgement of responsibility, without a separate express statement
conditions: payment of the sanction with a 50% reduction; reductions conditional on waiving administrative or contentious appeals
quote: Si el infractor realiza el pago de la sanción con una reducción del 50 %, el órgano sancionador entenderá que el infractor reconoce la responsabilidad

variable_text: más de 250 trabajadores (empresas con más de 250 trabajadores)
value_text: más de 250 trabajadores
measurement: Company headcount; the salary-information duty applies only if a regulation under Art. 9.6 is adopted
consequence: Employers above the threshold may be required by regulation to publish salary information needed to analyse pay differences
conditions: Applies only through regulatory development ('Por vía reglamentaria, se podrá exigir'); factors as in Art. 2.1
quote: cuyas empresas tengan más de 250 trabajadores [employers whose companies have more than 250 workers]

variable_text: antigüedad legal de la asociación u organización (al menos dos años antes de la iniciación del proceso judicial)
value_text: al menos dos años antes de la iniciación del proceso judicial
measurement: Time elapsed between legal constitution of the association or organisation and the start of the judicial process
consequence: Human-rights associations and organisations must meet this seniority requirement to be legitimated for judicial defence of rights
conditions: Also requires active pursuit of statutory activities, unless suing to defend its members; and a state-wide or relevant territorial scope under Art. 29.2 b)
quote: Que se hubieran constituido legalmente al menos dos años antes de la iniciación del proceso judicial

variable_text: número de infracciones leves cometidas (tercera o más, con dos sanciones firmes por infracciones leves en el año anterior)
value_text: una tercera o más infracción leve
measurement: Count of minor infractions committed by the alleged offender, with a one-year look-back for prior final administrative sanctions
consequence: The infraction is classified as grave
conditions: In the previous year the alleged offender had already been sanctioned by two minor infractions through a final administrative resolution
quote: La comisión de una tercera o más infracción leve, siempre que en el plazo del año anterior el presunto infractor hubiera sido ya sancionado por dos infracciones leves mediante resolución administrativa firme.

variable_text: número de infracciones graves cometidas (tercera o más, con dos sanciones firmes por infracciones graves en los dos años anteriores)
value_text: una tercera o más infracción grave
measurement: Count of grave infractions committed by the alleged offender, with a two-year look-back for prior final administrative sanctions
consequence: The infraction is classified as muy grave
conditions: In the two previous years the alleged offender had already been sanctioned by two grave infractions through a final administrative resolution
quote: La comisión de una tercera o más infracción grave, siempre que en el plazo de los dos años anteriores el presunto infractor hubiera sido ya sancionado por dos infracciones graves mediante resolución administrativa firme.

variable_text: importe de la sanción impuesta por infracción muy grave
value_text: exceda los 300.000 euros
measurement: Amount of the administrative fine imposed for a very grave infraction
consequence: Resolution requires agreement of the Council of Ministers, in addition to the Ministry competent by subject matter
conditions: Applies only where the infraction is muy grave
quote: cuando se trate de infracciones muy graves, y el importe de la sanción impuesta exceda los 300.000 euros, se requerirá acuerdo del Consejo de Ministros.

variable_text: edad del menor para fundar el tratamiento de sus datos en su propio consentimiento
value_text: mayor de catorce años
measurement: age of the minor at the time consent is given
consequence: A minor older than 14 may found processing of personal data on his or her own consent.
conditions: Exception where the law requires the assistance of the holders of parental authority or guardianship for the legal act in whose context consent is sought.
quote: únicamente podrá fundarse en su consentimiento cuando sea mayor de catorce años

variable_text: edad del menor por debajo de la cual se exige el consentimiento del titular de la patria potestad o tutela
value_text: menores de catorce años
measurement: age of the minor at the time consent is given
consequence: Processing of data of a minor under 14 based on consent is lawful only if the consent of the holder of parental authority or guardianship is also given.
conditions: Applies to processing founded on consent.
quote: El tratamiento de los datos de los menores de catorce años, fundado en el consentimiento, solo será lícito si consta el del titular de la patria potestad o tutela

variable_text: edad del menor para el ejercicio de derechos por sus representantes
value_text: menores de catorce años
measurement: age of the minor when rights are exercised
consequence: Holders of parental authority may exercise access, rectification, cancellation, objection and other rights in the name and on behalf of a minor under 14.
conditions: Without prejudice to other special regimes under Article 12(5).
quote: podrán ejercitar en nombre y representación de los menores de catorce años

variable_text: plazo máximo de conservación de datos de incumplimiento de obligaciones dinerarias en sistemas de información crediticia
value_text: con el límite máximo de cinco años desde la fecha de vencimiento de la obligación dineraria
measurement: from the due date of the monetary, financial or credit obligation
consequence: Data on non-payment may remain in a common credit information system only while the non-payment persists, up to this maximum.
conditions: Applies where the presumption of lawfulness in Article 20(1) is relied on.
quote: con el límite máximo de cinco años desde la fecha de vencimiento de la obligación dineraria

variable_text: plazo de supresión de imágenes captadas por videovigilancia
value_text: en el plazo máximo de un mes desde su captación
measurement: from capture of the images
consequence: Images must be deleted within this maximum period.
conditions: Exception where images must be kept to prove the commission of acts against the integrity of persons, property or installations; they are then made available to the competent authority within 72 hours.
quote: Los datos serán suprimidos en el plazo máximo de un mes desde su captación

variable_text: plazo de conservación de datos en sistemas de información de denuncias internas
value_text: transcurridos tres meses desde la introducción de los datos
measurement: from entry of the data into the whistleblowing system
consequence: Data must be deleted from the whistleblowing system after this period.
conditions: Exception where retention is needed as evidence of the operation of the legal person's crime prevention model; unprocessed reports may then be kept only in anonymised form.
quote: transcurridos tres meses desde la introducción de los datos, deberá procederse a su supresión del sistema de denuncias

variable_text: modificaciones presupuestarias de la Agencia Española de Protección de Datos autorizables por su Presidencia
value_text: hasta un tres por ciento de la cifra inicial de su presupuesto total de gastos
measurement: budget modification relative to the initial total expenditure budget
consequence: The Presidency of the Agency may authorise budget modifications up to this share.
conditions: Modifications must not increase credits for personnel expenditure.
quote: hasta un tres por ciento de la cifra inicial de su presupuesto total de gastos

variable_text: modificaciones presupuestarias de la Agencia Española de Protección de Datos autorizables por el Ministerio de Hacienda
value_text: Las restantes modificaciones que no excedan de un cinco por ciento del presupuesto
measurement: budget modification relative to the initial total expenditure budget
consequence: Budget modifications above the Presidency threshold and up to this share are authorised by the Ministry of Finance; larger ones by the Government.
quote: Las restantes modificaciones que no excedan de un cinco por ciento del presupuesto

variable_text: importe de la sanción impuesta por la Agencia Española de Protección de Datos a una persona jurídica
value_text: la sanción fuese superior a un millón de euros y el infractor sea una persona jurídica
measurement: amount of the sanction imposed
consequence: Information identifying the infringer, the infringement and the amount of the sanction must be published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado.
conditions: Applies where the Agencia Española de Protección de Datos is the competent authority and the infringer is a legal person.
quote: la sanción fuese superior a un millón de euros y el infractor sea una persona jurídica

variable_text: importe de la sanción, tramo de prescripción de un año
value_text: Las sanciones por importe igual o inferior a 40.000 euros, prescriben en el plazo de un año.
measurement: amount of the sanction imposed
consequence: Sanctions in this amount band prescribe after one year.
quote: Las sanciones por importe igual o inferior a 40.000 euros, prescriben en el plazo de un año.

variable_text: importe de la sanción, tramo de prescripción de dos años
value_text: Las sanciones por importe comprendido entre 40.001 y 300.000 euros prescriben a los dos años.

consequence: Sanctions in this amount band prescribe after two years.
quote: Las sanciones por importe comprendido entre 40.001 y 300.000 euros prescriben a los dos años.

variable_text: importe de la sanción, tramo de prescripción de tres años
value_text: Las sanciones por un importe superior a 300.000 euros prescriben a los tres años.
