consequence: Sanctions in this amount band prescribe after three years.
quote: Las sanciones por un importe superior a 300.000 euros prescriben a los tres años.

variable_text: cuantía del principal de la deuda incorporable a sistemas de información crediticia
value_text: deudas en que la cuantía del principal sea inferior a cincuenta euros
measurement: Principal amount of the debt. The text gives no window or aggregation and does not say who measures it. The Government may update the amount by royal decree.
consequence: Debts with principal below EUR 50 may not be incorporated into the credit information systems referred to in Art. 20.1.
conditions: Applies to the credit information systems referred to in Art. 20.1 of this organic law. The Government may update the amount by royal decree (mediante real decreto).
provision: Disposición adicional sexta. Incorporación de deudas a sistemas de información crediticia.
quote: No se incorporarán a los sistemas de información crediticia a los que se refiere el artículo 20.1 de esta ley orgánica deudas en que la cuantía del principal sea inferior a cincuenta euros.

variable_text: demanda de potencia eléctrica de los sistemas de tecnología de la información instalados
value_text: igual o superior a 500 kW
measurement: Nominal power demand of network, servers and storage equipment installed in the computer room (Art. 2(3))
consequence: Operators fall within the scope of Art. 4 (annual reporting to the Dirección General de Planificación y Coordinación Energética)
conditions: Applies to data centre operators; threshold measured on installed IT systems
quote: igual o superior a 500 kW

variable_text: entrada de energía nominal total
value_text: entrada de energía nominal total superior a 1 MW
measurement: Total nominal energy input of the data centre
consequence: Project promoters and owners fall within the scope of Art. 5 (waste heat reuse obligations)
conditions: Applies to promoters of data centre projects or owners of data centres
quote: entrada de energía nominal total superior a 1 MW

variable_text: demanda de potencia eléctrica de los sistemas de TI
value_text: igual o superior a 1 MW
measurement: Electrical power demand of installed IT systems
consequence: Promoters, owners and operators fall within the scope of Art. 6 (best-practice communication)
conditions: Applies to promoters of data centre projects, owners and operators
quote: igual o superior a 1 MW

variable_text: período de funcionamiento del centro de datos notificante
value_text: lleve en funcionamiento menos de un año
measurement: Operating period of the notifying data centre
consequence: Operator reports only the period of operation and states that period
conditions: Applies to the annual reporting under Art. 4(1)
quote: lleve en funcionamiento menos de un año

variable_text: coste de la renovación frente al coste de inversión de una unidad nueva comparable
value_text: cuyo coste supere el 50% del coste de inversión
measurement: Renovation cost compared with the investment cost of a comparable new unit
consequence: Renovation is treated as substantial, so a cost-benefit analysis must be carried out at the project phase
conditions: Applies to data centres projected for the first time or undergoing substantial renovation
quote: cuyo coste supere el 50% del coste de inversión

variable_text: posición dentro de las instalaciones con mejores prestaciones en los indicadores relevantes
value_text: dentro del 15% de instalaciones con mejores prestaciones
measurement: Ranking among installations on relevant indicators (including PUE, WUE, ERF and renewable energy share)
consequence: Operator must demonstrate that the data centre is within the best-performing 15% of installations to show best practice
conditions: Applies to data centres above 100 MW (Art. 6(2))
quote: estar situados dentro del 15% de instalaciones con mejores prestaciones

variable_text: potencia de los centros de datos
value_text: Para los centros de datos de potencia superior a 100MW
measurement: Power of the data centre
consequence: Operator must demonstrate compliance with best practice, within the best-performing 15% of installations
conditions: Applies to data centres above 100 MW
quote: Para los centros de datos de potencia superior a 100MW

variable_text: valor estimado del contrato
value_text: igual o superior a 120.000 euros
measurement: Estimated value of the contract (valor estimado)
consequence: The Dirección may delegate its contracting-body competence, except for contracts at or above this value, which cannot be delegated.
conditions: Applies to delegation of the contracting-body competence (órgano de contratación) of the Agency by the Dirección.
quote: salvo para contratos cuyo valor estimado fuera igual o superior a 120.000 euros

variable_text: saldo vivo de pólizas de crédito o préstamo frente al presupuesto de la Agencia
value_text: no supere el cinco por ciento de su presupuesto
measurement: Outstanding balance (saldo vivo) of credit or loan facilities, relative to the Agency's budget (presupuesto)
consequence: The Agency may take out credit or loan facilities to cover temporary treasury mismatches only while the outstanding balance does not exceed this share of its budget.
conditions: Applies only to temporary treasury mismatches (desfases temporales de tesorería); the Agency otherwise may not borrow.
quote: siempre que el saldo vivo no supere el cinco por ciento de su presupuesto

variable_text: pequeña y mediana empresa (pyme)
value_text: set by Reglamento (UE) 651/2014, anexo I, art. 2, via Art. 3(13)
consequence: Pyme status is a favourably weighted criterion in the evaluation of admission applications.
conditions: Weighed together with the size or type of the applicant provider to ensure diversity of participants.
depends_on: Reglamento (UE) 651/2014, anexo I, art. 2
quote: valorándose positivamente la condición de empresa emergente, pequeña o mediana empresa

variable_text: empresa emergente
value_text: set by Ley 28/2022, de 21 de diciembre, art. 3, via Art. 3(15)
consequence: Startup status is a favourably weighted criterion in the evaluation of admission applications.
conditions: Weighed together with the size or type of the applicant provider to ensure diversity of participants.
depends_on: Ley 28/2022, de 21 de diciembre, de fomento del ecosistema de las empresas emergentes, art. 3
quote: valorándose positivamente la condición de empresa emergente

variable_text: microempresas y pequeñas empresas (micro and small enterprises)
value_text: set by the annex of Recomendación 2003/361/CE
consequence: Annex II point 5(b) does not cover credit-scoring systems put into service by such providers for their own use.
conditions: Applies only to systems put into service for the provider's own use.
depends_on: Recomendación 2003/361/CE de la Comisión, anexo
quote: salvo los sistemas de IA puestos en servicio por proveedores que son microempresas y pequeñas empresas

variable_text: microempresas y pequeñas empresas (micro and small enterprises)
value_text: set by the annex of Recomendación 2003/361/CE
consequence: Annex II point 5(d) does not cover life and health insurance risk-assessment and pricing systems put into service by such providers for their own use.
conditions: Applies only to systems put into service for the provider's own use.
depends_on: Recomendación 2003/361/CE de la Comisión, anexo
quote: con excepción de los sistemas de IA puestos en servicio por proveedores que sean microempresas y pequeñas empresas

variable_text: maximum custodial sentence for the offence, as set by the law of the Member State
value_text: cuya duración máxima sea al menos tres años
measurement: Maximum duration of custodial penalty or security measure under the national law for the offence in question.
consequence: Remote real-time biometric identification for law enforcement in publicly accessible spaces is excluded from eligibility, except where strictly necessary for listed objectives; this offence cut-off qualifies one of those objectives.
conditions: Applies to the offence in Art. 2(2) of Framework Decision 584/2002/JAI for which the national law imposes such a penalty or measure.
quote: cuya duración máxima sea al menos tres años

variable_text: plazo de la tasación respecto de la incorporación del préstamo al conjunto de cobertura
value_text: dentro de los seis meses anteriores a la incorporación
measurement: Time between the full individual appraisal and the inclusion of the mortgage loan in the cover pool
consequence: A full individual appraisal made within six months before inclusion counts as the updated valuation
conditions: Appraisal made under Orden ECO/805/2003 at loan origination
quote: siempre que la misma se haya emitido dentro de los seis meses anteriores a la incorporación del préstamo hipotecario al conjunto de cobertura

variable_text: relación préstamo garantizado / valor de tasación del bien hipotecado (inmuebles no residenciales)
value_text: no podrá exceder del 60 por ciento del valor de tasación del bien hipotecado
measurement: Loan amount relative to appraisal value of the mortgaged property, at inclusion in the cover pool
consequence: Loan secured by mortgage may be included as cover asset up to this ratio
conditions: Applies to loans secured by real estate other than residential property
quote: no podrá exceder del 60 por ciento del valor de tasación del bien hipotecado

variable_text: relación préstamo garantizado / valor de tasación (inmuebles residenciales)
value_text: el préstamo podrá alcanzar el 80 por ciento del valor de tasación
measurement: Loan amount relative to appraisal value of the residential property, at inclusion in the cover pool
consequence: Loan secured by residential property may be included as cover asset up to this ratio
conditions: Residential immovable property
quote: el préstamo podrá alcanzar el 80 por ciento del valor de tasación

variable_text: plazo de amortización del préstamo garantizado para la vivienda habitual
value_text: no podrá exceder de 30 años
measurement: Amortisation term of the guaranteed loan
consequence: Loan financing acquisition, construction or rehabilitation of the habitual residence may not exceed this term to be eligible
conditions: Loan finances acquisition, construction or rehabilitation of the habitual residence
quote: no podrá exceder de 30 años

variable_text: límite de activos de sustitución en cédulas hipotecarias
value_text: hasta un límite del 10 por ciento del principal
measurement: Share of principal of the issued covered bonds
consequence: Covered bonds may be backed by substitute assets up to this share of principal
conditions: Substitute assets listed in Art. 23(3) a) and b)
quote: podrán estar respaldadas hasta un límite del 10 por ciento del principal por los siguientes activos de sustitución

variable_text: nivel mínimo de sobregarantía legal de las cédulas hipotecarias
value_text: set by the first paragraph of Art. 129.3 bis of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013
measurement: Legal overcollateralisation level
consequence: Covered mortgage bonds must maintain the minimum legal overcollateralisation level set in the referenced regulation
depends_on: Art. 129.3 bis of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 (first paragraph)
quote: el nivel mínimo de sobre garantía legal previsto en el primer párrafo del artículo 129.3 bis

variable_text: nivel mínimo de sobregarantía legal para bonos garantizados con préstamos a empresas públicas
value_text: un nivel mínimo de sobregarantía legal del 10 %
measurement: Legal overcollateralisation level
consequence: Covered bonds backed by loans to public enterprises or guaranteed by them must maintain this minimum legal overcollateralisation
conditions: Public enterprises providing essential public services under the conditions in Art. 27(4) a) to c)
quote: un nivel mínimo de sobregarantía legal del 10 %

variable_text: límite de activos de sustitución en bonos garantizados del artículo 27
value_text: hasta un límite del 10 por ciento del principal de cada emisión
measurement: Share of principal of each issue
consequence: Covered bonds under Art. 27 may be backed by substitute assets up to this share of principal
conditions: Substitute assets listed in Art. 23(3)
quote: podrán estar respaldados hasta un límite del 10 por ciento del principal de cada emisión

variable_text: límite de contribución de activos físicos en garantía a la cobertura
value_text: y el 70% del valor de dichos activos físicos en garantía
unit: percent of value of physical collateral
measurement: Value of physical collateral assets
consequence: Physical collateral contributes to coverage up to the lower of the combined encumbrance principal and this share of value
conditions: Applies to physical collateral assets under Art. 27(3) a)
quote: y el 70% del valor de dichos activos físicos en garantía

variable_text: proporción de ingresos de una sociedad de tasación procedente de una entidad de crédito o de su grupo
value_text: al menos en un 10 por cien de su relación de negocio con una entidad de crédito
measurement: Share of total income derived from business with a credit institution or its group, over a period set by regulation
consequence: Appraisal company must have mechanisms to favour independence and avoid conflicts of interest
conditions: Period to be set regulatorily
quote: al menos en un 10 por cien de su relación de negocio con una entidad de crédito

variable_text: participación significativa en una sociedad de tasación
value_text: al menos el 10 por cien del capital o de los derechos de voto de la sociedad
unit: percent of capital or voting rights
measurement: Direct or indirect holding in the appraisal company
consequence: Acquirer must inform the Banco de España in advance; acquisition by credit institutions is prohibited
conditions: Holding without reaching the percentage may also qualify if it allows notable influence
quote: al menos el 10 por cien del capital o de los derechos de voto de la sociedad

variable_text: period since cessation as auditor (fiscal years)
value_text: tres ejercicios desde su cese como auditor
measurement: fiscal years counted from cessation as auditor, relative to designation
consequence: A company that audited the issuer or its group cannot be designated external control body until at least three fiscal years have passed since it ceased as auditor.
conditions: Audit of the annual accounts of the issuer, its group or a group entity; the lookback covers the three fiscal years before designation.
quote: hasta que no hayan transcurrido, al menos, tres ejercicios desde su cese como auditor

variable_text: period of group membership before designation
value_text: en los tres años anteriores a la designación
measurement: three years before designation
consequence: A company that is or was in the same group as the issuer, or as the company in letter a), within the three years before designation cannot be designated external control body.
conditions: Same group as the issuer or as the auditing company described in letter a).
quote: en los tres años anteriores a la designación

variable_text: significant shareholding (capital or voting rights)
value_text: al menos el 10% del capital social o de los derechos de voto
measurement: direct or indirect holding
consequence: A shareholder holding this share, or exercising notable influence, must have recognised commercial and professional honourability; otherwise the issuer may not designate the company as external control body.
conditions: Also applies below the percentage where the shareholder can exercise notable influence.
quote: al menos el 10% del capital social o de los derechos de voto

variable_text: minimum contract period of an external control body
value_text: será de tres años
measurement: contract term
consequence: The minimum contract period of an external control body is three years.
conditions: Contract may be extended up to a maximum of ten years.
quote: El periodo mínimo de contratación de una sociedad como órgano externo de control del conjunto de cobertura de un programa de bonos garantizados será de tres años

variable_text: maximum contract period of an external control body
value_text: hasta un máximo de diez años
measurement: total contract term including extensions
consequence: The contract of an external control body may be extended up to a maximum of ten years.
conditions: Extension of the minimum three-year contract.
quote: pudiendo prorrogar su contratación hasta un máximo de diez años

variable_text: time since cessation before re-contracting an external control body
value_text: Trascurridos tres años del cese
measurement: time elapsed since cessation
consequence: A former external control body may be re-contracted once three years have elapsed since its cessation.
conditions: Applies after cessation of the external control body.
quote: Trascurridos tres años del cese, podrá ser de nuevo contratado

variable_text: lookback period for a prior final administrative sanction (repeat infringement)
value_text: durante los cinco años anteriores a su comisión
measurement: five years before commission of the infringement
consequence: A serious infringement committed within five years after a final administrative sanction for the same type of infringement is classed as very serious.
conditions: Prior sanction must be final in administrative proceedings and for the same type of infringement.
quote: durante los cinco años anteriores a su comisión hubiera sido impuesta a la entidad emisora sanción firme en vía administrativa por el mismo tipo de infracción

variable_text: lookback period for a prior final administrative sanction (repeat infringement)
value_text: durante los dos años anteriores a su comisión
measurement: two years before commission of the infringement
consequence: A minor infringement committed within two years after a final administrative sanction for the same type of infringement is classed as serious.
conditions: Prior sanction must be final in administrative proceedings and for the same type of infringement.
quote: cuando durante los dos años anteriores a su comisión, hubiera sido impuesta a la entidad emisora sanción firme en vía administrativa por el mismo tipo de infracción

variable_text: duration of non-compliance with minimum share capital or civil liability insurance (appraisal)
value_text: durante un período superior a tres meses
measurement: continuous period of non-compliance
consequence: Non-compliance with the minimum share capital or the civil liability insurance requirement for more than three months is a very serious infringement.
conditions: Applies to the minimum capital requirement for appraisal activity and to civil liability insurance cover.
quote: durante un período superior a tres meses

variable_text: lookback period for a prior final administrative sanction (repeat infringement, appraisal)
value_text: cuando durante los cinco años anteriores a su comisión hubiera sido impuesta una sanción firme
measurement: five years before commission of the infringement
consequence: A serious appraisal infringement committed within five years after a final sanction for the same type of infringement is classed as very serious.
conditions: Prior sanction must be final and for the same type of infringement.
quote: cuando durante los cinco años anteriores a su comisión hubiera sido impuesta una sanción firme por el mismo tipo de infracción

variable_text: lookback period for a prior final sanction (minor appraisal infringement)
value_text: cuando durante los dos años anteriores a su comisión, hubiera sido impuesta a los servicios y sociedades de tasación sanción firme
measurement: two years before commission of the infringement
consequence: A minor appraisal infringement committed within two years after a final sanction for the same type of infringement is classed as serious.
conditions: Prior sanction must be final and for the same type of infringement.
quote: cuando durante los dos años anteriores a su comisión, hubiera sido impuesta a los servicios y sociedades de tasación sanción firme por el mismo tipo de infracción

variable_text: lookback period for a prior final sanction (serious infringement by external control body)
value_text: cuando durante los cinco años anteriores a su comisión hubiera sido impuesta al órgano externo de control del conjunto de cobertura sanción firme
measurement: five years before commission of the infringement
consequence: A serious infringement by the external control body committed within five years after a final sanction for the same type of infringement is classed as very serious.
conditions: Prior sanction must be final in administrative proceedings and for the same type of infringement.
quote: cuando durante los cinco años anteriores a su comisión hubiera sido impuesta al órgano externo de control del conjunto de cobertura sanción firme

variable_text: lookback period for a prior final sanction (minor infringement by external control body)
value_text: cuando los dos años anteriores a su comisión, hubiera sido impuesta al órgano externo de control del conjunto de cobertura sanción firme
measurement: two years before commission of the infringement
consequence: A minor infringement by the external control body committed within two years after a final sanction for the same type of infringement is classed as serious.
conditions: Prior sanction must be final in administrative proceedings and for the same type of infringement.
quote: cuando los dos años anteriores a su comisión, hubiera sido impuesta al órgano externo de control del conjunto de cobertura sanción firme

variable_text: period after start of pre-marketing for subscriptions by professional investors (IIC)
value_text: en un plazo de dieciocho meses después de que una sociedad gestora haya comenzado la precomercialización
measurement: months from the start of pre-marketing by the management company
consequence: Subscriptions by professional investors within eighteen months of the start of pre-marketing are treated as marketing and subject to its notification procedures.
conditions: Applies to units or shares mentioned in the pre-marketing information, or of an IIC established as a result of pre-marketing.
quote: en un plazo de dieciocho meses después de que una sociedad gestora haya comenzado la precomercialización

variable_text: period in which a management company may not take part in pre-marketing after notified cessation (IIC)
value_text: Durante un período de 36 meses
measurement: months from the date of the cessation notification
consequence: The management company may not take part in pre-marketing of the same or similar funds in the notified Member State for 36 months after cessation.
conditions: Applies after a notified cessation of marketing under the cross-border regime.
quote: Durante un período de 36 meses a partir de la fecha a que se refiere el apartado 1, letra c), la SGIIC no participará en la precomercialización

variable_text: period after start of pre-marketing for subscriptions by professional investors (ECR/EICC)
value_text: en un plazo de dieciocho meses después de que una SGEIC haya comenzado la precomercialización
measurement: months from the start of pre-marketing by the SGEIC
consequence: Subscriptions by professional investors within eighteen months of the start of pre-marketing are treated as marketing and subject to its notification procedures.
conditions: Applies to ECR or EICC mentioned in the pre-marketing information, or established as a result of pre-marketing.
quote: en un plazo de dieciocho meses después de que una SGEIC haya comenzado la precomercialización

variable_text: period in which an SGEIC may not take part in pre-marketing after notified cessation (ECR/EICC)
value_text: Durante un período de 36 meses
measurement: months from the date of the cessation notification
consequence: The SGEIC may not take part in pre-marketing of the same or similar ECR or EICC in the notified Member State for 36 months after cessation.
conditions: Applies after a notified cessation of marketing under the cross-border regime.
quote: Durante un período de 36 meses a partir de la fecha a que se refiere el apartado 1, letra b), la SGEIC no participará en la precomercialización

variable_text: exclusivity period for digitisation agreements on cultural resources
value_text: el período de exclusividad no será superior, por regla general, a diez años
measurement: duration of the exclusive agreement
consequence: Exclusivity period for an exclusive agreement on digitisation of cultural resources generally may not exceed ten years.
conditions: Stated as a general rule ('por regla general'); applies to exclusive agreements related to digitisation of cultural resources.
quote: el período de exclusividad no será superior, por regla general, a diez años

variable_text: duration of exemption from free high-value dataset reuse
value_text: por un período no superior a los dos años a partir de la entrada en vigor del acto de ejecución o resolución que apruebe la lista de conjuntos de datos de alto valor
measurement: from entry into force of the act approving the high-value dataset list
consequence: Public bodies whose budget would be substantially affected may be exempted from providing high-value datasets free of charge for up to two years.
conditions: Substantial impact on the budget of bodies that must obtain revenue to finance their public service activity; exemption granted by the administration to which the body is attached.
provision: Art. 64, Nueve (Ley 37/2007, art. 7, apartado 9, letra a), 3.º)
quote: por un período no superior a los dos años a partir de la entrada en vigor del acto de ejecución o resolución que apruebe la lista de conjuntos de datos de alto valor

variable_text: años de operación en la Unión Europea de los nuevos prestadores de servicios para compartir contenidos en línea
value_text: menos de tres años operando en la Unión Europea
measurement: Time the provider has operated in the European Union
consequence: Eligible for the limited liability regime in Art. 73.7: Art. 73.4 requirements limited to letter a) and expeditious action on a sufficiently motivated notice
conditions: Also requires annual turnover below 10,000,000 euros (separate row)
quote: A los nuevos prestadores de servicios para compartir contenidos en línea que lleven menos de tres años operando en la Unión Europea

variable_text: volumen de negocios anual
value_text: volumen de negocios anual sea inferior a 10.000.000 euros
measurement: Annual turnover calculated under Recomendación 2003/361/CE (as cited in the text)
consequence: Eligible for the limited liability regime in Art. 73.7
conditions: Joint with operating less than three years in the EU; size calculation by reference to Recommendation 2003/361/EC
quote: cuyo volumen de negocios anual sea inferior a 10.000.000 euros

variable_text: promedio de visitantes únicos mensuales
value_text: supere los cinco millones
measurement: Monthly unique visitors averaged over the previous annual financial year
consequence: Such providers must also demonstrate best efforts to prevent new uploads of notified works that rights holders have identified
conditions: Applies to providers that qualify under the first paragraph of Art. 73.7
quote: Cuando el promedio de visitantes únicos mensuales de dichos prestadores de servicios supere los cinco millones

variable_text: umbral del artículo 1 del Real Decreto-ley 3/2020 para contratos de suministro y arrendamiento de vehículos
value_text: por encima del umbral previsto en el artículo 1 del Real Decreto-ley 3/2020, de 4 de febrero
consequence: Supply and rental contracts for road vehicles fall within the scope of Libro Séptimo above this threshold
conditions: Alternative limb: contracts subject to harmonised regulation under Ley 9/2017, art. 21; same reference used for art. 87.1 c)
depends_on: umbral previsto en el artículo 1 del Real Decreto-ley 3/2020, de 4 de febrero
quote: o por encima del umbral previsto en el artículo 1 del Real Decreto-ley 3/2020, de 4 de febrero

variable_text: umbrales del artículo 5.4 del Reglamento (CE) n.º 1370/2007 para transporte público de viajeros por carretera
value_text: cuando se superen los umbrales establecidos en el artículo 5.4 del Reglamento (CE) n.º 1370/2007
consequence: Passenger road transport public service contracts fall within the scope of Libro Séptimo above these thresholds
conditions: Applies to contracts under art. 87.1 b)
depends_on: Reglamento (CE) n.º 1370/2007, art. 5(4)
quote: cuando se superen los umbrales establecidos en el artículo 5.4 del Reglamento (CE) n.º 1370/2007

variable_text: plazas de asiento además de la del conductor (categoría M1)
value_text: como máximo, ocho plazas de asiento además de la del conductor
measurement: Seats other than the driver's seat, without standing-passenger space
consequence: Vehicle is category M1 (light vehicle): the clean light vehicle definition (Art. 88.4 a), Cuadro 2) and the light-vehicle targets (Annex, Cuadro 3) apply; above 8 seats it is M2/M3
conditions: Category M1 under Reglamento (UE) 2018/858
quote: vehículos de motor que tengan, como máximo, ocho plazas de asiento además de la del conductor

variable_text: masa máxima del vehículo (categoría M2)
value_text: cuya masa máxima no sea superior a 5 toneladas
measurement: Maximum mass of the vehicle
consequence: Vehicle with more than 8 seats is M2 (light) up to 5 tonnes and M3 (heavy) above; decides which clean-vehicle definition and target table apply
conditions: Category M2 has more than eight seats besides the driver; category M3 covers the same seat count above 5 tonnes
quote: cuya masa máxima no sea superior a 5 toneladas

variable_text: masa máxima del vehículo (categoría N1)
value_text: cuya masa máxima no sea superior a 3,5 toneladas
measurement: Maximum mass of the vehicle
consequence: Goods vehicle up to 3.5 tonnes is N1 (light): clean light vehicle definition and light-vehicle targets apply
conditions: Category N1 under Reglamento (UE) 2018/858
quote: vehículos de motor cuya masa máxima no sea superior a 3,5 toneladas

variable_text: masa máxima del vehículo (categoría N2)
value_text: masa máxima sea superior a 3,5 toneladas, pero no supere las 12 toneladas
measurement: Maximum mass of the vehicle
consequence: Goods vehicle above 3.5 and up to 12 tonnes is N2 (heavy): heavy clean vehicle definition (Art. 88.4 b) and heavy-vehicle targets apply
conditions: Category N2 under Reglamento (UE) 2018/858
quote: vehículos de motor cuya masa máxima sea superior a 3,5 toneladas, pero no supere las 12 toneladas

variable_text: masa máxima del vehículo (categoría N3)
value_text: masa máxima sea superior a 12 toneladas
measurement: Maximum mass of the vehicle
consequence: Goods vehicle above 12 tonnes is N3 (heavy): heavy clean vehicle definition (Art. 88.4 b) and heavy-vehicle targets apply
conditions: Category N3 under Reglamento (UE) 2018/858
quote: vehículos de motor cuya masa máxima sea superior a 12 toneladas

variable_text: emisiones de CO2 del tubo de escape (vehículos ligeros limpios, hasta 2025)
value_text: Hasta el 31 de diciembre de 2025: 50 g CO2/km
measurement: Maximum tailpipe CO2 emissions of the vehicle
consequence: Vehicle counts as a clean light vehicle (vehículo limpio) for public procurement targets
conditions: Applies to M1, M2 and N1 vehicles up to 31 December 2025; must also meet the pollutant RDE threshold
quote: Umbrales de emisiones aplicables a los vehículos ligeros limpios

variable_text: emisiones de CO2 por kWh de motor de combustión interna (vehículo pesado de emisión cero)
value_text: con un motor de combustión interna que emita menos de 1 g CO2 /kWh
measurement: Measured under Reglamento (CE) 595/2009 and its implementing measures
consequence: Heavy vehicle counts as zero-emission (vehículo pesado de emisión cero) for procurement targets, including the bus sub-target in the Annex
conditions: Alternative limb: vehicles without a combustion engine also qualify; see the 1 g CO2/km limb
quote: con un motor de combustión interna que emita menos de 1 g CO2 /kWh

variable_text: emisiones de CO2 por km (vehículo pesado de emisión cero, alternativa)
value_text: que emita menos de 1 g CO2 /km
measurement: Measured under Reglamento (CE) 715/2007 and its implementing measures
consequence: Heavy vehicle counts as zero-emission (vehículo pesado de emisión cero) for procurement targets
conditions: Alternative to the 1 g CO2/kWh limb for internal combustion engines

variable_text: Maximum Import Capacity (MIC) de-minimis level
value_text: minimum project level in terms of MIC below which elements of this policy do not apply, this de-minimis level will be set at 1 MVA
measurement: Measured on the whole project; multiple applications below the level for the same project/owner are aggregated; existing projects increasing MIC to 1 MVA or more are captured; System Operators assess MIC in connection applications
consequence: Elements of this policy apply to data centres at or above 1 MVA MIC; below it no other requirements from this policy apply (SOs still take location into account)
conditions: Applies to data centres seeking to connect to the electricity network
quote: This de-minimis level will be set at 1 MVA.

variable_text: MIC <10MVA (autoproducer tier)
value_text: data centres which are above the de-minimis level (1MVA) and have an MIC <10MVA
measurement: MIC of the whole project, as for the de-minimis level; multiple sub-threshold applications for the same project are aggregated
consequence: Data centres in this band must provide an autoproducer unit in the SEM meeting 100% of the site MIC on a de-rated basis; if compliant they are not required to meet Mandatory Demand Curtailment provisions
conditions: Applies only at or above the 1 MVA de-minimis level
quote: data centres which are above the de-minimis level (1MVA) and have an MIC <10MVA are required to provide an autoproducer unit

variable_text: MIC equal to or above 10 MVA (dispatchable generation tier)
value_text: data centres with an MIC equal to or above 10 MVA connecting to the electricity network will be required to provide dispatchable onsite or proximate generation and/or storage capacity
measurement: MIC of the data centre connection as sought in the application; aggregated treatment applies to multiple applications for the same project
consequence: Data centres at or above 10 MVA MIC must provide dispatchable onsite or proximate generation and/or storage at least covering their MIC, separately connected and metered, participating in the wholesale market; if compliant they are not required to meet Mandatory Demand Curtailment provisions; the connection cannot be operational or ramp up without that generation
conditions: Derating requirements apply; renewable generation contribution may be reflected on a de-rated basis
quote: data centres with an MIC equal to or above 10 MVA connecting to the electricity network will be required to provide dispatchable onsite or proximate generation and/or storage capacity

variable_text: Maximum Import Capacity (MIC) of a data centre connection application
value_text: equal to or above the de-minimis level of 1MVA
measurement: MIC of the whole project; multiple applications below the level for the same project or owner are treated on an aggregated basis by the SOs
consequence: The renewable electricity criterion and the autoproducer criterion for applicants between 1MVA and 10MVA apply only at or above this level.
conditions: Section 3.9.7 states that existing projects increasing MIC to 1MVA or more would not be captured under the de-minimis, as the level applies to the whole project.
provision: Section 6.2.1 (New Direction to the System Operators)
quote: For data centre applicants with an MIC equal to or above the de-minimis level of 1MVA and less than 10MVA

variable_text: Maximum Import Capacity (MIC) of a data centre connection application
value_text: equal to or above 10 MVA
measurement: MIC on a de-rated basis for the required dispatchable generation and/or storage capacity
consequence: Applicant must bring new onsite or proximate dispatchable generation and/or storage capacity at least equal to its MIC (de-rated), capable of wholesale market participation and separately connected and metered.
conditions: Applicants at or above 1MVA and below 10MVA must instead provide an autoproducer unit in the wholesale electricity market meeting 100% of the demand site MIC (de-rated basis).
provision: Section 6.2.1 (New Direction to the System Operators)
quote: For data centre applicants with an MIC equal to or above 10 MVA

consequence: Data centre must match at least 80% of its annual demand with additional renewable electricity generated in the Republic of Ireland, with a credible plan within a 6-year period from energisation.
conditions: Applies to data centre applicants with an MIC equal to or above the de-minimis level of 1MVA; renewable generation may be reflected up to 80% of annual demand on a de-rated basis against the dispatchable generation requirement.

conditions: Sentence of imprisonment imposed for violating this Act or related laws.

variable_text: 벌금형 선고 후 경과 기간

conditions: Fine imposed for violating this Act or related laws.

quote: 후 3년이 지나지 아니한 자

variable_text: pēdējo piecu gadu laikā piemērotas krimināla rakstura soda sankcijas (lookback period for criminal-nature sanctions imposed on a company)

consequence: A company on which criminal-nature sanctions were imposed within the last five years may not take part in the special regulatory environment
conditions: Applies jointly with the other exclusion grounds in Art. 8(3) points 1-3 (international or national sanctions; Russian or Belarusian ownership or control)
quote: komersants, kuram pēdējo piecu gadu laikā ir piemērotas krimināla rakstura soda sankcijas [a company on which criminal-nature sanctions have been imposed within the last five years]

variable_text: age of a child whose personal data is processed
value_text: below the age of 16 years
measurement: age of the data subject at the time of processing; the text does not specify a measurement method
consequence: Processing of a child's personal data requires consent from the child's parent or guardian; the controller must make every reasonable effort to verify that consent has been given (s.30(2)).
conditions: Applies to processing of personal data of a child; s.30(2) requires verification taking into account available technology.
quote: No person shall process the personal data of a child below the age of 16 years unless consent is given by the child’s parent or guardian.

variable_text: length of standing as a barrister (eligibility for the office of Data Protection Commissioner)

conditions: Applies to the head of the Office (Data Protection Commissioner) under s.4(3).
quote: shall be a barrister of not less than 5 years’ standing.

variable_text: coincidencia de la información biométrica con los registros del INE (credencial para votar)
value_text: al menos, en un noventa por ciento
measurement: Verificación en línea por la Institución contra los registros del Instituto Nacional Electoral; los datos biométricos obtenidos deben cumplir los requisitos técnicos de dicho Instituto
consequence: Online biometric verification of a person presenting an INE voter credential must reach at least a 90% match with INE records.
conditions: In-person operations under Art. 51 Bis; biometric data must be obtained directly from the holder.
provision: Artículo 51 Bis 4, fracción I, inciso b), párrafo primero
quote: coincida, al menos, en un noventa por ciento con los registros del mencionado Instituto

variable_text: coincidencia de la información biométrica con los registros de la SRE (pasaporte mexicano)
value_text: al menos, en un noventa por ciento
measurement: Verificación en línea por la Institución contra los registros de la Secretaría de Relaciones Exteriores; los datos biométricos obtenidos deben cumplir los requisitos técnicos de dicha Secretaría
consequence: Online biometric verification of a person presenting a Mexican passport must reach at least a 90% match with SRE records.
conditions: In-person operations under Art. 51 Bis; biometric data must be obtained directly from the person.
provision: Artículo 51 Bis 4, fracción II, inciso b), párrafo primero
quote: coincida, al menos, en un noventa por ciento con los registros de la Secretaría de Relaciones Exteriores

variable_text: coincidencia de la información biométrica con los registros de la SRE (matrícula consular)
value_text: al menos, en un noventa por ciento
measurement: Verificación en línea por la Institución contra los registros de la Secretaría de Relaciones Exteriores; los datos biométricos obtenidos deben cumplir los requisitos técnicos de dicha Secretaría
consequence: Online biometric verification of a person presenting a consular identity card (matrícula consular) must reach at least a 90% match with SRE records.
conditions: In-person operations under Art. 51 Bis; applies in addition to the data checks in fracción V, incisos a) to c).
provision: Artículo 51 Bis 4, fracción V, párrafo segundo
quote: que presenta la matrícula consular coincida, al menos, en un noventa por ciento con los registros de la Secretaría de Relaciones Exteriores

variable_text: número de identificaciones adicionales cuando la persona no cuenta con los documentos primarios
value_text: dos de las demás identificaciones

consequence: Where the person has none of the listed primary documents, the institution must require two of the other listed identifications and perform the verification in Art. 51 Bis 4, fracción IV.
conditions: Applies when the person presenting himself or herself has none of the documents listed in the preceding paragraph of Art. 51 Bis 2, fracción I, and the base de datos is being formed.
provision: Artículo 51 Bis 2, fracción I, párrafo segundo
quote: las Instituciones deberán requerir dos de las demás identificaciones mencionadas en la disposición 4ª, fracción I, inciso b), subinciso (i)

consequence: Centros de Carga connecting to the RGD at or above this contracted load are covered by the contract model; those below it do not require a connection contract under this model
conditions: Connection to the Redes Generales de Distribución; applies even where the Centro de Carga is a Usuaria de Suministro Básico
quote: con carga contratada mayor o igual a 1 MW aun cuando estos sean Usuarias de Suministro Básico [Contracted load of 1 MW or more, even where the users are Suministro Básico users]

consequence: Generación Distribuida plants below this installed capacity do not require an interconnection contract under this model; a contract under the Generación Distribuida model applies instead
conditions: Plant intends to operate under the Generación Distribuida figure
quote: con Capacidad Instalada menor a 0.7 MW, no requieren la suscripción de un contrato de interconexión

value_text: excede un período máximo de seis (6) meses adicionales a la fecha original o a la prórroga

consequence: Failure to meet the estimated start and completion dates by more than six additional months is a ground for termination of the contract
conditions: Termination also requires the other causes and procedure stated in the clause
quote: si esta excede un período máximo de seis (6) meses adicionales a la fecha original

consequence: A prórroga longer than six months must be requested under the applicable regulation (modification of the generation or storage permit before the CNE, or prórroga for a Centro de Carga before the CENACE)
conditions: Applies to the start and completion dates of the infrastructure required for the Interconexión or Conexión
quote: Si la Solicitante requiere de una prórroga mayor a seis (6) meses para

variable_text: capacidad de la Central Eléctrica de Autoconsumo

conditions: Central Eléctrica destined to satisfy Necesidades Propias through a Red Particular
quote: con capacidad igual o mayor a 0.7 MW que es destinada para satisfacer

variable_text: capacidad de Centrales Eléctricas de Autoconsumo interconectado con procedimiento simplificado
value_text: cuya capacidad sea entre 0.7 y 20 MW
consequence: Applicants for an interconnected self-consumption permit in this range follow a simplified procedure set by a separate Acuerdo
conditions: Permit for Autoconsumo interconectado
quote: cuya capacidad sea entre 0.7 y 20 MW cuentan con un trámite simplificado

variable_text: capacidad de Centrales Eléctricas de Autoconsumo interconectado fuera del procedimiento simplificado

conditions: Permit for Autoconsumo interconectado
quote: Centrales Eléctricas con capacidad mayor a 20 MW

variable_text: capacidad de Centrales Eléctricas adicionales al Grupo de Autoconsumo

conditions: Plant operates in addition to the Central Eléctrica de Autoconsumo
quote: Centrales Eléctricas con capacidad menor a 0.7 MW de forma adicional

variable_text: capacidad de pequeños sistemas eléctricos en micro-red de esquema comunitario
value_text: con capacidad mayor o igual a 0.7 MW y menor o igual a 5 MW

conditions: Gestión local de Autoconsumo aislado en esquema comunitario
quote: con capacidad mayor o igual a 0.7 MW y menor o igual a 5 MW

variable_text: demanda máxima de Usuarias de Autoconsumo respecto de la Capacidad Instalada, fuentes convencionales
value_text: sea menor a 50% tratándose de fuentes de energía convencional
measurement: Sum of maximum demand of Usuarias de Autoconsumo over Capacidad Instalada, per Registro de Autoconsumo information, over a continuous period of twelve months
consequence: If not cured by an accepted technical justification, the object of the permit is deemed to disappear (permit termination ground)
conditions: Measured after entry into operation of the Central Eléctrica; no accepted technical justification
quote: sea menor a 50% tratándose de fuentes de energía convencional

variable_text: demanda máxima de Usuarias de Autoconsumo respecto de la Capacidad Instalada, fuentes renovables
value_text: menor a 30% en el caso de fuentes de energía renovable
measurement: Sum of maximum demand of Usuarias de Autoconsumo over Capacidad Instalada, per Registro de Autoconsumo information, over a continuous period of twelve months
consequence: If not cured by an accepted technical justification, the object of the permit is deemed to disappear (permit termination ground)
conditions: Measured after entry into operation of the Central Eléctrica; no accepted technical justification
quote: menor a 30% en el caso de fuentes de energía renovable

variable_text: contraprestación por Excedentes de Autoconsumo con fuente primaria Energía Limpia (factor sobre costo nivelado y PML)
value_text: se paga a razón del menor entre el 0.9 por unidad del costo nivelado
measurement: Costo nivelado de la última subasta de largo plazo calculado con el año anterior; PML horario; negative PML taken as zero

quote: Si la Central Eléctrica de la Permisionaria utiliza como fuente primaria Energía Limpia, se paga a razón del menor entre el 0.9 por unidad del costo nivelado

variable_text: contraprestación por Excedentes de Autoconsumo sin fuente de Energía Limpia (factor sobre costo nivelado y PML)
value_text: se paga a razón del menor entre el 0.8 por unidad del costo nivelado
measurement: Costo nivelado de la última subasta de largo plazo calculado con el año anterior; PML horario; negative PML taken as zero
consequence: Surplus is paid at the lesser of 0.8 times the levelized cost and 0.8 times the PML
conditions: Central Eléctrica does not use any Energía Limpia source
quote: Si la Central Eléctrica de la Permisionaria no utiliza alguna fuente de Energía Limpia, se paga a razón del menor entre el 0.8 por unidad del costo nivelado

variable_text: capacidad de la central eléctrica, entre 0.7 y 20 MW
value_text: cuya capacidad sea entre 0.7 y 20 MW

quote: cuya capacidad sea entre 0.7 y 20 MW señalado en el presente Acuerdo [whose capacity is between 0.7 and 20 MW stated in this Acuerdo]

value_text: permitiendo hasta diez Líneas Telefónicas Móviles

conditions: Applies to personas físicas; exception for personas morales and personas físicas con actividad empresarial
quote: permitiendo hasta diez Líneas Telefónicas Móviles

variable_text: Titulares con diez o más Líneas Telefónicas Móviles en modalidad pospago al momento de la entrada en vigor

consequence: Titulares meeting the count are exempted from the restriction in Art. 10 on the maximum number of linked lines
conditions: Postpaid (pospago) lines only; count taken at the date of entry into force of the Lineamientos
quote: cuenten con diez o más Líneas Telefónicas Móviles en modalidad pospago

variable_text: duración de fallas por hechos fortuitos o causas de fuerza mayor que impiden u obstaculizan la operación de las Plataformas de Gestión y de Consulta

conditions: Failure caused by fortuitous events or force majeure that impedes or obstructs platform operation; failures not exceeding three hours are not treated as non-compliance under Art. 46 V.e
quote: que persistan por más de tres horas

variable_text: periodo de habilitación de nuevas Líneas Telefónicas Móviles en la zona afectada por emergencia o desastre

conditions: Applies to new lines in the zone affected by an emergency or disaster communicated by the competent authority, or when the Comisión so determines; the Comisión may set another period
quote: permanecerán habilitadas por un periodo de quince días

variable_text: volumen de descarga de aguas residuales (metros cúbicos mensuales)
value_text: no exceda de 300 metros cúbicos mensuales

provision: Artículo Segundo (reforming Ley de Aguas Nacionales, Art. 88 BIS 1, párrafo segundo)
quote: su volumen de descarga no exceda de 300 metros cúbicos mensuales

variable_text: años consecutivos sin explotar, usar o aprovechar aguas nacionales (plazo de caducidad)

provision: Artículo Segundo (reforming Ley de Aguas Nacionales, Art. 29 BIS 3, fracción VI, numeral 3)
quote: antes de dos años consecutivos sin explotar, usar o aprovechar aguas nacionales

quote: las personas futuras beneficiarias que representen las cuatro quintas partes de la superficie de riego proyectada

variable_text: fracción de la duración total de la concesión (última décima u octava parte)

quote: Si durante la última décima u octava parte de la duración total de la concesión

quote: que incurra más de una vez en conductas que impliquen infracciones a un mismo precepto

value_text: Cuando la cantidad sea mayor o equivalente a 50,000 litros

quote: Cuando la cantidad sea mayor o equivalente a 50,000 litros

variable_text: grado de parentesco consanguíneo con la persona servidora pública
value_text: parientes consanguíneos hasta el cuarto grado

conditions: Benefit not included in the public servant's remuneration
