measurement: cadastral value of the property
consequence: Rent for habitations leased to workers may not exceed this ceiling.
conditions: Applies to dwellings leased by the employer to workers.
quote: la renta no podrá exceder del medio por ciento mensual del valor catastral de la finca

variable_text: más de 50 trabajadores
value_text: En las empresas que tengan más de 50 trabajadores se constituirán Comisiones Mixtas
consequence: Mixed Training, Apprenticeship and Productivity Committees must be constituted.
conditions: Committees have equal numbers of worker and employer representatives.
quote: En las empresas que tengan más de 50 trabajadores se constituirán Comisiones Mixtas

variable_text: hasta 50 trabajadores
value_text: micro y pequeñas empresas, que son aquellas que cuentan con hasta 50 trabajadores
consequence: Labour and Economy Secretariats must incentivise productivity of these firms through programmes.
conditions: Defines micro and small firms for this provision.
quote: micro y pequeñas empresas, que son aquellas que cuentan con hasta 50 trabajadores

variable_text: vacantes provisionales con duración mayor de treinta días
value_text: las provisionales con duración mayor de treinta días
measurement: duration of the provisional vacancy
consequence: Definitive and provisional vacancies of this duration are filled by the worker of the immediately lower category, per the rule of the article.
conditions: Applies to definitive vacancies, provisional vacancies of more than thirty days and new posts.
quote: las provisionales con duración mayor de treinta días

variable_text: vacantes menores de treinta días
value_text: Cuando se trate de vacantes menores de treinta días
measurement: duration of the vacancy
consequence: Article 160 refers vacancies under thirty days to the first paragraph of article 159.
conditions: Vacancies of less than thirty days.
quote: Cuando se trate de vacantes menores de treinta días

variable_text: duración de la relación de trabajo de más de veinte años
value_text: Cuando la relación de trabajo haya tenido una duración de más de veinte años
measurement: duration of the employment relationship
consequence: Employer may terminate only for particularly grave causes under Art. 47 or where continuation is impossible.
conditions: Termination limited to causes in art. 47 that are particularly grave or make continuation impossible.
quote: Cuando la relación de trabajo haya tenido una duración de más de veinte años

variable_text: quince años de servicios
value_text: siempre que hayan cumplido quince años de servicios, por lo menos
measurement: years of service
consequence: Worker separating voluntarily is entitled to the seniority premium.
conditions: Applies to voluntary separation; separation for justified cause or dismissal is covered without this requirement.
quote: siempre que hayan cumplido quince años de servicios, por lo menos

variable_text: retiro voluntario dentro de un año
value_text: diez por ciento del total de los trabajadores de la empresa o establecimiento
measurement: number of workers retiring within one year
consequence: Premium is paid at the time of retirement; above this share, payment for the remaining workers may be deferred to the following year.
conditions: Measured over a one-year term, for the company or establishment, or a given category.
quote: diez por ciento del total de los trabajadores de la empresa o establecimiento

variable_text: empresas agrícolas, industriales, mineras, ...
value_text: en establecimientos comerciales o de servicio después de las diez de la noche
consequence: Pregnant or breastfeeding women's work may not be used in commercial or service establishments after this hour.
conditions: Applies to pregnant or breastfeeding women; also excludes unhealthy or dangerous work and night industrial work.
quote: en establecimientos comerciales o de servicio después de las diez de la noche

variable_text: descanso de seis semanas anteriores y posteriores al parto
value_text: Disfrutarán de un descanso de seis semanas anteriores y seis posteriores al parto
consequence: Maternity rest: six weeks before and six weeks after childbirth, with full salary.
conditions: Applies to working mothers; part of the pre-birth period may be transferred under the stated conditions.
quote: Disfrutarán de un descanso de seis semanas anteriores y seis posteriores al parto

variable_text: descanso posterior al parto de hasta ocho semanas
value_text: el descanso podrá ser de hasta ocho semanas posteriores al parto
consequence: Postnatal rest may be extended up to this duration.
conditions: Applies when children were born with a disability or require hospital medical care; a medical certificate is required.
quote: el descanso podrá ser de hasta ocho semanas posteriores al parto

variable_text: descanso por adopción de un infante
value_text: En caso de adopción de un infante disfrutarán de un descanso de seis semanas con goce de sueldo
consequence: Six-week paid rest after receiving an adopted infant.
conditions: Applies on adoption of an infant.
quote: En caso de adopción de un infante disfrutarán de un descanso de seis semanas con goce de sueldo

variable_text: período de lactancia
value_text: En el período de lactancia hasta por el término máximo de seis meses
consequence: Two extraordinary rests per day during the lactation period, or a one-hour reduction of working time.
conditions: Maximum lactation period for the breaks.
quote: En el período de lactancia hasta por el término máximo de seis meses

variable_text: prórroga del descanso al cincuenta por ciento de salario
value_text: tendrán derecho al cincuenta por ciento de su salario por un período no mayor de sesenta días
consequence: Fifty percent of salary during the extension of the rest period.
conditions: Applies to extensions mentioned in fraction III (rest prolonged for inability to work due to pregnancy or childbirth).
quote: tendrán derecho al cincuenta por ciento de su salario por un período no mayor de sesenta días

variable_text: regreso al puesto dentro de un año del parto
value_text: siempre que no haya transcurrido más de un año de la fecha del parto
consequence: Right to return to the post held.
conditions: Time elapsed since the date of birth.
quote: siempre que no haya transcurrido más de un año de la fecha del parto

variable_text: mayores de quince y menores de dieciocho años
value_text: Los mayores de quince y menores de dieciocho años, deberán obtener un certificado médico
consequence: Must obtain a medical certificate of fitness for work; no employer may use their services without it.
conditions: Bounds are exclusive as written ('mayores de' and 'menores de').
quote: Los mayores de quince y menores de dieciocho años, deberán obtener un certificado médico

variable_text: menores de dieciocho años
value_text: Queda prohibida la utilización del trabajo de los menores de dieciocho años:
consequence: Use of minors' work is prohibited in the listed activities (fractions I to IV).
conditions: Applies to the activities listed in fractions I to IV.
quote: Queda prohibida la utilización del trabajo de los menores de dieciocho años:

variable_text: establecimientos no industriales después de las diez de la noche
value_text: En establecimientos no industriales después de las diez de la noche
consequence: Use of minors' work prohibited in non-industrial establishments after this hour.
conditions: Applies to minors under eighteen.
quote: En establecimientos no industriales después de las diez de la noche

variable_text: menores de quince años en actividades artísticas, científicas o deportivas
value_text: realicen los menores de quince años relacionadas con la creación artística
consequence: Activities under parental supervision are not considered work, if the listed rules are met.
conditions: Written agreement with parental consent; activities must not interfere with education or health; remuneration not lower than the wage of a minor aged fifteen to eighteen.
quote: realicen los menores de quince años relacionadas con la creación artística

variable_text: trabajo nocturno industrial o después de las veintidós horas
value_text: Nocturnas industriales o el trabajo después de las veintidós horas
consequence: Listed as a hazardous or unhealthy activity for minors, whose employment is restricted.
conditions: Part of the list of hazardous or unhealthy work for minors under Art. 176.
quote: Nocturnas industriales o el trabajo después de las veintidós horas

variable_text: cargas superiores a los siete kilogramos
value_text: cargas superiores a los siete kilogramos
consequence: Moderate and heavy physical effort involving such loads is classed among hazardous work for minors.
conditions: Applies together with forced postures or repetitive movements over prolonged periods that affect the musculoskeletal system.
quote: cargas superiores a los siete kilogramos

variable_text: jornada de trabajo de menores de dieciséis años
value_text: La jornada de trabajo de los menores de dieciséis años no podrá exceder de seis horas diarias
consequence: Daily working time of minors under sixteen may not exceed this limit; periods of work are at most three hours.
conditions: Applies to minors under sixteen; rest periods of at least one hour between periods.
quote: La jornada de trabajo de los menores de dieciséis años no podrá exceder de seis horas diarias

variable_text: menores de dieciocho años en horas extraordinarias y días domingos
value_text: Queda prohibida la utilización del trabajo de los menores de dieciocho años, en horas extraordinarias y en los días domingos
consequence: Overtime and work on Sundays and mandatory rest days are prohibited for minors.
conditions: Applies to overtime and to Sundays and mandatory rest days.
quote: Queda prohibida la utilización del trabajo de los menores de dieciocho años, en horas extraordinarias y en los días domingos

variable_text: vacaciones pagadas de minores de dieciocho años
value_text: disfrutarán de un período anual de vacaciones pagadas de dieciocho días laborables
consequence: Minors under eighteen are entitled to an annual paid vacation of at least this many working days.
conditions: Applies to minors under eighteen; the stated minimum.
quote: disfrutarán de un período anual de vacaciones pagadas de dieciocho días laborables

variable_text: menores de dieciséis años en buques
value_text: Queda prohibido el trabajo a que se refiere este capítulo a los menores de dieciséis años
consequence: Work on ships under this chapter is prohibited for minors under sixteen.
conditions: Applies to work on ships (Chapter III, Título Sexto).
quote: Queda prohibido el trabajo a que se refiere este capítulo a los menores de dieciséis años

variable_text: menores de dieciocho como pañoleros o fogoneros
value_text: el de los menores de dieciocho en calidad de pañoleros o fogoneros
consequence: Work as pañoleros or fogoneros is prohibited for minors under eighteen.
conditions: Applies to the roles of pañoleros or fogoneros on ships.
quote: el de los menores de dieciocho en calidad de pañoleros o fogoneros

variable_text: período mínimo de vacaciones de trabajadores de buques
value_text: un período mínimo de doce días laborables de vacaciones anuales pagadas
consequence: Minimum annual paid vacation for ship workers, increasing with each year of service.
conditions: Applies to workers on ships (Chapter III, Título Sexto).
quote: un período mínimo de doce días laborables de vacaciones anuales pagadas

variable_text: máximo de vacaciones de trabajadores de buques
value_text: que se aumentará en dos días laborables, hasta llegar a veinticuatro
consequence: Annual vacation period for ship workers increases by two working days per year up to this maximum.
conditions: Increases apply for each subsequent year of service.
quote: que se aumentará en dos días laborables, hasta llegar a veinticuatro

variable_text: diez días o menos para el vencimiento del viaje
value_text: Cuando falten diez días o menos para su vencimiento
measurement: days remaining before expiry of the voyage contract
consequence: Ship workers may request termination of the employment relationship, giving three days' notice before departure.
conditions: Applies where a new voyage is intended that exceeds this term.
quote: Cuando falten diez días o menos para su vencimiento

variable_text: buques que naveguen por seis horas o más
value_text: cuando se trate de buques que naveguen por seis horas o más
measurement: duration of navigation
consequence: Food for ship workers is mandatory at the employer's expense, even if not stipulated in contracts.
conditions: Also mandatory where food is provided to passengers.
quote: cuando se trate de buques que naveguen por seis horas o más

variable_text: período de descanso de cuatro horas o más
value_text: a menos que el período de descanso sea de cuatro horas o más
consequence: Time spent obliged to remain aboard is counted as working time unless the rest period is this long or longer.
conditions: Applies to ship workers remaining on board during port stays.
quote: a menos que el período de descanso sea de cuatro horas o más

variable_text: monthly total service time of flight crew (tiempo total de servicios)
value_text: ciento ochenta horas mensuales
measurement: monthly total, fixed in the employment contract
consequence: Total monthly service time set in the employment contract may not exceed this figure.
quote: sin que pueda exceder de ciento ochenta horas mensuales.

variable_text: monthly effective flight time of flight crew (tiempo efectivo de vuelo)
value_text: noventa horas
measurement: monthly, fixed in the employment contract with regard to aircraft characteristics
consequence: Monthly effective flight time set in the employment contract may not exceed this figure.
quote: sin que pueda exceder de noventa horas.

variable_text: effective flight time of flight crew, day duty (jornada diurna)
value_text: ocho horas en la jornada diurna
measurement: per duty period
consequence: Flight time above this limit is extraordinary time.
conditions: Does not apply where a horizontal rest period equal to the flight time is granted before or on completing the duty period.
quote: no excederá de ocho horas en la jornada diurna, de siete en la nocturna y de siete y media en la mixta

variable_text: remaining flight duration at the working-day limit
value_text: no requiere más de tres horas
measurement: time remaining in the flight when the working-day limit is reached
consequence: Crew must complete the flight if it requires no more than this time; otherwise they are relieved or the flight is suspended at the nearest airport.
conditions: Applies when crew reach the working-day limit during flight or at a non-destination airport.
quote: si no requiere más de tres horas

variable_text: duration of service ending on a mandatory rest day
value_text: primera hora y media de dichos días
measurement: duration of service on a mandatory rest day
consequence: Where a service ending within this period is terminated, crew receive only one additional day's wage.
conditions: Applies to services on mandatory rest days.
quote: que no exceda de la primera hora y media de dichos días

variable_text: annual vacation increase per year of service (calendar days)
value_text: sesenta días de calendario
measurement: cumulative vacation period
consequence: Vacation period is increased by one day per year of service up to this maximum.
quote: sin que exceda de sesenta días de calendario

variable_text: period without flying for a technical crew member
value_text: 21 días o más
measurement: consecutive days without flying
consequence: Technical crew member must retrain for the category held and prove technical capacity before resuming work.
quote: hubiese dejado de volar durante 21 días o más

variable_text: hours before assigned flights during which alcohol is prohibited
value_text: veinticuatro horas anteriores
measurement: time before start of assigned flights
consequence: Crew may not drink alcohol during service or in this period before assigned flights.
quote: y en las veinticuatro horas anteriores a la iniciación de los vuelos que tengan asignados

variable_text: hours before start of service during which alcohol is prohibited (bus transport)
value_text: doce horas anteriores a su iniciación
measurement: time before start of service
consequence: Workers in road passenger and cargo transport may not use alcoholic beverages during service or in this period before it starts.
quote: en las doce horas anteriores a su iniciación

variable_text: age below which work by minors is prohibited (maniobras)
value_text: menores de dieciocho años
measurement: age of the worker
consequence: Use of work by persons under this age is prohibited.
quote: No podrá utilizarse el trabajo de los menores de dieciocho años.

variable_text: days of service in the three years before the incapacity determination (occupational disease contribution)
value_text: durante 90 días, por lo menos, en los tres años anteriores
measurement: days of service in the three years before determination of the degree of incapacity
consequence: Each employer that used the worker's services for at least this period contributes proportionally to occupational disease compensation.
conditions: Applies to occupational diseases.
quote: durante 90 días, por lo menos, en los tres años anteriores

variable_text: continuous work period for a temporary field worker
value_text: mayor a veintisiete semanas
measurement: continuous work for one or several employers
consequence: Temporary field worker is presumed to be a permanent field worker.
quote: labore en forma continua por un periodo mayor a veintisiete semanas

variable_text: duration of salary payment during incapacity of field workers
value_text: hasta por noventa días
measurement: duration of incapacity payment
consequence: Employer pays incapacitated field workers the stated share of salary for up to this period.
conditions: Applies to incapacity of field workers under Chapter VIII.
quote: el setenta y cinco por ciento de los salarios hasta por noventa días

variable_text: age below which employing minors is prohibited (field work)
value_text: menores de dieciocho años de edad
measurement: age of the person employed
consequence: Employers may not use the services of persons under this age.
quote: Utilizar los servicios de las personas menores de dieciocho años de edad

variable_text: net monthly income of platform worker, compared to minimum wage
value_text: por lo menos un salario mínimo mensual de la Ciudad de México
measurement: net monthly income, measured each month independent of time worked
consequence: Worker is treated as a platform worker in an employment relationship; if not reached at month end, the worker is considered independent for that month.
conditions: Income must be generated from services through the platform.
quote: genere ingresos netos mensuales equivalentes a por lo menos un salario mínimo mensual de la Ciudad de México

variable_text: consecutive days without activity on a digital platform
value_text: por un periodo consecutivo de 30 días naturales
measurement: consecutive natural days without platform activity
consequence: Employment relationship is deemed terminated automatically; renewed eligibility starts a new relationship.
quote: por un periodo consecutivo de 30 días naturales

variable_text: share of working time at the worker's home or chosen domicile (telework)
value_text: más del cuarenta por ciento del tiempo en el domicilio de la persona trabajadora
measurement: share of working time at home or chosen domicile
consequence: Employment relationships exceeding this share fall under the telework chapter; occasional or sporadic telework is excluded.
quote: más del cuarenta por ciento del tiempo en el domicilio de la persona trabajadora

variable_text: age below which domestic work hiring is prohibited
value_text: menores de quince años de edad
measurement: age of the adolescent
consequence: Hiring adolescents below this age for domestic work is prohibited.
quote: Queda prohibida la contratación para el trabajo del hogar de adolescentes menores de quince años de edad.

variable_text: maximum daily working hours for domestic-worker adolescents over 15
value_text: las seis (6) horas diarias de labor
measurement: daily working hours
consequence: Working days for adolescents over 15 in domestic work may not exceed this number of hours.
conditions: Adolescents over 15 years old hired for domestic work.
quote: las seis (6) horas diarias de labor y treinta y seis (36) horas semanales

variable_text: minimum nightly rest for domestic workers residing in the household
value_text: un descanso mínimo diario nocturno de nueve horas consecutivas
measurement: consecutive hours per night
consequence: Employer must allow at least this nightly rest.
conditions: Applies to domestic workers who reside in the household where they work.
quote: un descanso mínimo diario nocturno de nueve horas consecutivas

variable_text: minimum rest between morning and evening activities for residing domestic workers
value_text: un descanso mínimo diario de tres horas entre las actividades matutinas y vespertinas
measurement: hours per day between morning and evening activities
consequence: Employer must allow at least this rest between morning and evening activities.
conditions: Applies to domestic workers who reside in the household where they work.
quote: un descanso mínimo diario de tres horas entre las actividades matutinas y vespertinas

variable_text: maximum daytime working day for residing domestic workers
value_text: las ocho horas diarias
measurement: daily daytime working hours
consequence: Daytime working day may not exceed this number of hours; excess is treated as overtime.
conditions: Applies to domestic workers who reside in the household where they work.
quote: sin que la jornada diaria diurna pueda excederse de las ocho horas diarias

variable_text: age below which contracting workers in mines is prohibited
value_text: menores de 18 años
measurement: age of the person contracted
consequence: Employer may not contract or permit contracting of persons under this age in mining work centres.
quote: No contratar o permitir que se contrate a menores de 18 años.

variable_text: minimum duration of a fixed-term contract for medical residents
value_text: no menor de un año
measurement: contract term
consequence: Medical resident employment relationship must be for a fixed term of at least this length, not exceeding the residency duration.
conditions: Upper limit is the duration of the residency needed for the specialist certificate.
quote: La relación de trabajo será por tiempo determinado, no menor de un año

variable_text: number of workers in the same profession in a municipality below which an oficios varios union may be formed
value_text: menor de veinte
measurement: workers of one profession in the municipality
consequence: Miscellaneous-trade unions may be formed only where the number of workers in the same profession is below this figure.
conditions: Applies to oficios varios unions.
quote: el número de trabajadores de una misma profesión sea menor de veinte

variable_text: age above which workers may join unions
value_text: mayores de quince años
measurement: age of the worker
consequence: Workers older than this age may be members of unions.
quote: Pueden formar parte de los sindicatos, los trabajadores mayores de quince años.

variable_text: minimum number of workers to constitute a union
value_text: un mínimo de veinte trabajadores
measurement: workers at constitution
consequence: Unions must be constituted with at least this number of workers.
conditions: Alternative to the employer threshold for employer unions.
quote: Los sindicatos deberán constituirse con un mínimo de veinte trabajadores o con tres patrones, por lo menos.

variable_text: share of workers covered by the collective contract needed to support a union's application for representativeness
value_text: cuenta con el respaldo de por lo menos el treinta por ciento de los trabajadores cubiertos por el contrato colectivo
measurement: share of workers covered by the collective contract
consequence: Union may obtain the Constancia de Representatividad only with at least this support.
conditions: Applies to initial collective contract procedure.
quote: cuenta con el respaldo de por lo menos el treinta por ciento de los trabajadores cubiertos por el contrato colectivo

variable_text: share of union members that applicants must represent to request revision of a collective contract signed by several unions
value_text: el cincuenta y uno por ciento de la totalidad de los miembros de los sindicatos
measurement: share of members of the unions
consequence: Revision of the collective contract is available only where applicants represent at least this share.
conditions: Applies where the contract was signed by several unions.
quote: los solicitantes representen el cincuenta y uno por ciento de la totalidad de los miembros de los sindicatos, por lo menos

variable_text: share of affected workers that applicants must hold to request revision of a collective contract signed by several employers
value_text: el cincuenta y uno por ciento de la totalidad de los trabajadores afectados por el contrato, por lo menos
measurement: share of workers affected by the contract
consequence: Revision of the collective contract is available only where applicants hold at least this share.
conditions: Applies where the contract was signed by several employers.
quote: los solicitantes tengan el cincuenta y uno por ciento de la totalidad de los trabajadores afectados por el contrato, por lo menos

variable_text: share of unionized workers that unions must represent to request a contrato-ley
value_text: las dos terceras partes de los trabajadores sindicalizados, por lo menos
measurement: share of unionized workers in one branch of industry
consequence: Unions may request a contrato-ley only where they represent at least two-thirds of unionized workers in a branch.
conditions: Applies to a branch of industry in one or more states, economic zones or nationally.
quote: los sindicatos que representen las dos terceras partes de los trabajadores sindicalizados, por lo menos

variable_text: maximum duration of a contrato-ley
value_text: no podrá exceder de dos años
measurement: duration of the contrato-ley
consequence: Validity of the contrato-ley may not exceed this period.
quote: Su vigencia, que no podrá exceder de dos años

variable_text: two-thirds majority of unionized workers in a branch of industry (contrato-ley eligibility)
value_text: mayoría de dos terceras partes
measurement: Share of unionized workers in the branch concerned who conclude the collective contract; majority verified by the Centro Federal de Conciliación y Registro Laboral (Art. 415 II)
consequence: A collective contract concluded by this majority may be elevated to contrato-ley, subject to the procedure in Art. 415 I–VI.
conditions: Contract covers one or more Entidades Federativas, economic zones or the whole national territory.
quote: Si el contrato colectivo ha sido celebrado por una mayoría de dos terceras partes de los trabajadores sindicalizados de determinada rama de la industria

variable_text: duration of disciplinary suspension (cap)
value_text: no podrá exceder de ocho días
measurement: Length of disciplinary suspension imposed under the internal work rules
consequence: A disciplinary suspension in the work place may not exceed eight days.
conditions: Applies to the disciplinary provisions of the reglamento interior de trabajo (Art. 423 X).
quote: La suspensión en el trabajo, como medida disciplinaria, no podrá exceder de ocho días.

variable_text: indemnity per day of suspension, in multiples of the general minimum wage
value_text: un día de salario mínimo general vigente, por cada día que dure la suspensión
unit: days of general minimum wage per day of suspension
measurement: Per day of suspension ordered under Art. 427 VII (health-authority suspension)
consequence: The employer must pay workers an indemnity equal to one day of general minimum wage for each day of suspension.
conditions: Suspension of work declared by the competent health authority in a health contingency (Art. 427 VII); no authorization by the Tribunal required (Art. 429 IV).
quote: estará obligado a pagar a sus trabajadores una indemnización equivalente a un día de salario mínimo general vigente, por cada día que dure la suspensión

variable_text: duration of indemnity for suspension under Art. 427 VII (cap)
value_text: sin que pueda exceder de un mes
measurement: Duration of the daily indemnity from the start of the suspension
consequence: The indemnity for the health-contingency suspension may not exceed one month.
conditions: Health-contingency suspension under Art. 427 VII.
quote: sin que pueda exceder de un mes

variable_text: court-fixed indemnity for suspension, in months of salary (cap)
value_text: sin que pueda exceder del importe de un mes de salario
measurement: Indemnity fixed by the Tribunal when sanctioning or authorizing the suspension
consequence: The indemnity fixed by the Tribunal for suspension may not exceed the amount of one month of salary.
conditions: Applies to suspensions under Art. 427 other than fracción VII (Art. 430).
quote: sin que pueda exceder del importe de un mes de salario

variable_text: severance indemnity on termination for closure or definitive reduction of work, in months of salary
value_text: tendrán derecho a una indemnización de tres meses de salario
measurement: Per worker, in the collective termination causes of Art. 434 other than fracción IV
consequence: Workers are entitled to an indemnity of three months of salary, plus seniority premium under Art. 162.
conditions: Termination causes under Art. 434 fracciones I, II, III and V; not fracción IV.
quote: los trabajadores tendrán derecho a una indemnización de tres meses de salario

variable_text: indemnity on reduction of staff due to new machinery or procedures, in months of salary
value_text: tendrán derecho a una indemnización de cuatro meses de salario, más veinte días por cada año de servicios prestados
measurement: Per reassigned worker, plus 20 days of salary for each year of service
consequence: Workers reassigned due to implementation of new machinery or work procedures are entitled to four months of salary plus twenty days per year of service.
conditions: Absent agreement; employer must obtain Tribunal authorization (Art. 439).
quote: Los trabajadores reajustados tendrán derecho a una indemnización de cuatro meses de salario, más veinte días por cada año de servicios prestados

variable_text: minimum base for occupational-risk indemnities, in multiples of the minimum wage
value_text: no podrá ser inferior al salario mínimo
measurement: Daily wage used as base for indemnities under the occupational-risk title
consequence: The base amount for occupational-risk indemnities may not be below the minimum wage.
conditions: Indemnities under Título Noveno (Arts. 473–513).
quote: La cantidad que se tome como base para el pago de las indemnizaciones no podrá ser inferior al salario mínimo.

variable_text: maximum wage base for occupational-risk indemnities, in multiples of the area minimum wage

value_text: se apeguen a los límites de acumulación de espectro radioeléctrico que al efecto determine

variable_text: sanciones firmes previas por la misma causa

variable_text: capacidad de la Central Eléctrica

consequence: Generation permit in force required

variable_text: capacidad de la Central Eléctrica
value_text: menor a 0.7 MW
measurement: capacidad de la Central Eléctrica
consequence: Qualifies as Generadora Exenta; no generation permit required

variable_text: capacidad de la Central Eléctrica en Generación Distribuida

consequence: Central must be below this capacity to be Generación Distribuida

variable_text: capacidad de la Central Eléctrica de autoconsumo
value_text: igual o mayor a 0.7 MW

consequence: Production falls within the definition of autoconsumo
conditions: Production destined for own needs on site of the permit holder

variable_text: capacidad de Central Eléctrica interconectada de autoconsumo
value_text: entre 0.7 y 20 MW
measurement: capacidad de la Central Eléctrica
consequence: May obtain generation permit through a simplified procedure under CNE guidelines
conditions: Interconnected self-consumption
quote: cuya capacidad sea entre 0.7 y 20 MW pueden tener un trámite simplificado

variable_text: capacidad de la Central Eléctrica para el Mercado Eléctrico Mayorista
value_text: igual o mayor a 0.7 MW
measurement: capacidad de la Central Eléctrica
consequence: Production falls within the definition of generación para el mercado eléctrico
conditions: Output sold through Mercado Eléctrico Mayorista mechanisms
quote: Se considera generación para el mercado eléctrico a la producción de energía eléctrica y Productos asociados de una Central Eléctrica con capacidad igual o mayor a 0.7 MW

variable_text: demanda de los pequeños sistemas eléctricos
value_text: no mayor a 100 MW
measurement: demanda suministrada por el sistema
consequence: System qualifies as pequeño sistema eléctrico
conditions: Not permanently connected to the Red Nacional de Transmisión or Redes Generales de Distribución
quote: y que suministren una demanda no mayor a 100 MW

variable_text: niveles de consumo o demanda para registrarse como Usuario Calificado
value_text: niveles de consumo o demanda determinados y ajustados periódicamente por la Secretaría

consequence: Final user may register as Usuario Calificado
conditions: Levels set in the Secretaría's dispositions
depends_on: Secretaría determination under Art. 10 para. XXIII; Art. 73
quote: Determinar y ajustar periódicamente los niveles de consumo o demanda total y de consumo o demanda por Centro de Carga

variable_text: participación directa o indirecta de la Empresa Pública del Estado en el proyecto de inversión mixta
value_text: al menos el cincuenta y cuatro por ciento
measurement: participación directa o indirecta en el proyecto
consequence: Mixed investment scheme for generation projects is available
conditions: Scheme under Capítulo V of Título Tercero
quote: La Empresa Pública del Estado debe tener una participación directa o indirecta en el proyecto, de al menos el cincuenta y cuatro por ciento;

variable_text: distancia al poste o registro de red de baja tensión existente más próximo
value_text: inferior a doscientos metros

conditions: Mediation under Art. 97
quote: En caso de que la diferencia entre los avalúos de los dos peritos sea inferior a quince por ciento

variable_text: vigencia de los Certificados de Energía Limpia
value_text: 30 meses a partir de la fecha de su otorgamiento
measurement: periodo desde el otorgamiento del certificado
consequence: Certificate validity period
quote: Los Certificados de Energía Limpia tienen una vigencia de 30 meses a partir de la fecha de su otorgamiento.

variable_text: umbrales de emisiones o residuos de las fuentes de energía limpia
value_text: umbrales establecidos en las disposiciones reglamentarias

consequence: Source qualifies as Energía Limpia only if below the thresholds
conditions: Emissions or residues, where present
depends_on: Disposiciones reglamentarias
quote: no rebasen los umbrales establecidos en las disposiciones reglamentarias

variable_text: eficiencia mínima para la generación con hidrógeno

depends_on: CNE determination

variable_text: eficiencia mínima para centrales térmicas con captura y almacenamiento de carbono

consequence: Qualifies as Energía Limpia only if the minimum is met
conditions: Carbon capture and storage or biosequestration; emissions criteria also apply
depends_on: CNE determination
quote: emitida a la atmósfera a la eficiencia mínima que establezca la CNE

variable_text: monto total de los estímulos fiscales autorizados (presupuesto)
value_text: hasta 30 mil millones de pesos
measurement: Total of stimulus amounts authorised by the Comité de Evaluación, distributed from entry into force until 30 September 2030

conditions: Applies across Artículo Primero and Artículo Cuarto stimuli
quote: El monto total de los estímulos fiscales que se autoricen a los contribuyentes a que se refiere este decreto será de hasta 30 mil millones de pesos

variable_text: monto máximo del estímulo de deducción inmediata (Artículo Primero)
value_text: no excederá de 28 mil 500 millones de pesos

consequence: Amount authorised for the Artículo Primero stimulus may not exceed this sub-cap
conditions: Part of the total cap of 30 mil millones de pesos
quote: dicho monto no excederá de 28 mil 500 millones de pesos para el estímulo fiscal a que se refiere el artículo Primero de este decreto

variable_text: monto máximo del estímulo de deducción adicional (Artículo Cuarto)
value_text: ni de 1 mil 500 millones de pesos
measurement: Amount authorised for the Artículo Cuarto stimulus over the decree's validity
consequence: Amount authorised for the Artículo Cuarto stimulus may not exceed this sub-cap
conditions: Part of the total cap of 30 mil millones de pesos
quote: ni de 1 mil 500 millones de pesos para el estímulo a que se refiere el artículo Cuarto de este instrumento

variable_text: ingresos totales en el ejercicio inmediato anterior
value_text: hasta 100 millones de pesos

conditions: Applies to the minimum allocation of 1 mil millones de pesos

value_text: como mínimo 1 mil millones de pesos

conditions: Part of the total cap of 30 mil millones de pesos

variable_text: periodo mínimo en que los contribuyentes mantienen en uso la inversión
value_text: durante un periodo mínimo de dos años inmediatos siguientes al ejercicio en el que se efectúe su deducción inmediata

variable_text: monto máximo anual de estímulos que cada contribuyente puede aplicar
value_text: el monto máximo que los contribuyentes podrán aplicar, determinado por el Comité de Evaluación para cada ejercicio fiscal

quote: El comité determinará para cada ejercicio fiscal, el monto máximo que los contribuyentes podrán aplicar

variable_text: deducción inmediata (porcentaje del monto original de la inversión en bienes nuevos de activo fijo)
value_text: la deducción inmediata del 100% del monto original de la inversión de bienes nuevos de activo fijo

quote: podrán efectuar la deducción inmediata del 100% del monto original de la inversión de bienes nuevos de activo fijo

value_text: durante los ejercicios fiscales de 2025, 2026, 2027, 2028, 2029 o 2030

conditions: Investment acquired within the acquisition window stated in Artículo Tercero, párr. 2.
quote: durante los ejercicios fiscales de 2025, 2026, 2027, 2028, 2029 o 2030

variable_text: periodo mínimo de uso de la inversión tras la deducción inmediata
value_text: durante un periodo mínimo de dos años inmediatos siguientes al ejercicio en el que se efectúe su deducción inmediata
consequence: Immediate deduction applies only to investments kept in use for at least two years after the deduction year, except cases under Article 37 of the Income Tax Law.
conditions: Investment kept in use by the taxpayer.
quote: durante un periodo mínimo de dos años inmediatos siguientes al ejercicio en el que se efectúe su deducción inmediata

value_text: Para el ejercicio fiscal en que los contribuyentes inicien operaciones

quote: Para el ejercicio fiscal en que los contribuyentes inicien operaciones

value_text: Para el segundo ejercicio fiscal, el incremento será la diferencia positiva

variable_text: ejercicio fiscal de operación del contribuyente (tercer ejercicio)

consequence: The increment equals the positive difference from the average spending of the two preceding fiscal years.
quote: Para el tercer ejercicio fiscal, el incremento será la diferencia positiva

quote: sea igual o menor a 0.7 MW está exenta de permiso de generación

variable_text: quantity of computing power
value_text: greater than 10^26 integer or floating-point operations
measurement: Includes computing for the original training run and any subsequent fine-tuning, reinforcement learning or other material modifications the developer applies to a preceding foundation model (22757.11(i)(2)). Not indexed; the Department of Technology must recommend annually whether to update the definition (22757.14), with no automatic update.
consequence: A foundation model is a 'frontier model', bringing the transparency-report, incident-reporting and statement duties into play

value_text: at least as much computing power to train the frontier model as would meet the technical specifications found in subdivision (i)

consequence: The person is a 'frontier developer', the addressee of the chapter's developer duties and of the Labor Code whistleblower provisions

value_text: in excess of five hundred million dollars ($500,000,000)

consequence: A frontier developer is a 'large frontier developer': frontier AI framework, internal-use risk summaries to OES, risk-assessment summaries in transparency reports, framework-statement prohibition, internal anonymous whistleblower process, and the civil penalty in 22757.15
conditions: Must be a frontier developer
quote: “Large frontier developer” means a frontier developer that together with its affiliates collectively had annual gross revenues in excess of five hundred million dollars ($500,000,000) in the preceding calendar year.

variable_text: household income relative to state median income
value_text: incomes below 80 percent of the median income of this state
measurement: Median income of this state as defined by the most recent federal decennial census
consequence: Households below this income level count toward the household share test.
conditions: Used jointly with the 50 percent household share test.
quote: incomes below 80 percent of the median income of this state

variable_text: unemployment rate of the local area relative to the comparable state rate
value_text: at least 2.0 percentage points greater than the comparable unemployment rate for this entire state
measurement: Per the most recently available data published or officially provided by the United States Government, the Employment Department, the Portland State University Population Research Center or special studies
consequence: Local area may qualify for enterprise zone designation under the unemployment test.
conditions: Alternative to the income test in ORS 285C.090(1)(a) and the hardship determination in ORS 285C.090(1)(c).
quote: at least 2.0 percentage points greater than the comparable unemployment rate for this entire state

variable_text: total area of an urban enterprise zone
value_text: may consist of a total area of not more than 12 square miles in size
measurement: Excludes the portion of the zone below the ordinary high water mark of a navigable body of water
consequence: Size limit on an urban enterprise zone.
quote: may consist of a total area of not more than 12 square miles in size

variable_text: total area of a rural enterprise zone
value_text: may consist of a total area of not more than 15 square miles in size
measurement: Excludes the portion of the zone below the ordinary high water mark of a navigable body of water
consequence: Size limit on a rural enterprise zone.
quote: may consist of a total area of not more than 15 square miles in size

variable_text: greatest distance between any two points within an urban enterprise zone
value_text: An urban enterprise zone must have 12 miles or less
measurement: Greatest distance between any two points within the zone
consequence: Distance limit on urban enterprise zone shape.
conditions: Does not apply where ORS 285C.090(4) applies.
quote: An urban enterprise zone must have 12 miles or less

variable_text: greatest distance between any two points within a rural enterprise zone
value_text: a rural enterprise zone must have 15 miles or less
measurement: Greatest distance between any two points within the zone
consequence: Distance limit on rural enterprise zone shape.
conditions: Does not apply where ORS 285C.090(4) applies.
quote: a rural enterprise zone must have 15 miles or less

variable_text: distance between unconnected areas of an enterprise zone
value_text: Unconnected areas of an enterprise zone may not be more than five miles apart
consequence: Unconnected areas must lie within this distance of each other.
quote: Unconnected areas of an enterprise zone may not be more than five miles apart

variable_text: distance between unconnected areas of a rural enterprise zone in a sparsely populated county
value_text: Unconnected areas of a rural enterprise zone may not be more than 15 miles apart
consequence: Distance limit between unconnected areas of a rural zone.
conditions: Applies when an unconnected area is entirely within a sparsely populated county.
quote: Unconnected areas of a rural enterprise zone may not be more than 15 miles apart

variable_text: greatest distance between any two points within a rural zone partly in a sparsely populated county
value_text: Must have 20 miles or less as the greatest distance between any two points within the zone
measurement: Greatest distance between any two points within the zone
consequence: Alternative distance limit for a rural zone.
conditions: Only a portion of the zone is contained within a sparsely populated county.
quote: Must have 20 miles or less as the greatest distance between any two points within the zone

variable_text: greatest distance between any two points within a rural zone entirely in a sparsely populated county
value_text: Must have 25 miles or less as the greatest distance between any two points within the zone
measurement: Greatest distance between any two points within the zone
consequence: Alternative distance limit for a rural zone.
conditions: Zone is entirely contained within a sparsely populated county.
quote: Must have 25 miles or less as the greatest distance between any two points within the zone

variable_text: number of electronic commerce zones designated at any time
value_text: There may be designated at any time no more than 15 zones for electronic commerce
consequence: Caps the number of electronic commerce zones that may be designated at any time.
quote: There may be designated at any time no more than 15 zones for electronic commerce

variable_text: population of a city seeking electronic commerce designation
value_text: has a population of more than 1,500 but less than 2,000
measurement: As of January 1, 2002
consequence: City may be designated for electronic commerce under this alternative route.
conditions: Strict inequalities as worded. Must be met jointly with ORS 285C.100(1)(a), (c) and (d).
quote: As of January 1, 2002, has a population of more than 1,500 but less than 2,000

variable_text: distance from a city with population above 500,000
value_text: Is located less than 25 miles from a city with a population of more than 500,000
consequence: Required location for alternative electronic commerce city designation.
conditions: Must be met jointly with ORS 285C.100(1)(a), (b) and (d).
quote: Is located less than 25 miles from a city with a population of more than 500,000

variable_text: population of the reference city
value_text: a city with a population of more than 500,000
consequence: Reference city must exceed this population for the location test in ORS 285C.100(1)(c).
quote: a city with a population of more than 500,000

variable_text: distance from a city with a high concentration of high technology firms
value_text: Is located less than 10 miles from a city with a high concentration of high technology firms
consequence: Required location for alternative electronic commerce city designation.
conditions: Must be met jointly with ORS 285C.100(1)(a), (b) and (c).
quote: Is located less than 10 miles from a city with a high concentration of high technology firms

variable_text: population of the high technology reference city
value_text: does not exceed 85,000
measurement: As of January 1, 2002
consequence: Reference city must not exceed this population for the location test in ORS 285C.100(1)(d).
quote: does not exceed 85,000

variable_text: number of cities that may be designated for electronic commerce under ORS 285C.100
value_text: Only one city may be designated for electronic commerce under this section
consequence: Only one city may be designated under the alternative route.
quote: Only one city may be designated for electronic commerce under this section

variable_text: share of original zone lands retained after a boundary change
value_text: Retain at least 50 percent of the lands in the original enterprise zone
consequence: A boundary change must retain at least this share of the original zone lands.
quote: Retain at least 50 percent of the lands in the original enterprise zone

variable_text: population density of a county after an increase
value_text: If the population density of a county increases to more than 100 persons per square mile
consequence: County is no longer sparsely populated; later boundary changes of an existing rural zone are restricted under ORS 285C.120(1)(a) to (c).
quote: If the population density of a county increases to more than 100 persons per square mile

variable_text: distance of a separate area from the existing zone boundary
value_text: Is a separate area farther than five miles from the nearest point on the existing boundary
consequence: A boundary change may not add such an area to the zone.
conditions: Applies after the county ceases to be a sparsely populated county.
quote: Is a separate area farther than five miles from the nearest point on the existing boundary

variable_text: share of customers or orders located and originating in an out-of-area region
value_text: Not less than 90 percent of the customers or orders are located and originate in an area
measurement: Area from which long distance telephone charges would apply absent a toll-free number
consequence: Retail or financial firm serving customers by telephone, computer or the Internet is an eligible business firm only if this share is met.
quote: Not less than 90 percent of the customers or orders are located and originate in an area

variable_text: share of equity interest owned by the same person or persons
value_text: if 100 percent of the equity interest in the business firms is owned by the same person or persons
consequence: Affiliated business firms may elect to be treated as one eligible business firm.
conditions: Alternatively, one firm owns 100 percent of the equity interest of the other or others.
quote: if 100 percent of the equity interest in the business firms is owned by the same person or persons

variable_text: authorization filing fee cap (fixed amount component)
value_text: may not exceed the greater of $200 or one-tenth of one percent of the value of the investment in qualified property
measurement: Greater of this amount or the percentage of the proposed investment in qualified property
consequence: Sponsor may require a filing fee for applications up to the greater of this amount or the percentage component.
conditions: Fee may be required only after the sponsor adopts a policy consistent with Oregon Business Development Department rules.
quote: may not exceed the greater of $200 or one-tenth of one percent of the value of the investment in qualified property

variable_text: additional tax years covered by an extension agreement
value_text: may not exceed two additional tax years for which a school support fee must be paid
consequence: Extension of the exemption period by agreement is capped at this number of additional tax years.
conditions: Agreement must be executed on or before the date the firm is authorized.
quote: may not exceed two additional tax years for which a school support fee must be paid

variable_text: average compensation of new employees as share of county average annual wage
value_text: at an average rate of at least 150 percent of the county average annual wage
unit: percent of county average annual wage
measurement: Per assessment year during the tax exemption period, as determined at time of authorization
consequence: Agreement must require annual compensation of new employees at or above this rate.
conditions: Applies to rural enterprise zones and urban enterprise zones inside an MSA of fewer than 400,000 residents, other than where ORS 285C.160(3)(a)(A)(ii) applies.
quote: at an average rate of at least 150 percent of the county average annual wage

variable_text: average compensation of new employees as share of county average annual wage in a qualified rural county
value_text: at an average rate of at least 130 percent of the county average annual wage
unit: percent of county average annual wage
measurement: Per assessment year during the tax exemption period, as determined at time of authorization
consequence: Agreement must require annual compensation of new employees at or above this rate.
conditions: Applies if the enterprise zone is located in a qualified rural county.
quote: at an average rate of at least 130 percent of the county average annual wage

variable_text: average wage of newly hired employees as share of county average wage
value_text: must equal or exceed 100 percent of the average wage in the county
consequence: Average wage of newly hired employees must at least equal the county average wage.
conditions: Applies notwithstanding ORS 285C.160(3)(a)(A).
quote: must equal or exceed 100 percent of the average wage in the county

variable_text: population of the metropolitan statistical area containing an urban enterprise zone
value_text: an urban enterprise zone located inside a metropolitan statistical area of fewer than 400,000 residents
consequence: Determines whether the compensation requirement in ORS 285C.160(3)(a) applies to an urban enterprise zone.
quote: an urban enterprise zone located inside a metropolitan statistical area of fewer than 400,000 residents

variable_text: exemption claim filing fee for an inactive authorized firm (fixed amount component)
value_text: a filing fee equal to the greater of $200 or one-tenth of one percent
measurement: Greater of this amount or the percentage of total investment cost of qualified property in the property schedule
consequence: Inactive firm may file an exemption claim only with this fee; exemption may not be granted without it.
quote: a filing fee equal to the greater of $200 or one-tenth of one percent

variable_text: exemption claim filing fee for an inactive authorized firm (percentage component)
value_text: a filing fee equal to the greater of $200 or one-tenth of one percent
measurement: Total investment cost of the qualified property listed in the property schedule filed with the claim
consequence: Inactive firm may file an exemption claim only with this fee; exemption may not be granted without it.
quote: one-tenth of one percent of the total investment cost

variable_text: number of tax years property may be exempt under construction-in-process exemption
value_text: for no more than two tax years, which must be consecutive
consequence: Construction-in-process exemption is limited to this number of consecutive tax years.
quote: for no more than two tax years, which must be consecutive

variable_text: succeeding tax years of enterprise zone exemption
value_text: The exemption shall continue for the next two succeeding tax years
consequence: Exemption continues for two succeeding tax years after the first exempt tax year, if conditions continue to be met.
conditions: Applies if the property continues to be owned or leased by the business firm and located in the enterprise zone; subject to ORS 285C.203.
quote: The exemption shall continue for the next two succeeding tax years

variable_text: additional tax years of enterprise zone exemption under agreement
value_text: for up to two additional tax years consecutively following the tax years described in subparagraph (A)
consequence: Exemption may be extended by up to this number of additional consecutive tax years.
conditions: Requires a written agreement between the firm and the sponsor under ORS 285C.160.
depends_on: written agreement under ORS 285C.160
quote: for up to two additional tax years consecutively following the tax years described in subparagraph (A)

variable_text: exempt share of assessed value of qualified property
value_text: shall be 100 percent of the assessed value of the qualified property
consequence: Qualified property is exempt from ad valorem property tax at this share of assessed value.
conditions: Measured by the increase in value for additions, modifications and reconditioned property under ORS 285C.175(3)(b).
quote: shall be 100 percent of the assessed value of the qualified property

variable_text: time qualified property has been in service in the zone before January 1 of the first claim year
value_text: was in service within the zone for more than 12 months by January 1 of the first assessment year
measurement: Measured by January 1 of the first assessment year for which an exemption claim is made
consequence: Exemption may not be granted for qualified property in service in the zone for longer than this period.
quote: was in service within the zone for more than 12 months by January 1 of the first assessment year

variable_text: time qualified property has been in service in the zone for a late claim
value_text: or 24 months, in the case of a late claim under ORS 285C.220 (9)
consequence: For a late claim, exemption may not be granted for qualified property in service in the zone for longer than this period.
conditions: Applies to a late claim under ORS 285C.220(9).
quote: or 24 months, in the case of a late claim under ORS 285C.220 (9)

variable_text: period of non-use or non-occupancy of qualified property
value_text: not in use or occupancy for more than a 180-day period
measurement: Period ending during the preceding assessment year
consequence: Property not in use or occupancy for longer than this period is not qualified property.
conditions: Does not apply to the first assessment year for which the property is exempt (ORS 285C.180(4)).
quote: not in use or occupancy for more than a 180-day period

variable_text: minimum cost of qualified real or other personal property
value_text: $50,000 or more, in the case of:
consequence: Property must cost at least this amount to be qualified property.
conditions: Applies to all real property concurrently exempt at the location, and to personal property not described in ORS 285C.185(1)(b).
quote: $50,000 or more, in the case of:

variable_text: minimum cost of qualified personal property used in production of tangible goods or electronic commerce
value_text: $1,000 or more, in the case of an item of personal property that is used
consequence: Personal property must cost at least this amount to be qualified property.
conditions: Applies to personal property used exclusively in production of tangible goods, or in electronic commerce in a zone approved for electronic commerce designation.
quote: $1,000 or more, in the case of an item of personal property that is used

variable_text: share of receipts from property use paid by overnight guests
value_text: if at least 50 percent of any receipts from use of the property are paid by overnight guests
consequence: Hotel-related property is used primarily to serve overnight guests if this share is met.
conditions: Applies to property owned or leased by a firm operating a hotel, motel or destination resort.
quote: if at least 50 percent of any receipts from use of the property are paid by overnight guests

variable_text: period of idleness of reconditioned, refurbished, retrofitted or upgraded equipment
value_text: For a period of at least 18 consecutive months
measurement: Before or after the application, preceding the first assessment year of exemption
consequence: Equipment qualifies as reconditioned, refurbished, retrofitted or upgraded qualified property only if idle for this period.
conditions: Must also be idle at the time of application for authorization.
quote: For a period of at least 18 consecutive months

variable_text: prior period of use of reconditioned equipment
value_text: in use within the enterprise zone or elsewhere in the county for at least 12 consecutive months
measurement: Prior to the period of idleness
consequence: Equipment qualifies only if used for at least this period before idleness.
quote: in use within the enterprise zone or elsewhere in the county for at least 12 consecutive months

variable_text: cost of reconditioning, refurbishing, retrofitting or upgrading equipment
value_text: costs at least $50,000
consequence: Reconditioning or upgrade must cost at least this amount to qualify.
conditions: Must be completed in the year immediately preceding the first assessment year of exemption.
quote: costs at least $50,000

variable_text: employment of the firm relative to annual average employment
value_text: 110 percent of the annual average employment of the firm
measurement: Measured on or before the earlier of April 1 or the initial exemption claim date, following the year qualified property is first placed in service
consequence: Firm meets the employment qualification only at or above this level (or the alternative in ORS 285C.200(1)(c)(B)).
conditions: Except as ORS 285C.203 provides.
quote: 110 percent of the annual average employment of the firm

variable_text: employment of the firm relative to annual average employment, increment
value_text: The annual average employment of the firm plus one employee
measurement: Increment above annual average employment of the firm
consequence: Alternative employment qualification: average employment plus one employee.
conditions: Applies when this is greater than the 110 percent test in ORS 285C.200(1)(c)(A).
quote: The annual average employment of the firm plus one employee

variable_text: investment in qualified property as alternative qualification
value_text: completes an investment of $25 million or more in qualified property
consequence: Firm may qualify under ORS 285C.200(2) without meeting the employment requirements of ORS 285C.200(1)(c) or (e).
conditions: Firm must also be subject to ORS 285C.155 and satisfy those requirements, per ORS 285C.200(2)(a).
quote: completes an investment of $25 million or more in qualified property

variable_text: distance of closed or curtailed operations from the enterprise zone
value_text: more than 30 miles from the nearest boundary of the enterprise zone
consequence: Firm does not meet the qualifications if the firm or a firm under common control closes or permanently curtails operations beyond this distance and employment is diminished.
conditions: Applies to the transfer of eligible operations to the zone; diminished employment in the county and local labor markets; relevant through December 31 of the first tax year of exemption.
quote: more than 30 miles from the nearest boundary of the enterprise zone

variable_text: distance of transferred employees' former sites from the enterprise zone
value_text: from a site or sites within 30 miles from the nearest boundary of the enterprise zone
consequence: Firm moving employees from sites within this distance may meet qualifications under the employment test in ORS 285C.200(5).
conditions: Requires employment in the zone and at the former sites to reach the level in ORS 285C.200(5).
quote: from a site or sites within 30 miles from the nearest boundary of the enterprise zone

variable_text: employment in the zone and former sites after employee transfers, relative to annual average employment
value_text: to not less than 110 percent of the annual average employment of the firm within the zone
measurement: Calculated over the 12 months preceding the date of application for authorization
consequence: Required employment level for a firm that moved employees from nearby sites.
conditions: Applies where employees are moved from a site within 30 miles of the zone boundary; employment is measured in the zone and at the former sites.
quote: to not less than 110 percent of the annual average employment of the firm within the zone

variable_text: consecutive calendar quarters of statewide payroll decline and county unemployment condition
value_text: For two or more consecutive calendar quarters in the previous 12 months
measurement: As defined by the most recently available data published or officially provided by the United States Government or the Employment Department
consequence: Sponsor may suspend employment requirements only if this condition is met.
conditions: Requires a statewide decline in seasonally adjusted nonfarm payroll employment and the county unemployment condition in ORS 285C.203(1)(a)(A)(ii).
quote: For two or more consecutive calendar quarters in the previous 12 months

variable_text: county unemployment rate relative to comparable state rate for suspension
value_text: at least two percentage points greater than the comparable unemployment rate for this state
consequence: Required condition for sponsor suspension of employment requirements.
conditions: County in which qualified property is located; applies jointly with ORS 285C.203(1)(a)(A)(i).
quote: at least two percentage points greater than the comparable unemployment rate for this state

variable_text: qualified property investment required for suspension in a rural enterprise zone
value_text: $4 million if the qualified property is in a rural enterprise zone
consequence: Firm must complete at least this investment for sponsor to suspend employment requirements.
conditions: Applies jointly with ORS 285C.203(1)(a)(A).
quote: $4 million if the qualified property is in a rural enterprise zone

variable_text: qualified property investment required for suspension in an urban enterprise zone
value_text: $8 million if the qualified property is in an urban enterprise zone
consequence: Firm must complete at least this investment for sponsor to suspend employment requirements.
conditions: Applies jointly with ORS 285C.203(1)(a)(A).
quote: $8 million if the qualified property is in an urban enterprise zone

variable_text: duration of suspension of employment requirements
value_text: for a period not to exceed two consecutive years
consequence: Sponsor may suspend the employment requirements for at most this period.
conditions: Period of suspension does not count toward the total exemption period under ORS 285C.175.
quote: for a period not to exceed two consecutive years

variable_text: school support fee rate set by sponsor and school districts
value_text: that is at least 15 percent and not more than 30 percent
consequence: Governing bodies set a school support fee rate within this range, applied to exempt qualified property in the zone.
conditions: Set jointly by the zone sponsor governing body and each school district with territory in the zone.
quote: that is at least 15 percent and not more than 30 percent

variable_text: productivity increase of qualified business firm
value_text: at least a 10 percent increase in productivity
measurement: increase no later than 18 months following January 1 of first assessment year for which exemption claimed; productivity = output per labor hours
consequence: firm meets productivity requirement of ORS 285C.200(2)(b)(B)
conditions: sponsor may specify further requirements in resolution under ORS 285C.155
quote: The firm demonstrates at least a 10 percent increase in productivity

variable_text: amount withdrawn from productivity training account per trained employee
value_text: may not exceed $3,500 per trained employee
measurement: per deposit into account
consequence: caps firm withdrawals from account for training
conditions: for up to 30 months following the relevant April 1 date
quote: the total amount withdrawn from the account for that deposit may not exceed $3,500 per trained employee

variable_text: reduction in number of employees from highest number of employees
value_text: reduced by more than 85 percent from the highest number of employees of the firm
measurement: measured from highest number of employees of the firm, pursuant to initial claim of exemption
consequence: operations deemed substantially curtailed (disqualification notice under ORS 285C.240(1)(b))
conditions: pursuant to initial claim of exemption and satisfaction of ORS 285C.200 (1)(c)
quote: Is reduced by more than 85 percent from the highest number of employees of the firm

variable_text: reduction in number of employees over two consecutive annual filing periods
value_text: reduced by more than 50 percent from the highest number of employees of the firm over two consecutive annual filing periods
measurement: over two consecutive annual filing periods under ORS 285C.220(1)
consequence: operations deemed substantially curtailed (disqualification notice under ORS 285C.240(1)(b))
quote: Has been reduced by more than 50 percent from the highest number of employees of the firm over two consecutive annual filing periods

variable_text: annual average number of employees reduced below the greater of 12-month average plus one employee or 110 percent of that average
value_text: reduced below the greater of: (A) the annual average number of employees averaged over the 12 months preceding the application plus one employee; or (B) 110 percent of that average
measurement: annual average over each assessment year in which exemption allowed, using at least four equivalent periods
consequence: operations deemed substantially curtailed (disqualification notice under ORS 285C.240(1)(b))
conditions: applies to the first assessment year and any subsequently allowed year of exemption
depends_on: annual average number of employees over the 12 months preceding the date of the application for authorization (ORS 285C.210(1)(b))
quote: is reduced below the greater of:

variable_text: 110 percent of annual average number of employees over 12 months preceding application
value_text: 110 percent of the annual average number of employees of the firm, averaged over the 12 months preceding the date of the application for authorization
measurement: average over 12 months preceding the date of the application for authorization
consequence: operations deemed substantially curtailed (disqualification notice under ORS 285C.240(1)(b))
conditions: alternative to the greater-of test in ORS 285C.210(1)(b)(A)
quote: 110 percent of the annual average number of employees of the firm

variable_text: time after first year qualified property placed in service for filing additional property schedule
value_text: placed in service more than two years after the first year that qualified property of the firm was placed in service and subsequently granted exemption
measurement: from first year qualified property of the firm was placed in service and granted exemption
consequence: firm may not file an additional property schedule for such property (except under another authorization application)
quote: The firm may not file an additional property schedule to claim an exemption for additional qualified property placed in service more than two years after

variable_text: protected period of exemption against disqualification for failure to meet ORS 285C.160 agreement requirements
value_text: during the first three years of exemption
measurement: first three years of exemption
consequence: qualified property may not be disqualified for failure to comply with agreement requirements, if all other requirements are met
conditions: firm meets all other applicable requirements under ORS 285C.050 to 285C.250
quote: may not be disqualified during the first three years of exemption

variable_text: enterprise zone term from effective date of designation
value_text: Ten years plus that number of days necessary to delay the date of termination to the June 30 next following
measurement: from effective date of designation
consequence: enterprise zone terminates
conditions: plus days needed to reach the next June 30
quote: Ten years plus that number of days necessary to delay the date of termination to the June 30 next following

variable_text: period after termination for business firm to apply for authorization (enterprise zone)
value_text: shall be allowed for 10 years after the effective date of the termination to apply for authorization
measurement: from effective date of zone termination
consequence: firm may apply for authorization and claim exemption for qualified property inside former zone boundaries
conditions: property must be entirely outside boundaries of any current enterprise zone
quote: shall be allowed for 10 years after the effective date of the termination to apply for authorization

variable_text: period after termination for business firm to apply for certification (rural enterprise zone)
value_text: shall be allowed for 10 years after the effective date of the termination to apply for certification under ORS 285C.403
measurement: from effective date of rural enterprise zone termination
consequence: firm may apply for certification and claim exemption for facilities inside former zone boundaries
conditions: facility must be entirely outside boundaries of any current enterprise zone
quote: shall be allowed for 10 years after the effective date of the termination to apply for certification under ORS 285C.403

variable_text: period during which sponsor may not redesignate or designate a zone after termination for non-compliance
value_text: for a period not to exceed 10 years after the zone is terminated
measurement: from termination of zone under ORS 285C.245(2) or (3)
consequence: sponsor not eligible to redesignate or designate a new enterprise zone
conditions: does not apply to a county government if the terminated zone was also jointly sponsored by a city or port (ORS 285C.250(1)(c))
quote: for a period not to exceed 10 years after the zone is terminated

variable_text: area of reservation enterprise zone
value_text: may cover an area of no more than 12 square miles
measurement: area of zone
consequence: caps size of reservation enterprise zone
conditions: area need not be contiguous
quote: The reservation enterprise zone may cover an area of no more than 12 square miles

variable_text: area of reservation partnership zone
value_text: a reservation partnership zone comprising an area of up to 12 square miles
measurement: area of zone
consequence: caps size of reservation partnership zone
conditions: may include lands within jurisdiction of cosponsoring city, county or port
quote: a reservation partnership zone comprising an area of up to 12 square miles

variable_text: population of city whose urban growth boundary area is excluded from rural area
value_text: a city with a population of 30,000 or more
consequence: territory within urban growth boundary of such a city is not a rural area
quote: a city with a population of 30,000 or more

variable_text: default exemption amount in real market value for rural renewable energy development zone designation
value_text: the amount shall be $250 million
measurement: real market value of property exempt under the zone
consequence: caps total exempt real market value authorized for the designation
conditions: applies if no amount is specified in the sponsor resolution
quote: If no amount is specified in the resolution described in subsection (2) of this section, the amount shall be $250 million

variable_text: maximum exemption amount in real market value for any single designation
value_text: may not exceed $250 million for any single designation under this section
measurement: real market value of property exempt under a single designation
consequence: caps amount authorized by a single designation
conditions: amount specified in resolution may not exceed this value
quote: The amount may not exceed $250 million for any single designation under this section.

variable_text: investment in qualified property (waiver of ORS 285C.200(1)(c) and (e))
value_text: an investment of $5 million or more in qualified property
measurement: investment completed by the firm in qualified property
consequence: property may be exempt despite waiver of ORS 285C.200(1)(c) and (e) requirements
conditions: zone sponsor adopts resolution waiving ORS 285C.200(1)(c) and (e) at time of authorization
quote: The firm completes an investment of $5 million or more in qualified property.

variable_text: duration of rural renewable energy development zone exemption after first tax year
value_text: for the next two succeeding tax years
measurement: tax years following first tax year of exemption
consequence: exemption continues if conditions in subsection (4) remain met
conditions: property continues owned or leased, operated for renewable energy, and located in zone
quote: The exemption shall continue for the next two succeeding tax years

variable_text: additional extension of rural renewable energy development zone exemption
value_text: may continue for up to two additional tax years consecutively
measurement: tax years following subsection (4) period
consequence: extended exemption if authorized by written agreement under ORS 285C.160
conditions: written agreement between firm and sponsor
quote: may continue for up to two additional tax years consecutively

variable_text: median ratio of county per capita personal income to US equivalent
value_text: equal to or less than 0.75 over the last 10 years
measurement: median ratio for each year over last 10 years, per Bureau of Economic Analysis data
consequence: county qualifies as county with chronically low income or chronic unemployment (alternative test)
conditions: one of the alternative tests in ORS 285C.400(3)(a) to (c)
quote: is equal to or less than 0.75 over the last 10 years

variable_text: median ratio of county unemployment rate to US equivalent
value_text: at least 1.3 over the last 20 years or over the last 10 years
measurement: median ratio for each year over last 20 or last 10 years
consequence: county qualifies as county with chronically low income or chronic unemployment (alternative test)
